      <section class="a2-pass3-plan-puzzle-readable-surface" data-a2-pass3-surface="plan-puzzle" aria-label="平面拼圖說明">
        <div class="surface-kicker">平面拼圖</div>
        <h1>整理你的平面與空間資料</h1>
        <p>在這裡匯入底圖、設定比例，並畫出牆線、門窗、空間與家具。完成後可前往預算預覽做初步整理；後續預算仍以尺寸與物件資料為準，需人工確認，尚未進入正式估價流程。</p>
        <div class="a2-pass3-chip-row"><span>可匯入底圖</span><span>可設定比例</span><span>可畫牆與家具</span><span>需人工確認</span></div>
      </section>
      <section class="file-area" aria-label="檔案區">

          <button class="toolbar-btn primary" type="button" data-action="choose-file"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--file" aria-hidden="true"></span> 匯入底圖</button>
          <button class="toolbar-btn" type="button" data-action="start-blank-mm-draft" title="建立空白毫米草稿，先供人工確認與後續討論。"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--new" aria-hidden="true"></span> 空白毫米草稿</button>
          <button class="toolbar-btn" type="button" data-action="start-calibration" title="若檔名含寬度、高度或 mm 線索會提出比例建議；沒有線索時請用兩點校正。"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--ruler" aria-hidden="true"></span> 校正比例</button>
          <button class="toolbar-btn" type="button" data-action="reset-project"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--reset" aria-hidden="true"></span> 清空重畫</button>
          <button class="toolbar-btn" id="undoActionButton" type="button" data-action="undo-action" disabled title="復原上一個可復原操作，也可按 Ctrl+Z。"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--undo" aria-hidden="true"></span> 復原</button>
          <button class="toolbar-btn" id="redoActionButton" type="button" data-action="redo-action" disabled title="重做剛復原的操作，也可按 Ctrl+Y。"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--redo" aria-hidden="true"></span> 重做</button>
          <button class="toolbar-btn" type="button" data-mock-only="true" data-action="export-draft" title="整理平面草稿，供人工確認、預算整理與設計討論。"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--save" aria-hidden="true"></span> 整理草稿</button>
          <button class="toolbar-btn" type="button" disabled data-mock-only="true" data-action="export-pc-spike" title="正式圖說與估價需另行審核後提供。"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--stop" aria-hidden="true"></span> 正式文件尚未開放</button>
        </div>
        <div class="file-area-note">
          <span>操作路徑：上方檔案區；左側工具區；中間畫布；右側屬性面板。</span>
          <strong>草稿僅供討論與設計溝通，之後可整理進需求。</strong>
        </div>

      <section class="first-success-guide" aria-label="第一次成功流程" hidden>
        <div class="first-success-copy">
          <span class="first-success-kicker">第一次使用</span>
          <h2>5 步完成一份可討論的平面草稿</h2>
          <p>像做簡報一樣先完成草稿，再慢慢精修。</p>
        </div>
        <ol class="first-success-steps">
          <li class="first-success-step">
            <b>1. 開始草稿</b>
            <span>沒有底圖也能先畫。</span>
            <button class="toolbar-btn primary" type="button" data-action="start-blank-mm-draft">空白開始</button>
          </li>
          <li class="first-success-step">
            <b>2. 畫第一面牆</b>
            <span>點畫布兩點新增牆段。</span>
            <button class="toolbar-btn" type="button" data-action="start-draw-wall" data-mode-button="draw-wall">畫牆</button>
          </li>
          <li class="first-success-step">
            <b>3. 加門或窗</b>
            <span>先選牆，再加開口。</span>
            <button class="toolbar-btn" type="button" data-action="add-opening" data-opening-kind="door">新增門</button>
          </li>
          <li class="first-success-step">
            <b>4. 放一個物件</b>
            <span>家具、櫃體可拖拉調整。</span>
            <button class="toolbar-btn" type="button" data-action="start-place-furniture" data-mode-button="place-furniture">放到畫布</button>
          </li>
          <li class="first-success-step">
            <b>5. 檢查草稿</b>
            <span>右側摘要確認後即可完成草稿。</span>
            <button class="toolbar-btn" type="button" data-action="export-draft">匯出草稿</button>
          </li>
        </ol>
      </section>

                <button class="tool-card is-ready" type="button" data-action="toggle-orthogonal" data-toggle-button="orthogonal" aria-pressed="false" title="正交開關：畫牆第二點會鎖定水平或垂直方向，方便畫直角牆。"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--orthogonal" aria-hidden="true"></span><strong>正交</strong><span>水平 / 垂直</span><span class="tool-status" data-orthogonal-status>關閉</span></button>

              </div>

                <div class="compact-field">
                  <label for="current-wall-status">牆體狀態</label>
                  <select id="current-wall-status" data-field="current-wall-status">

                    <option value="bearing_wall">承重牆 / 結構牆</option>
                    <option value="light_partition">輕隔間 / 雙斜線 hatch</option>
                    <option value="wood_partition">木隔間 / 斜線 hatch</option>
                    <option value="solid_partition" selected>分間實牆 / 磚牆或石膏磚牆</option>
                  </select>
                </div>

                  <select id="current-wall-thickness" data-field="current-wall-thickness">
                    <option value="80">80mm　薄隔間或裝修牆</option>
                    <option value="100">100mm　木隔間、輕隔間常見</option>
                    <option value="120" selected>120mm　一般分間實牆</option>
                    <option value="150">150mm　較厚磚牆或石膏磚牆</option>
                    <option value="200">200mm　厚牆或局部結構</option>
                    <option value="240">240mm　分戶牆、承重牆常見</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div class="static-note"><strong>牆厚說明</strong> 一般承重牆約 240mm；木隔間與輕隔間常見 100mm；磚牆與石膏磚牆需依現場牆厚確認。</div>
                <label class="toggle-row" for="snap-enabled"><span>物件鎖點</span><input id="snap-enabled" data-field="snap-enabled" type="checkbox" checked></label>

    (function cleanFileAreaForLoop66() {
      const fileArea = document.querySelector(".file-area");
      if (!fileArea) return;
      fileArea.setAttribute("aria-label", "檔案區");
      fileArea.innerHTML = `

          <button class="toolbar-btn" type="button" data-mock-only="true" data-action="export-draft" title="整理平面草稿，供人工確認、預算整理與設計討論。"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--save" aria-hidden="true"></span> 儲存草稿</button>
          <button class="toolbar-btn" id="undoActionButton" type="button" data-action="undo-action" disabled title="復原上一個操作；快捷鍵 Ctrl+Z。"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--undo" aria-hidden="true"></span> 復原上一動</button>
          <button class="toolbar-btn" id="redoActionButton" type="button" data-action="redo-action" disabled title="重做剛復原的操作；快捷鍵 Ctrl+Y。"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--redo" aria-hidden="true"></span> 重做</button>
          <button class="toolbar-btn danger" type="button" data-action="reset-project" title="刪除目前候選草稿，重新開始。"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--reset" aria-hidden="true"></span> 刪除草稿</button>
          <button class="toolbar-btn" type="button" data-mock-only="true" data-action="export-draft" title="整理平面草稿，尚未進入正式估價。"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--file" aria-hidden="true"></span> 整理草稿</button>

    (function normalizeLoop74FileAreaStatus() {
      const fileArea = document.querySelector(".file-area");
      if (!fileArea) return;
      const path = fileArea.querySelector(".file-area-path");
      if (path) {
        path.setAttribute("aria-label", "草稿狀態");
        path.innerHTML = `
          <span role="status" aria-label="草稿模式" title="只建立可編輯草稿資料，不是正式成果。">草稿模式</span>
          <span role="status" aria-label="此裝置草稿" title="目前是此裝置可繼續整理的平面草稿。">此裝置草稿</span>
          <span role="status" aria-label="草稿資料" title="僅整理可供人工確認的平面草稿，不是正式報價。">草稿資料</span>
        `;
      }
      const actions = fileArea.querySelector(".file-area-actions");
      const chooseButton = fileArea.querySelector("[data-action='choose-file']");
      if (chooseButton) {
        chooseButton.classList.add("primary");
        chooseButton.title = "匯入 JPG／PNG／PDF 作為套繪底圖（PDF 取第 1 頁）。";
        chooseButton.innerHTML = '<span class="tool-icon tool-icon--file" aria-hidden="true"></span> 匯入底圖';
      }
      let blankButton = fileArea.querySelector("[data-action='start-blank-mm-draft']");
      if (!blankButton && actions && chooseButton) {
        blankButton = document.createElement("button");
        blankButton.className = "toolbar-btn primary";
        blankButton.type = "button";
        blankButton.dataset.action = "start-blank-mm-draft";
        chooseButton.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", blankButton);
      }
      if (blankButton) {
        blankButton.classList.add("primary");
        blankButton.title = "不匯入底圖，直接建立空白毫米草稿。下一步：畫牆，點兩點建立第一段牆。";
        blankButton.innerHTML = '<span class="tool-icon tool-icon--new" aria-hidden="true"></span> 空白開始';
      }
      const redoButton = fileArea.querySelector("[data-action='redo-action']");
      if (redoButton) {
        redoButton.title = "重做剛復原的操作；快捷鍵 Ctrl+Y。";
        redoButton.innerHTML = '<span class="tool-icon tool-icon--redo" aria-hidden="true"></span> 重做';
      }
      const exportButtons = fileArea.querySelectorAll("[data-action='export-draft']");
      exportButtons.forEach((button, index) => {
        if (index === 0) {
          button.dataset.loop74ExportIntent = "refresh-preview";
          button.title = "更新平面預覽。";
          button.innerHTML = '<span class="tool-icon tool-icon--save" aria-hidden="true"></span> 更新預覽';
        } else {
          // 移除 JSON/語意候選下載（MVP 不對外輸出檔案）
          button.style.display = "none";
        }
      });
      const note = fileArea.querySelector(".file-area-note span");
      if (note) {
        note.textContent = "兩種開始方式：匯入底圖套繪，或空白開始直接畫。下一步：畫牆，點兩點建立第一段牆。";
      }
    })();

    (function keepFirstSuccessGuideForLoop92() {
      const guide = document.querySelector(".first-success-guide");
      if (!guide) return;
      guide.innerHTML = `
        <div class="first-success-copy">
          <span class="first-success-kicker">第一次成功路徑</span>
          <h2>先選一種開始方式</h2>
          <p>可以匯入底圖套繪，也可以空白開始直接畫。空白開始後，下一步就是畫牆，點兩點建立第一段牆。</p>
        </div>
        <ol class="first-success-steps" style="grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));">
          <li class="first-success-step">
            <b>匯入底圖套繪</b>
            <span>有 JPG / PNG / PDF 平面圖時使用。</span>
            <button class="toolbar-btn primary" type="button" data-action="choose-file"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--file" aria-hidden="true"></span> 匯入底圖</button>
          </li>
          <li class="first-success-step">
            <b>空白開始直接畫</b>
            <span>沒有底圖也能先畫第一段牆。</span>
            <button class="toolbar-btn primary" type="button" data-action="start-blank-mm-draft"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--new" aria-hidden="true"></span> 空白開始</button>
          </li>
          <li class="first-success-step">
            <b>下一步：畫牆</b>
            <span>空白開始後，點畫布兩點建立第一段牆。</span>
            <button class="toolbar-btn" type="button" data-action="start-draw-wall" data-mode-button="draw-wall"><span class="tool-icon tool-icon--wall" aria-hidden="true"></span> 畫牆</button>
          </li>
        </ol>
      `;
      guide.hidden = true;
      guide.style.display = "none";
    })();

    (function enhanceKeyboardToolAffordanceLoop90() {
      const SHORTCUTS = {
        "undo-action": { aria: "Control+Z Meta+Z", label: "Ctrl 或 Command + Z" },
        "redo-action": { aria: "Control+Y Meta+Y Control+Shift+Z Meta+Shift+Z", label: "Ctrl 或 Command + Y；亦可使用 Ctrl 或 Command + Shift + Z" },
        "delete-current-selection": { aria: "Delete Backspace", label: "Delete 或 Backspace" }
      };
      const ACTION_HINTS = {
        "delete-current-selection": "只刪除目前選取的牆、門窗、標籤或家具。",
        "reset-project": "清除草稿前會先請你確認。",
        "export-draft": "更新平面預覽，不會產生對外檔案或正式估價。",
        "pan-canvas": "移動畫布視角，圖面物件不會被改動。",
        "fit-underlay-view": "把匯入的底圖重新填回可視畫面。",
        "toggle-object-snap": "鎖點為物件端點吸附，非背景格線吸附。",
        "toggle-orthogonal": "正交：將畫牆鎖定為水平或垂直方向。",
        "start-draw-wall": "畫牆過程可按 Esc 或「選取」取消。"
      };
      const MARKER = " | ";

      function stripLoop90Hint(value) {
        return String(value || "")
          .split(`${MARKER}Shortcut:`)[0]
          .split(`${MARKER}快捷鍵：`)[0]
          .split(`${MARKER}Note:`)[0]
          .split(`${MARKER}說明：`)[0]
          .trim();
      }

      function enhanceButton(button) {
        if (!(button instanceof HTMLButtonElement)) return;
        const action = button.dataset.action;
        if (!action) return;
        const shortcut = SHORTCUTS[action];
        const hint = ACTION_HINTS[action];
        if (!shortcut && !hint) return;
        if (shortcut) button.setAttribute("aria-keyshortcuts", shortcut.aria);

        const visibleText = (button.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        const currentTitle = stripLoop90Hint(button.getAttribute("title") || visibleText || action);
        const parts = [currentTitle || visibleText || action];
        if (shortcut) parts.push(`快捷鍵：${shortcut.label}`);
        if (hint) parts.push(`說明：${hint}`);
        const nextTitle = parts.join(MARKER);
        if (button.getAttribute("title") !== nextTitle) {
          button.setAttribute("title", nextTitle);
        }

        const currentLabel = stripLoop90Hint(button.getAttribute("aria-label") || visibleText || action);
        const labelParts = [currentLabel || visibleText || action];
        if (shortcut) labelParts.push(`快捷鍵：${shortcut.label}`);
        const nextLabel = labelParts.join(MARKER);
        if (button.getAttribute("aria-label") !== nextLabel) {
          button.setAttribute("aria-label", nextLabel);
        }
      }

      function enhanceAll(root = document) {
        root.querySelectorAll("button[data-action]").forEach(enhanceButton);
      }

      function install() {
        enhanceAll();
        const shell = document.getElementById("planPuzzleCleanShell") || document.body;
        const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
          mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            mutation.addedNodes.forEach((node) => {
              if (!(node instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
              if (node.matches?.("button[data-action]")) enhanceButton(node);
              enhanceAll(node);
            });
            if (mutation.type === "attributes" && mutation.target instanceof HTMLButtonElement) {
              enhanceButton(mutation.target);
            }
          });
        });
        observer.observe(shell, {
          childList: true,
          subtree: true,
          attributes: true,
          attributeFilter: ["title", "aria-label", "disabled", "aria-disabled"]
        });
        document.addEventListener("focusin", (event) => enhanceButton(event.target));
        document.addEventListener("mouseover", (event) => enhanceButton(event.target));
      }

      if (document.readyState === "loading") {
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", install, { once: true });
      } else {
        install();
      }
    })();
  </script>

  <script>
    (function () {
      var runtimeApiState = window.__laibePlanPuzzleRuntimeApi || {
        ready: false,
        importImpl: null,
        qaImpl: null,
        waiters: [],
        version: "r27-dom-import-bridge-20260705"
      };
      runtimeApiState.version = "r27-dom-import-bridge-20260705";
      window.__laibePlanPuzzleRuntimeApi = runtimeApiState;

      function getBridgeNode() {
        var bridge = document.getElementById("laibePlanPuzzleRuntimeBridge");
        if (!bridge) {
          bridge = document.createElement("div");
          bridge.id = "laibePlanPuzzleRuntimeBridge";
          bridge.hidden = true;
          bridge.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
          bridge.style.display = "none";
          (document.body || document.documentElement).appendChild(bridge);
        }
        bridge.dataset.version = runtimeApiState.version;
        bridge.dataset.ready = String(typeof runtimeApiState.importImpl === "function");
        bridge.dataset.lastStatus = bridge.dataset.lastStatus || "idle";
        return bridge;
      }

      function readBridgePayload(bridge, event) {
        if (event && event.detail && typeof event.detail === "object") {
          return event.detail;
        }
        var raw = bridge.textContent || bridge.getAttribute("data-payload") || "";
        if (!raw) {
          return null;
        }
        try {
          return JSON.parse(raw);
        } catch (error) {
          return { action: "error", requestId: bridge.dataset.requestId || "", error: "invalid bridge payload" };
        }
      }

      function writeBridgeResult(bridge, requestId, status, result) {
        bridge.dataset.ready = String(typeof runtimeApiState.importImpl === "function");
        bridge.dataset.lastRequestId = requestId || "";
        bridge.dataset.lastStatus = status;
        var json = "";
        try {
          json = JSON.stringify(result || {});
        } catch (error) {
          json = JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: "bridge result could not be serialized" });
        }
        bridge.dataset.lastResult = json;
        document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("laibe-plan-puzzle-runtime-bridge-response", {
          detail: { requestId: requestId || "", status: status, result: result || null }
        }));
      }

      function summarizeForBridge() {
        if (runtimeApiState.qaImpl && typeof runtimeApiState.qaImpl.getSummary === "function") {
          return runtimeApiState.qaImpl.getSummary();
        }
        return runtimeApiState.qaProxy && typeof runtimeApiState.qaProxy.getSummary === "function"
          ? runtimeApiState.qaProxy.getSummary()
          : { ready: false, importMetrics: {} };
      }

      function handleBridgeRequest(event) {
        var bridge = getBridgeNode();
        var payload = readBridgePayload(bridge, event);
        if (!payload) {
          return;
        }
        var requestId = String(payload.requestId || bridge.dataset.requestId || Date.now());
        if (requestId && bridge.dataset.processingRequestId === requestId) {
          return;
        }
        bridge.dataset.processingRequestId = requestId;
        bridge.dataset.lastStatus = "processing";
        var action = payload.action || payload.type || "import";
        var finish = function (status, result) {
          bridge.dataset.processingRequestId = "";
          writeBridgeResult(bridge, requestId, status, result);
        };
        try {
          if (action === "summary") {
            finish("ok", { ok: true, summary: summarizeForBridge() });
            return;
          }
          if (action === "smoke") {
            var smoke = runtimeApiState.qaProxy && typeof runtimeApiState.qaProxy.runSmoke === "function"
              ? runtimeApiState.qaProxy.runSmoke()
              : { errors: ["runtime-not-ready"] };
            finish("ok", { ok: true, smoke: smoke, summary: summarizeForBridge() });
            return;
          }
          if (action === "focus") {
            var focused = runtimeApiState.qaProxy && typeof runtimeApiState.qaProxy.focusBounds === "function"
              ? runtimeApiState.qaProxy.focusBounds(payload.bounds)
              : false;
            finish(focused ? "ok" : "not-ready", { ok: Boolean(focused), summary: summarizeForBridge() });
            return;
          }
          if (action === "error") {
            finish("error", { ok: false, error: payload.error || "invalid bridge request" });
            return;
          }
          Promise.resolve(window.laibePlanImportPdfObjectizationScene(payload.scene, payload.options || {}))
            .then(function (result) {
              finish(result && result.ok ? "ok" : "error", { ok: Boolean(result && result.ok), importResult: result, summary: summarizeForBridge() });
            })
            .catch(function (error) {
              finish("error", { ok: false, error: error && error.message ? error.message : String(error), summary: summarizeForBridge() });
            });
        } catch (error) {
          finish("error", { ok: false, error: error && error.message ? error.message : String(error), summary: summarizeForBridge() });
        }
      }

      function waitForRuntimeApi(timeoutMs) {
        if (typeof runtimeApiState.importImpl === "function") {
          return Promise.resolve(runtimeApiState.importImpl);
        }
        return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
          var startedAt = Date.now();
          var waiter = { resolve: resolve, reject: reject };
          runtimeApiState.waiters.push(waiter);
          window.setTimeout(function () {
            var index = runtimeApiState.waiters.indexOf(waiter);
            if (index >= 0) {
              runtimeApiState.waiters.splice(index, 1);
            }
            reject(new Error("平面圖工具尚未準備完成，已等待 " + (Date.now() - startedAt) + " 毫秒"));
          }, timeoutMs || 12000);
        });
      }

      function createQaProxy() {
        return {
          getSummary: function () {
            if (runtimeApiState.qaImpl && typeof runtimeApiState.qaImpl.getSummary === "function") {
              return runtimeApiState.qaImpl.getSummary();
            }
            return {
              ready: false,
              boot: window.__laibePlanPuzzleRuntimeBoot || null,
              mode: null,
              walls: 0,
              structures: 0,
              formalOpenings: 0,
              formalFurniture: 0,
              reviewText: 0,
              reviewLines: 0,
              reviewShapes: 0,
              importMetrics: {}
            };
          },
          runSmoke: function () {
            if (runtimeApiState.qaImpl && typeof runtimeApiState.qaImpl.runSmoke === "function") {
              return runtimeApiState.qaImpl.runSmoke();
            }
            return {
              selectReachable: false,
              wallToolReachable: false,
              furnitureToolReachable: false,
              dimensionToolReachable: false,
              zoomReachable: false,
              errors: ["runtime-not-ready"]
            };
          },
          focusBounds: function (bounds) {
            if (runtimeApiState.qaImpl && typeof runtimeApiState.qaImpl.focusBounds === "function") {
              return runtimeApiState.qaImpl.focusBounds(bounds);
            }
            return false;
          }
        };
      }

      if (typeof window.laibePlanImportPdfObjectizationScene !== "function" || !window.laibePlanImportPdfObjectizationScene.__laibeRuntimeBootstrap) {
        var importBootstrap = function (scene, options) {
          options = options || {};
          if (typeof runtimeApiState.importImpl === "function") {
            return runtimeApiState.importImpl(scene, options);
          }
          return waitForRuntimeApi(Number(options.timeoutMs) || 12000)
            .then(function (importImpl) { return importImpl(scene, options); })
            .catch(function (error) {
              return { ok: false, error: error && error.message ? error.message : String(error) };
            });
        };
        importBootstrap.__laibeRuntimeBootstrap = true;
        window.laibePlanImportPdfObjectizationScene = importBootstrap;
      }

      runtimeApiState.qaProxy = runtimeApiState.qaProxy || createQaProxy();
      window.LaibePlanPuzzleQa = runtimeApiState.qaProxy;
      var bridgeNode = getBridgeNode();
      document.addEventListener("laibe-plan-puzzle-import-objectization-request", handleBridgeRequest);
      document.addEventListener("laibe-plan-puzzle-runtime-bridge-request", handleBridgeRequest);
      if (window.MutationObserver) {
        new MutationObserver(function () {
          var nextReady = String(typeof runtimeApiState.importImpl === "function");
          if (bridgeNode.dataset.ready !== nextReady) { bridgeNode.dataset.ready = nextReady; }
          if (bridgeNode.dataset.requestId && bridgeNode.dataset.requestId !== bridgeNode.dataset.lastRequestId && bridgeNode.dataset.requestId !== bridgeNode.dataset.processingRequestId) {
            handleBridgeRequest();
          }
        }).observe(bridgeNode, { attributes: true, childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });
      }
      window.setInterval(function () {
        var node = getBridgeNode();
        var nextReady = String(typeof runtimeApiState.importImpl === "function");
        if (node.dataset.ready !== nextReady) { node.dataset.ready = nextReady; }
      }, 500);
    })();
  </script>

  <script id="laibe-endpoint-grips">
  // 端點夾點：選取圖塊後四角出現方形端點；拖端點精準移動，吸附牆端點/其他圖塊角點（12px 內）
  (function(){
    function init(){
      var canvas=document.getElementById('planCanvas');
      if(!canvas){ setTimeout(init,400); return; }
      var layer=document.createElement('div');
      layer.id='laibeGripLayer';
      layer.style.cssText='position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:14;';
      canvas.appendChild(layer);
      var raf=0, dragging=null;
      function schedule(){ if(raf) return; raf=requestAnimationFrame(function(){ raf=0; update(); }); }
      function selItem(){ return canvas.querySelector('.furniture-item.is-selected'); }
      function itemBox(it){
        return {L:parseFloat(it.style.left)||0, T:parseFloat(it.style.top)||0, W:it.offsetWidth, H:it.offsetHeight};
      }
      function update(){
        if(dragging) return;
        layer.textContent='';
        // Body moving is handled by the object body itself; do not render the extra blue body grip.
        return;
        var it=selItem(); if(!it) return;
        var b=itemBox(it);
        var g=document.createElement('div');
        g.className='laibe-endpoint-grip laibe-endpoint-grip--body';
        g.style.cssText='position:absolute;width:9px;height:9px;margin:-4.5px 0 0 -4.5px;border-radius:999px;background:#79d8ff;border:1.5px solid #0b1219;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(121,216,255,.48);pointer-events:auto;cursor:move;';
        g.style.left=(b.L+b.W/2)+'px';
        g.style.top=(b.T+b.H/2)+'px';
        g.__anchor=[.5,.5];
        g.addEventListener('pointerdown',startDrag);
        layer.appendChild(g);
      }
      function canvasScale(){
        var r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        return canvas.offsetWidth ? (r.width/canvas.offsetWidth) : 1;
      }
      function toClient(pt){
        var r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), s=canvasScale();
        return {x:r.left+pt.x*s, y:r.top+pt.y*s};
      }
      function snapTargets(exclude){
        var pts=[];
        canvas.querySelectorAll('line[data-wall-id]').forEach(function(l){
          pts.push({x:+l.getAttribute('x1'),y:+l.getAttribute('y1')});
          pts.push({x:+l.getAttribute('x2'),y:+l.getAttribute('y2')});
        });
        canvas.querySelectorAll('.furniture-item').forEach(function(f){
          if(f===exclude) return;
          var b=itemBox(f);
          pts.push({x:b.L+b.W/2,y:b.T+b.H/2});
        });
        return pts.map(toClient);
      }
      function startDrag(e){
        var it=selItem(); if(!it) return;
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        var b=itemBox(it), a=e.currentTarget.__anchor||[.5,.5];
        var anchorClient=toClient({x:b.L+a[0]*b.W, y:b.T+a[1]*b.H});
        dragging={
          it:it, start:{x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY},
          anchorStart:anchorClient,
          targets:snapTargets(it),
          lastAdj:{x:0,y:0}
        };
        layer.style.opacity='0';
        it.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:e.clientX,clientY:e.clientY,button:0,pointerId:99}));
        window.addEventListener('pointermove',onMove,true);
        window.addEventListener('pointerup',onUp,true);
      }
      var SNAP=12;
      function onMove(e){
        if(!dragging) return;
        if(e.pointerId===99) return;
        e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        var raw={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};
        var anchor={x:dragging.anchorStart.x+(raw.x-dragging.start.x), y:dragging.anchorStart.y+(raw.y-dragging.start.y)};
        var best=null,bd=SNAP*SNAP;
        dragging.targets.forEach(function(t){
          var dx=t.x-anchor.x, dy=t.y-anchor.y, d=dx*dx+dy*dy;
          if(d<bd){ bd=d; best=t; }
        });
        var adj=best?{x:best.x-anchor.x,y:best.y-anchor.y}:{x:0,y:0};
        dragging.lastAdj=adj;
        window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:raw.x+adj.x,clientY:raw.y+adj.y,button:0,pointerId:99}));
      }
      function onUp(e){
        if(!dragging) return;
        if(e.pointerId!==99){
          e.stopImmediatePropagation();
          window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:e.clientX+dragging.lastAdj.x,clientY:e.clientY+dragging.lastAdj.y,button:0,pointerId:99}));
        }
        dragging=null;
        layer.style.opacity='';
        window.removeEventListener('pointermove',onMove,true);
        window.removeEventListener('pointerup',onUp,true);
        schedule();
      }
      new MutationObserver(schedule).observe(canvas,{subtree:true,childList:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class','style']});
      schedule();
    }
    if(document.readyState!=='loading'){ init(); } else { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init); }
  })();
  </script>
  <script id="laibe-svg-layer-color">
  // 圖塊依 DWG 圖層上色（依用戶圖例）；取代 invert 濾鏡，修正黑/灰/白線在深色畫布隱形問題
  (function(){
    var RULES=[
      [/11-1|插座/,'#ff5f5f'],
      [/活動傢俱|活動家具|^09活動/,'#5b86ff'],
      [/09-2|廚具上櫃/,'#2fd8e8'],
      [/09-4|廚具設備/,'#2fd8e8'],
      [/09-6|電器設備/,'#2fd8e8'],
      [/09-1|廚具下櫃/,'#f2f6f9'],
      [/09-5|廚具配件/,'#f2f6f9'],
      [/^08|固定家具|固定傢俱/,'#9fe8e8'],
      [/06.*原有|門.*原有/,'#8ea3b8'],
      [/06.*新作|門.*新作/,'#7c93ab'],
      [/^7C$|^7c$/,'#9aa4ad'],
      [/衛浴/,'#bfe3ef']
    ];
    var FALLBACK='#dde5ec'; // 未對應圖層：亮灰，確保深底可見
    var GENERIC=/^(0|FURNITURE|DEFPOINTS)?$/i; // 無語意的 per-path 圖層
    var SVG_BLOCK_VISIBILITY_FILTER='none';
    function minVisibleStroke(doc){
      var vb=(doc.documentElement.getAttribute('viewBox')||'').trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number);
      var maxDim=vb.length===4 ? Math.max(Math.abs(vb[2])||0, Math.abs(vb[3])||0) : 0;
      return Math.max(4, Math.min(12, maxDim ? maxDim*.012 : 6));
    }
    function ruleColor(layer){
      for(var i=0;i<RULES.length;i++){ if(RULES[i][0].test(layer)) return RULES[i][1]; }
      return null;
    }
    // 分類主色：以工具籃分類上色（優先於來源圖層），確保同籃一致
    function catColor(cat){
      if(!cat) return null;
      if(/衛浴/.test(cat)) return '#bfe3ef';
      if(/廚具|爐具|水槽|電器/.test(cat)) return '#2fd8e8';
      if(/固定家具|固定傢俱|衣櫃|電視櫃|訂製/.test(cat)) return '#9fe8e8';
      if(/活動傢俱|活動家具|沙發|床/.test(cat)) return '#5b86ff';
      if(/水電|配電|插座|電信|對講/.test(cat)) return '#ff5f5f';
      if(/門|結構/.test(cat)) return '#8ea3b8';
      return null;
    }
    var relCat=null; // rel(檔名) -> 分類字串；來自 index
    var relCatReady=fetch('svg-blocks3-index.json?v=block-library-layered-qa-r58-20260708').then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(idx){
      relCat={};
      (Array.isArray(idx)?idx:idx.blocks||[]).forEach(function(e){
        relCat[e.rel]=[e.main||'',e.child||'',e.grand||'',e.title||''].join('/');
      });
    }).catch(function(){ relCat={}; });
    var colored={}; // srcUrl -> Promise<objectURL>
    function coloredUrl(url){
      if(!colored[url]){
        colored[url]=Promise.all([fetch(url).then(function(r){ return r.text(); }), relCatReady]).then(function(res){
          var text=res[0];
          var doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(text,'image/svg+xml');
          if(doc.querySelector('parsererror')) throw new Error('parse');
          var srcLayer=(doc.documentElement.getAttribute('data-source-layer')||'');
          var rel=decodeURIComponent((url.split('#')[0].match(/svg-blocks3\/[^\/]+$/)||[''])[0]);
          var cat=relCat&&relCat[rel]||'';
          var baseColor=catColor(cat)||ruleColor(srcLayer)||FALLBACK;
          var shapes=doc.querySelectorAll('path,line,polyline,polygon,circle,ellipse,rect');
          Array.prototype.forEach.call(shapes,function(el){
            var pl=el.getAttribute('data-layer')||'';
            var c=(!GENERIC.test(pl) && ruleColor(pl)) || baseColor;
            if((el.getAttribute('fill')||'none')!=='none'){ el.setAttribute('fill',c); }
            el.setAttribute('stroke',c);
          });
          var blob=new Blob([new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(doc.documentElement)],{type:'image/svg+xml'});
          return URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        });
      }
      return colored[url];
    }
    function recolor(img){
      var src=img.getAttribute('src')||'';
      if(img.__lbLayerColored) return;
      if(src.indexOf('svg-blocks3/')===-1 || src.indexOf('blob:')===0) return;
      img.__lbLayerColored=true;
      coloredUrl(src.split('#')[0]).then(function(u){ img.src=u; img.style.filter=SVG_BLOCK_VISIBILITY_FILTER; img.style.opacity='1'; }).catch(function(){});
    }
    function sweep(){
      var imgs=document.querySelectorAll('img.furniture-svg-block-preview, .lblib-thumb img');
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(imgs,recolor);
    }
    new MutationObserver(sweep).observe(document.documentElement,{subtree:true,childList:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['src']});
    if(document.readyState!=='loading'){ sweep(); } else { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',sweep); }
  })();
  </script>
  <script>
  (function(){
    function updLabel(){
      var sp=document.querySelector('#laibeTopTools [data-zoomlbl]');
      if(sp&&window.laibePlanGetViewZoom) sp.textContent=Math.round(window.laibePlanGetViewZoom()*100)+'%';
    }
    function zin(){ if(window.laibePlanStepViewZoom){ window.laibePlanStepViewZoom(1); updLabel(); } }
    function zout(){ if(window.laibePlanStepViewZoom){ window.laibePlanStepViewZoom(-1); updLabel(); } }
    function bind(){
      var canvas=document.getElementById('planCanvas');
      if(!canvas){ setTimeout(bind,200); return; }
      canvas.addEventListener('wheel', function(e){
        e.preventDefault();
        if(window.laibePlanZoomAtClient){
          window.laibePlanZoomAtClient(e.clientX, e.clientY, e.deltaY<0?1.15:0.87);
          updLabel();
        } else {
          if(e.deltaY<0) zin(); else zout();
        }
      }, {passive:false});
      function isEditableTarget(el){
        if(!el) return false;
        if(el.nodeType===3) el=el.parentElement;
        if(!el||!el.tagName) return false;
        return /^(INPUT|SELECT|TEXTAREA)$/i.test(el.tagName)||!!el.isContentEditable;
      }
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
        if(isEditableTarget(e.target)||isEditableTarget(document.activeElement)) return;
        if(!(e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)) return;
        if(e.key==='='||e.key==='+'){ e.preventDefault(); zin(); }
        else if(e.key==='-'||e.key==='_'){ e.preventDefault(); zout(); }
      });
    }
    bind();
  })();
  </script>
<script id="laibe-marquee-select">
(function(){
  function ready(){ var canvas=document.getElementById('planCanvas'); if(!canvas){ setTimeout(ready,200); return; } init(canvas); }
  function init(canvas){
    var SPECIAL=['is-calibrating','is-drawing-wall','is-pan-canvas','is-placing-zone','is-editing-zone-boundary','is-panning'];
    // 畫圖類殘留 class：引擎切回選取模式時可能沒摘掉（例：校正比例完成後），這些可安全清除
    var STALE=['is-calibrating','is-drawing-wall','is-placing-zone','is-editing-zone-boundary'];
    function engineMode(){ try{ var u=window.laibePlancraftPlusUiState; return u&&u.mode||null; }catch(e){ return null; } }
    function inSelectMode(){
      if(document.body.classList.contains('laibe-dim-on')) return false;
      var m=engineMode();
      if(m){
        if(m!=='select') return false;
        // 引擎說是選取模式 → 以引擎為準，順手清掉殘留的畫圖類 class（修正十字游標卡住）
        for(var s=0;s<STALE.length;s++){ if(canvas.classList.contains(STALE[s])) canvas.classList.remove(STALE[s]); }
        // 平移中（手掌/空白鍵拖曳）仍禁止框選
        if(canvas.classList.contains('is-pan-canvas')||canvas.classList.contains('is-panning')) return false;
        return true;
      }
      for(var i=0;i<SPECIAL.length;i++){ if(canvas.classList.contains(SPECIAL[i])) return false; }
      return true;
    }
    function isBackground(t){
      if(!t||!t.closest) return false;
      if(!canvas.contains(t)) return false;
      // 排除可單獨拖曳/操作的物件與 UI；牆線與背景允許起框（密圖時到處都是牆線）
      if(t.closest('button,a,input,select,textarea,[data-action],.furniture-item,[data-structure-id],[data-opening-id],[data-zone-id],.furniture-resize-handle,.furniture-rotate-handle,.loop70-tool-basket-panel,#loop70ToolBasketPanel,.laibe-dim-del,[data-loop70-panel-close]')) return false;
      return true;
    }
    // 底圖是 <img>：禁止瀏覽器原生圖片拖曳，否則在底圖上拖曳會吃掉 pointer 事件、框選畫不出來
    document.addEventListener('dragstart',function(e){ if(canvas.contains(e.target)) e.preventDefault(); },true);
    var ov=document.createElement('div'); ov.id='laibeMarqueeOverlay';
    ov.style.cssText='position:fixed;inset:0;display:block!important;visibility:visible!important;width:100vw;height:100vh;overflow:visible;pointer-events:none;z-index:2147483600';
    document.body.appendChild(ov);
    var box=document.createElement('div');
    box.style.cssText='position:fixed;z-index:2147483601;border:3px dashed rgba(121,216,255,1);background:rgba(64,140,255,.26);display:none;pointer-events:none;border-radius:2px;box-sizing:border-box;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(4,12,20,.92),0 0 20px rgba(121,216,255,.36)';
    ov.appendChild(box);
    // CAD 式動態提示：拖曳中跟隨游標顯示「指定對角點」
    var tip=document.createElement('div');
    tip.style.cssText='position:fixed;display:none;pointer-events:none;z-index:2147483602;padding:4px 9px;font:600 12px/1.3 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC",sans-serif;color:#e6edf2;background:rgba(16,22,28,.95);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.4);white-space:nowrap';
    tip.textContent='指定對角點：';
    ov.appendChild(tip);
    var outlines=[];
    window.__laibeMarqueeSel=[];
    function clearOutlines(){ outlines.forEach(function(o){o.remove();}); outlines=[]; window.__laibeMarqueeSel=[]; }
    window.laibeClearMarqueeSelection = clearOutlines;
    function outlineFor(el){
      var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
      var d=document.createElement('div');
      d.style.cssText='position:fixed;z-index:2147483601;pointer-events:none;border:1.5px dashed #ffd166;background:rgba(255,209,102,.10);border-radius:3px;left:'+(r.left-2)+'px;top:'+(r.top-2)+'px;width:'+(r.width+4)+'px;height:'+(r.height+4)+'px';
      ov.appendChild(d); outlines.push(d);
    }
    function clientPoint(e){
      var x=Number.isFinite(e.clientX)?e.clientX:(Number.isFinite(e.x)?e.x:(Number.isFinite(e.pageX)?e.pageX-window.scrollX:NaN));
      var y=Number.isFinite(e.clientY)?e.clientY:(Number.isFinite(e.y)?e.y:(Number.isFinite(e.pageY)?e.pageY-window.scrollY:NaN));
      return Number.isFinite(x)&&Number.isFinite(y)?{x:x,y:y}:null;
    }
    function intersects(a,b){ return a.left<=b.right&&b.left<=a.right&&a.top<=b.bottom&&b.top<=a.bottom; }
    var st=null, swallowClick=false;
    // 拖曳後瀏覽器仍會發 click，吞掉它以免引擎誤判為「點空白清除選取」
    window.addEventListener('click',function(e){ if(swallowClick){ swallowClick=false; e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault(); } },true);
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
      if(e.button!==0) return;
      canvas.classList.remove('is-marquee'); // 清上一輪殘留（pointerup 遺失時的保險）
      if(!inSelectMode()) return;
      if(!isBackground(e.target)) return; // 讓一般點選/拖曳照舊
      var p=clientPoint(e); if(!p) return;
      st={x:p.x,y:p.y,moved:false};
      clearOutlines();
    },true);
    window.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
      if(!st) return;
      var p=clientPoint(e); if(!p) return;
      var dx=p.x-st.x, dy=p.y-st.y;
      if(!st.moved && Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)<10) return; // 點擊容忍度：微抖不算拖曳
      st.moved=true;
      canvas.classList.add('is-marquee');
      e.preventDefault();
      ov.style.setProperty('display','block','important');
      ov.style.setProperty('visibility','visible','important');
      // CAD 式：左→右＝窗選（藍實線，全包才選）；右→左＝碰選（綠虛線，碰到即選）
      var toRight = p.x >= st.x;
      box.style.border = toRight ? '3px dashed rgba(121,216,255,1)' : '3px dashed rgba(126,226,154,1)';
      box.style.background = toRight ? 'rgba(64,140,255,.26)' : 'rgba(46,160,90,.30)';
      box.style.display='block';
      box.style.left=Math.min(st.x,p.x)+'px'; box.style.top=Math.min(st.y,p.y)+'px';
      box.style.width=Math.abs(dx)+'px'; box.style.height=Math.abs(dy)+'px';
      tip.style.display='block';
      tip.style.left=(p.x+16)+'px'; tip.style.top=(p.y+18)+'px';
    },true);
    window.addEventListener('pointerup',function(e){
      if(!st) return;
      var p=clientPoint(e)||{x:st.x,y:st.y};
      var wasDrag=st.moved, sx=st.x, sy=st.y; st=null; box.style.display='none'; tip.style.display='none'; canvas.classList.remove('is-marquee');
      if(!wasDrag) return; // 純點擊 → 交給原本單選
      var rect={left:Math.min(sx,p.x),top:Math.min(sy,p.y),right:Math.max(sx,p.x),bottom:Math.max(sy,p.y)};
      var crossing = p.x < sx; // 右→左＝碰選
      function contained(A,r){ return r.left>=A.left && r.right<=A.right && r.top>=A.top && r.bottom<=A.bottom; }
      var sel=[], seenW={}, seenS={};
      canvas.querySelectorAll('[data-wall-id],.furniture-item,[data-structure-id]').forEach(function(el){
        var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
        if(r.width<=0&&r.height<=0) return;
        if(crossing ? !intersects(rect,r) : !contained(rect,r)) return;
        var wid=el.getAttribute('data-wall-id'); if(wid){ if(seenW[wid])return; seenW[wid]=1; }
        var sid=el.getAttribute('data-structure-id'); if(sid){ if(seenS[sid])return; seenS[sid]=1; }
        sel.push(el); outlineFor(el);
      });
      window.__laibeMarqueeSel=sel;
      var applied=0;
      try{ if(typeof window.laibePlanApplyMarqueeSelection==='function') applied=window.laibePlanApplyMarqueeSelection(sel)||0; }catch(err){}
      if(applied){ sel=[]; }
      swallowClick=true; // 吞掉拖曳後的 click
      setTimeout(function(){ swallowClick=false; },150); // 若瀏覽器沒發 click，避免吞到下一次真點擊
      // 只框到單一物件 → 同步觸發引擎單選，讓屬性面板更新
      if(sel.length===1){ try{ setTimeout(function(){ swallowClick=false; sel[0].dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); },0); }catch(err){} }
    },true);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel',function(){
      if(!st) return;
      st=null; box.style.display='none'; tip.style.display='none'; canvas.classList.remove('is-marquee');
    },true);
    canvas.addEventListener('wheel',function(){ clearOutlines(); },true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      if(e.key!=='Delete'&&e.key!=='Backspace') return;
      if(/input|textarea|select/i.test((e.target&&e.target.tagName)||'')) return;
      if(typeof window.laibePlanHasActiveSelection==='function'&&window.laibePlanHasActiveSelection()){
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        try{ window.laibePlanDeleteCurrentSelection&&window.laibePlanDeleteCurrentSelection(); }catch(err){}
        clearOutlines();
        return;
      }
      var sel=window.__laibeMarqueeSel||[]; if(!sel.length) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      var specs=[];
      sel.forEach(function(el){
        var w=el.getAttribute&&el.getAttribute('data-wall-id'); if(w){ specs.push('[data-wall-id="'+(window.CSS&&CSS.escape?CSS.escape(w):w)+'"]'); return; }
        var s=el.getAttribute&&el.getAttribute('data-structure-id'); if(s){ specs.push('[data-structure-id="'+(window.CSS&&CSS.escape?CSS.escape(s):s)+'"]'); return; }
        var f=el.getAttribute&&el.getAttribute('data-furniture-id'); if(!f&&el.classList&&el.classList.contains('furniture-item')) f=el.getAttribute('data-furniture-id');
        if(f){ specs.push('[data-furniture-id="'+(window.CSS&&CSS.escape?CSS.escape(f):f)+'"]'); }
      });
      clearOutlines();
      specs.forEach(function(q){
        try{
          var el=canvas.querySelector(q); if(!el) return;
          el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));
          var d=document.querySelector('[data-action="delete-current-selection"]');
          if(d) d.click();
        }catch(err){}
      });
    },true);
  }
  ready();
})();
</script>

<script id="laibe-plan-clean">
(function(){
  var RX=/^(JSON|SVG)$|候選\s*JSON|floorplan\.(budget|semantic)|\.pc\b/i;
  function clean(){
    document.querySelectorAll("button, a, .toolbar-btn, .file-area-actions *").forEach(function(el){
      if(el.children.length===0){ var t=(el.textContent||"").trim(); if(t && RX.test(t)){ var b=el.closest("button,a"); (b||el).style.display="none"; } }
    });
    document.querySelectorAll("*").forEach(function(el){ if(el.children.length===0){ var t=(el.textContent||"").trim(); if(t && /^\?{3,}/.test(t)){ el.style.visibility="hidden"; } } });
  }
  clean(); setTimeout(clean,500); setTimeout(clean,1500);
  var mo=new MutationObserver(function(){ clearTimeout(window.__lpc); window.__lpc=setTimeout(clean,300); });
  mo.observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});
})();
</script>

Calibrate before drawing walls, openings, or furniture.":"匯入的底圖尚待校正比例，請先校正再畫牆、門窗或傢俱。","Scale set. Next: draw the first wall.":"比例已設定。下一步：畫出第一段牆。"};
  function tr(){ try{
    var w=document.createTreeWalker(document.body,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,null);
    var nodes=[],node; while(node=w.nextNode()){ nodes.push(node); }
    nodes.forEach(function(t){ var k=(t.nodeValue||"").trim(); if(D[k]!==undefined){ t.nodeValue=t.nodeValue.replace(k,D[k]); } });
    document.querySelectorAll(".toolbar-btn,button").forEach(function(b){ if(/JSON|候選\s*草稿\s*JSON/i.test(b.textContent||"")) b.style.display="none"; });
    document.querySelectorAll(".canvas-footer strong").forEach(function(s){ if((s.textContent||"").indexOf("候選草稿")>=0) s.textContent=(s.textContent||"").replace("候選草稿","草稿"); });
    document.querySelectorAll(".inspector-compact-note").forEach(function(d){ if(/Candidate|candidate|window\.|mock|n8n|evidence|JSON|候選/.test(d.textContent||"")) d.style.display="none"; });
    document.querySelectorAll(".status-card").forEach(function(c){ var b=c.querySelector("b"); if(b&&/草稿預覽/.test(b.textContent||"")) c.style.display="none"; });
    var dos=document.getElementById("draftOutputStatusText"); if(dos&&/正式提交|草稿/.test(dos.textContent||"")) dos.textContent="草稿預覽，尚未正式提交";
    nodes.forEach(function(t){ var v=t.nodeValue; if(!v) return;
      if(/\d+\s*walls?\s*\/\s*\d+\s*openings?\s*\/\s*\d+\s*objects?/.test(v)){
        t.nodeValue=v.replace(/(\d+)\s*walls?\s*\/\s*(\d+)\s*openings?\s*\/\s*(\d+)\s*objects?/, "$1 牆面 / $2 門窗 / $3 物件");
      }
    });
  }catch(e){} }
  tr(); setTimeout(tr,400); setTimeout(tr,1200);
  var mo=new MutationObserver(function(){ clearTimeout(window.__lpi); window.__lpi=setTimeout(tr,250); });
  mo.observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});
})();

<script id="laibe-plan-guide">
(function(){
  // #5 收合技術頁籤（材料／總覽）
  function hideTabs(){ document.querySelectorAll(".inspector-tab").forEach(function(t){ var x=(t.textContent||"").trim(); if(x==="材料"||x==="總覽"){ t.classList.add("laibe-hide"); } }); }
  hideTabs(); setTimeout(hideTabs,600); new MutationObserver(hideTabs).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});
  // #4 步驟提示列
  var fa=document.querySelector(".file-area-actions");
  if(fa && !document.getElementById("laibe-stepstrip")){
    var steps=["匯入底圖","畫牆","門窗","標示空間","放置傢俱","標示地板材質","確認每頁圖種"];
    var strip=document.createElement("div"); strip.id="laibe-stepstrip";
    strip.innerHTML='<span class="lbl">繪製步驟</span>'+steps.map(function(s,i){return '<span class="lstep'+(i===0?" on":"")+'" data-i="'+i+'"><span class="n">'+(i+1)+'</span>'+s+'</span>'+(i<steps.length-1?'<span class="arr">›</span>':'');}).join("");
    fa.parentNode.insertBefore(strip, fa.nextSibling);
    strip.addEventListener("click",function(e){ var s=e.target.closest(".lstep"); if(!s)return; if(e.target.classList.contains("opt")){ s.classList.toggle("checked"); e.target.textContent=s.classList.contains("checked")?"\u2611":"\u2610"; return; } strip.querySelectorAll(".lstep").forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove("on");}); s.classList.add("on"); });
  }
  // #7 完成平面 → 下一步 CTA
  if(!document.getElementById("laibe-plancta")){
    var bar=document.createElement("div"); bar.id="laibe-plancta";
    bar.innerHTML='<button class="pbtn primary" id="planDone" type="button">完成平面</button>'
      +'<a class="pbtn" id="planBackReq" aria-disabled="true" href="../onboard_ai_agent/code.html">回需求整理</a>'
      +'<a class="pbtn" id="planGoBudget" aria-disabled="true" href="../preview_budget/code.html">進預算預覽 →</a>';
    document.body.appendChild(bar);
    document.getElementById("planDone").addEventListener("click",function(){
      bar.classList.add("done");
      document.getElementById("planBackReq").setAttribute("aria-disabled","false");
      var gb=document.getElementById("planGoBudget"); gb.setAttribute("aria-disabled","false"); gb.classList.add("primary");
      this.textContent="✓ 已完成平面"; this.setAttribute("aria-disabled","true");
      var st=document.querySelector("#laibe-stepstrip .lstep[data-i=\"6\"]"); if(st){ document.querySelectorAll("#laibe-stepstrip .lstep").forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove("on");}); st.classList.add("on"); }
    });
  }
})();
</script>
<script id="laibe-mat-tool">
(function(){
  var MATS=["木地板","超耐磨木地板","拋光石英磚","磁磚","石材","水泥粉光","塑膠地板","未指定"];
  function build(){
    if(document.getElementById("laibeMatTool")) return true;
    var nav=document.querySelector(".loop67-toolbar.loop68-compact-rail")||document.querySelector(".loop70-tool-basket-rail");
    if(!nav) return false;

    sec.className="loop67-tool-section loop68-rail-group loop70-rail-group";
    sec.setAttribute("data-loop70-rail-group","floor-material");
    sec.setAttribute("aria-label","地板材質");

    btn.innerHTML='<span class="loop70-basket-icon"><span class="tool-icon" aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-grid;place-items:center;font-size:16px">▦</span></span><span class="loop70-basket-label"><span>地板</span><span>材質</span></span>';

    pop.innerHTML='<div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:900;color:#8d979f;margin:2px 4px 4px">選擇地板材質</div>'+MATS.map(function(m){return '<button type="button" class="laibe-mat-opt" style="text-align:left;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);color:#f4f7f8;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer">'+m+'</button>';}).join("");
    document.body.appendChild(pop);
    btn.addEventListener("click",function(){ var r=btn.getBoundingClientRect(); pop.style.left=(r.right+8)+"px"; pop.style.top=r.top+"px"; pop.style.display=pop.style.display==="flex"?"none":"flex"; });
    pop.addEventListener("click",function(e){ var o=e.target.closest(".laibe-mat-opt"); if(!o)return; var sel=document.getElementById("canvas-furniture-material"); pop.style.display="none";
      var t=document.createElement("div"); t.textContent="已選地板材質："+o.textContent+"（點畫布空間套用）"; t.style.cssText="position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:80px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:200;background:rgba(18,22,26,.96);color:#f4f7f8;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:12px;padding:11px 17px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5)"; document.body.appendChild(t); setTimeout(function(){t.remove();},2400);
      var st=document.querySelector("#laibe-stepstrip .lstep[data-i=\"5\"]"); if(st){ document.querySelectorAll("#laibe-stepstrip .lstep").forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove("on");}); st.classList.add("on"); st.classList.add("checked"); var c=st.querySelector(".opt"); if(c)c.textContent="\u2611"; }
    });
    document.addEventListener("click",function(e){ if(!pop.contains(e.target)&&e.target!==btn&&!btn.contains(e.target)) pop.style.display="none"; });
    return true;
  }
  if(!build()){ var n=0,iv=setInterval(function(){ n++; if(build()||n>40) clearInterval(iv); },200); }
})();
