    (function markCommon(){
      function mark(){ var ts=document.querySelectorAll('.loop70-basket-trigger'); for(var i=0;i<ts.length;i++){ var t=(ts[i].textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,''); if(t.indexOf('常用')>-1 && ts[i].id!=='laibeMatTool'){ ts[i].classList.add('laibe-hide-basket'); } } }
      mark(); setInterval(mark,800);
    })();
    (function guardCommonPanel(){
      function panelEl(){ return document.getElementById('loop70ToolBasketPanel')||document.querySelector('.loop70-tool-basket-panel'); }
      function isCommon(panel){ var t=panel.querySelector('[data-loop70-panel-title]'); return !!(t && (t.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,'').indexOf('常用')>-1); }
      function hideIfCommon(){
        var panel=panelEl(); if(!panel) return;
        if(panel.getAttribute('aria-hidden')==='true') return;
        if(isCommon(panel)){
          var close=panel.querySelector('[data-loop70-panel-close]');
          if(close){ close.click(); }
          else { panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); }
          var g=document.querySelector('.loop70-rail-group[data-loop70-rail-group="common"]');
          if(g) g.classList.remove('is-open');
        }
      }
      var attached=false;
      function attach(){
        var panel=panelEl(); if(!panel||attached) return;
        attached=true;
        new MutationObserver(hideIfCommon).observe(panel,{attributes:true,childList:true,subtree:true});
        hideIfCommon();
      }
      attach();
      setInterval(function(){ attach(); hideIfCommon(); },150);
    })();
    /* 尺寸／備註：按下後切到右側「總覽」分頁，並收掉工具籃讓結果可見 */
    (function inspectorBasketClose(){
      document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){
        var btn=ev.target&&ev.target.closest?ev.target.closest('button[data-action="set-inspector-tab"]'):null;
        if(!btn) return;
        var panel=document.getElementById('loop70ToolBasketPanel')||document.querySelector('.loop70-tool-basket-panel');
        if(!panel||!panel.contains(btn)) return;
        setTimeout(function(){
          var close=panel.querySelector('[data-loop70-panel-close]');
          if(close){ close.click(); } else { panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); }
          document.querySelectorAll('.loop70-rail-group.is-open').forEach(function(g){ g.classList.remove('is-open'); });
        },20);
      },false);
    })();
    /* ====== 「標註」工具：在圖面上點兩點，畫出紅色尺寸標註（類 AutoCAD 線性標註） ====== */
    (function closeBasketAfterPlacementChoice(){
      function closePanel(panel){
        if(!panel) return;
        var close=panel.querySelector('[data-loop70-panel-close]');
        if(close){ close.click(); }
        else {
          panel.classList.remove('is-open','is-collapsed');
          panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
        }
        document.querySelectorAll('.loop70-rail-group.is-open').forEach(function(group){
          group.classList.remove('is-open');
        });
      }
      document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){
        var target=ev.target&&ev.target.closest?ev.target.closest(
          '#loop70ToolBasketPanel [data-action="select-furniture-template"],'+
          '#loop70ToolBasketPanel [data-action="select-svg-block-template"],'+
          '#loop70ToolBasketPanel [data-action="start-place-furniture"]'
        ):null;
        if(!target) return;
        var panel=document.getElementById('loop70ToolBasketPanel')||document.querySelector('.loop70-tool-basket-panel');
        window.setTimeout(function(){
          var state=window.laibePlancraftPlusUiState||{};
          if(state.mode==='place-furniture') closePanel(panel);
        },20);
      },false);
    })();
    (function laibeDimTool(){
      var SVGNS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
      var canvas=document.getElementById('planCanvas');
      if(!canvas) return;
      var SNAP_R=14, ORTHO_R=9;
      var layer=null, dimMode=false, stage=0, p1=null, p2=null, anns=[], seq=0, suppressOff=false;
      function ensureLayer(){
        if(layer&&layer.isConnected) return layer;
        layer=document.createElementNS(SVGNS,'svg');
        layer.id='laibeDimLayer'; layer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
        canvas.appendChild(layer);
        return layer;
      }
      function pan(){ return {x:Number(canvas.dataset.panX||0)||0, y:Number(canvas.dataset.panY||0)||0}; }
      function viewZoom(){
        var z=1;
        try{ if(window.laibePlanGetViewZoom) z=Number(window.laibePlanGetViewZoom()); }catch(e){}
        if(!isFinite(z)||z<=0){
          try{ z=Number(getComputedStyle(canvas).getPropertyValue('--canvas-view-zoom'))||1; }catch(e2){ z=1; }
        }
        return (isFinite(z)&&z>0)?z:1;
      }
      function clientPoint(x,y){
        var r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), pn=pan(), z=viewZoom();
        return {x:(x-r.left-pn.x)/z, y:(y-r.top-pn.y)/z};
      }
      function pt(ev){ var p=clientPoint(ev.clientX,ev.clientY); return {x:Math.round(p.x), y:Math.round(p.y)}; }
      function scale(){ var s=window.laibePlanScale||{}; return (s.pxPerMm&&isFinite(s.pxPerMm)&&s.pxPerMm>0)?s.pxPerMm:null; }
      function fmtMm(mm){ var v=Math.round(mm); return v.toLocaleString('en-US')+' mm'; }
      function toast(msg){ try{ var t=document.createElement('div'); t.textContent=msg; t.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:120px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:99999;background:rgba(18,22,28,.96);color:#ffd9c7;border:1px solid rgba(235,88,30,.5);padding:9px 16px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.45)'; document.body.appendChild(t); setTimeout(function(){t.remove();},2200); }catch(e){} }
      // ---- snapping: gather rendered geometry endpoints (same unpanned canvas space) ----
      function collectSnaps(){
        var pts=[], i;
        function add(x,y,kind,id){
          x=Number(x); y=Number(y);
          if(isFinite(x)&&isFinite(y)) pts.push({x:x,y:y,kind:kind||'',id:id||''});
        }
        function addBox(left,top,right,bottom,kind,id){
          if(!isFinite(left)||!isFinite(top)||!isFinite(right)||!isFinite(bottom)) return;
          var cx=(left+right)/2, cy=(top+bottom)/2;
          add(left,top,kind,id); add(right,top,kind,id); add(right,bottom,kind,id); add(left,bottom,kind,id);
          add(cx,top,kind,id); add(right,cy,kind,id); add(cx,bottom,kind,id); add(left,cy,kind,id); add(cx,cy,kind,id);
        }
        function addDomBox(el,kind){
          var r=el.getBoundingClientRect(), a=clientPoint(r.left,r.top), b=clientPoint(r.right,r.bottom);
          addBox(a.x,a.y,b.x,b.y,kind,el.getAttribute('data-furniture-id')||el.getAttribute('data-structure-id')||el.getAttribute('data-opening-id')||el.getAttribute('data-wall-id')||'');
        }
        function addLineNode(l,kind){
          var x1=+l.getAttribute('x1'), y1=+l.getAttribute('y1'), x2=+l.getAttribute('x2'), y2=+l.getAttribute('y2');
          add(x1,y1,kind,l.getAttribute('data-wall-id')||l.getAttribute('data-opening-id')||l.getAttribute('data-structure-id')||'');
          add(x2,y2,kind,l.getAttribute('data-wall-id')||l.getAttribute('data-opening-id')||l.getAttribute('data-structure-id')||'');
          add((x1+x2)/2,(y1+y2)/2,kind,l.getAttribute('data-wall-id')||l.getAttribute('data-opening-id')||l.getAttribute('data-structure-id')||'');
        }
        document.querySelectorAll('#wallLayer line,#openingLayer line,#structureLayer line').forEach(function(l){
          addLineNode(l,l.getAttribute('data-wall-id')?'wall':l.getAttribute('data-opening-id')?'opening':l.getAttribute('data-structure-id')?'structure':'svg-line');
        });
        document.querySelectorAll('#wallLayer circle,#openingLayer circle').forEach(function(c){
          add(+c.getAttribute('cx'),+c.getAttribute('cy'),c.getAttribute('data-opening-id')?'opening':'svg-circle',c.getAttribute('data-opening-id')||c.getAttribute('data-structure-id')||'');
        });
        document.querySelectorAll('#wallLayer rect,#openingLayer rect,#structureLayer rect').forEach(function(r){
          var x=+r.getAttribute('x'),y=+r.getAttribute('y'),w=+r.getAttribute('width'),h=+r.getAttribute('height');
          if(isFinite(x)&&isFinite(y)&&isFinite(w)&&isFinite(h)) addBox(x,y,x+w,y+h,r.getAttribute('data-structure-id')?'structure':'svg-rect',r.getAttribute('data-structure-id')||'');
        });
        document.querySelectorAll('#wallLayer ellipse,#openingLayer ellipse,#structureLayer ellipse').forEach(function(e){
          var cx=+e.getAttribute('cx'),cy=+e.getAttribute('cy'),rx=+e.getAttribute('rx'),ry=+e.getAttribute('ry');
          if(isFinite(cx)&&isFinite(cy)){ add(cx,cy,'structure',e.getAttribute('data-structure-id')||''); if(isFinite(rx)&&isFinite(ry)){ addBox(cx-rx,cy-ry,cx+rx,cy+ry,'structure',e.getAttribute('data-structure-id')||''); add(cx-rx,cy,'structure',e.getAttribute('data-structure-id')||''); add(cx+rx,cy,'structure',e.getAttribute('data-structure-id')||''); add(cx,cy-ry,'structure',e.getAttribute('data-structure-id')||''); add(cx,cy+ry,'structure',e.getAttribute('data-structure-id')||''); } }
        });
        document.querySelectorAll('#wallLayer polygon,#wallLayer polyline,#openingLayer polygon,#openingLayer polyline,#structureLayer polygon,#structureLayer polyline').forEach(function(pg){
          var raw=(pg.getAttribute('points')||'').trim().split(/\s+/), xs=[], ys=[];
          raw.forEach(function(pair){ var xy=pair.split(','); if(xy.length===2){ var x=+xy[0],y=+xy[1]; if(isFinite(x)&&isFinite(y)){ add(x,y,'structure',pg.getAttribute('data-structure-id')||''); xs.push(x); ys.push(y); } } });
          if(xs.length){ addBox(Math.min.apply(null,xs),Math.min.apply(null,ys),Math.max.apply(null,xs),Math.max.apply(null,ys),'structure',pg.getAttribute('data-structure-id')||''); }
        });
        document.querySelectorAll('#zonePolygonLayer polygon,#zonePolygonLayer polyline').forEach(function(pg){
          var raw=(pg.getAttribute('points')||'').trim().split(/\s+/);
          raw.forEach(function(pair){ var xy=pair.split(','); if(xy.length===2){ var x=+xy[0],y=+xy[1]; add(x,y,'zone',''); } });
        });
        var usedRuntimeFurnitureSnap=false;
        try{
          if(typeof window.laibePlanGetFurnitureSnapPoints==='function'){
            var furniturePts=window.laibePlanGetFurnitureSnapPoints({unit:'px'});
            if(Array.isArray(furniturePts)){
              furniturePts.forEach(function(p){ add(p.x,p.y,p.kind||'furniture',p.id||''); });
              usedRuntimeFurnitureSnap=true;
            }
          }
        }catch(e){}
        if(!usedRuntimeFurnitureSnap){
          canvas.querySelectorAll('.furniture-item').forEach(function(el){
            addDomBox(el,el.classList.contains('has-svg-block-preview')?'svg-block-furniture':'furniture');
          });
        }
        return pts.filter(function(p){return isFinite(p.x)&&isFinite(p.y);});
      }
      function snapPoint(p,base){
        // 1) nearest rendered endpoint
        var cands=collectSnaps(), best=null, bestD=SNAP_R;
        for(var i=0;i<cands.length;i++){ var d=Math.hypot(cands[i].x-p.x,cands[i].y-p.y); if(d<bestD){ bestD=d; best=cands[i]; } }
        if(best) return {x:best.x,y:best.y,snapped:true};
        // 2) ortho-lock relative to base (first point) for clean H/V measures
        if(base){
          var ax=Math.abs(p.x-base.x), ay=Math.abs(p.y-base.y);
          if(ay<=ORTHO_R && ax>ay) return {x:p.x,y:base.y,snapped:false,ortho:true};
          if(ax<=ORTHO_R && ay>ax) return {x:base.x,y:p.y,snapped:false,ortho:true};
        }
        return {x:p.x,y:p.y,snapped:false};
      }
      function clearPreview(){ if(!layer) return; layer.querySelectorAll('.laibe-dim-preview').forEach(function(n){n.remove();}); }
      function arrow(x1,y1,x2,y2){
        var a=Math.atan2(y2-y1,x2-x1), len=11, w=4.2;
        var ax1=x2-len*Math.cos(a)+w*Math.sin(a), ay1=y2-len*Math.sin(a)-w*Math.cos(a);
        var ax2=x2-len*Math.cos(a)-w*Math.sin(a), ay2=y2-len*Math.sin(a)+w*Math.cos(a);
        var p=document.createElementNS(SVGNS,'path');
        p.setAttribute('d','M'+x2+' '+y2+'L'+ax1+' '+ay1+'L'+ax2+' '+ay2+'Z');
        p.setAttribute('fill','#ff3b30'); return p;
      }
      function line(x1,y1,x2,y2,w){ var l=document.createElementNS(SVGNS,'line'); l.setAttribute('x1',x1);l.setAttribute('y1',y1);l.setAttribute('x2',x2);l.setAttribute('y2',y2); l.setAttribute('stroke','#ff3b30'); l.setAttribute('stroke-width',w||1.6); l.setAttribute('stroke-linecap','round'); return l; }
      function snapMarker(sp){
        if(sp.snapped){ var r=document.createElementNS(SVGNS,'rect'); r.setAttribute('x',sp.x-6);r.setAttribute('y',sp.y-6);r.setAttribute('width',12);r.setAttribute('height',12); r.setAttribute('fill','none');r.setAttribute('stroke','#79d8ff');r.setAttribute('stroke-width','2'); return r; }
        var c=document.createElementNS(SVGNS,'circle'); c.setAttribute('cx',sp.x);c.setAttribute('cy',sp.y);c.setAttribute('r',3.4); c.setAttribute('fill', sp.ortho?'#ffd166':'#ff3b30'); return c;
      }
      function buildDim(rec,opts){
        opts=opts||{};
        var a=rec.a, b=rec.b, off=Number(rec.offset)||0;
        var g=document.createElementNS(SVGNS,'g'); g.setAttribute('class',opts.preview?'laibe-dim-preview':'laibe-dim');
        var dx=b.x-a.x, dy=b.y-a.y, L=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1; var nx=-dy/L, ny=dx/L;
        var dir = off>=0?1:-1, gap=2, over=9;
        var ax=a.x+nx*off, ay=a.y+ny*off, bx=b.x+nx*off, by=b.y+ny*off;
        g.appendChild(line(a.x+nx*dir*gap, a.y+ny*dir*gap, ax+nx*dir*over, ay+ny*dir*over, 1.4));
        g.appendChild(line(b.x+nx*dir*gap, b.y+ny*dir*gap, bx+nx*dir*over, by+ny*dir*over, 1.4));
        g.appendChild(line(ax,ay,bx,by,1.8));
        g.appendChild(arrow(bx,by,ax,ay));
        g.appendChild(arrow(ax,ay,bx,by));
        var sc=scale(); var label= sc? fmtMm(L/sc) : Math.round(L)+' px';
        var mx=(ax+bx)/2, my=(ay+by)/2;
        var ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx)*180/Math.PI; if(ang>90)ang-=180; if(ang<-90)ang+=180;
        var loX=nx*14, loY=ny*14; if(loY>0){loX=-loX;loY=-loY;}
        var t=document.createElementNS(SVGNS,'text');
        t.setAttribute('x',mx+loX); t.setAttribute('y',my+loY);
        t.setAttribute('fill','#ff3b30'); t.setAttribute('font-size','14'); t.setAttribute('font-weight','800');
        t.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle'); t.setAttribute('dominant-baseline','middle');
        t.setAttribute('transform','rotate('+ang+' '+(mx+loX)+' '+(my+loY)+')');
        t.setAttribute('paint-order','stroke'); t.setAttribute('stroke','rgba(8,11,16,.85)'); t.setAttribute('stroke-width','3');
        t.textContent=label; g.appendChild(t);
        if(!opts.preview){
          g.dataset.dimId=rec.id;
          var cx=mx+loX + (label.length*4+22), cy=my+loY;
          var del=document.createElementNS(SVGNS,'g'); del.setAttribute('class','laibe-dim-del');
          var c=document.createElementNS(SVGNS,'circle'); c.setAttribute('cx',cx);c.setAttribute('cy',cy);c.setAttribute('r',8); c.setAttribute('fill','rgba(18,22,28,.92)'); c.setAttribute('stroke','#ff3b30'); c.setAttribute('stroke-width','1.2');
          var xx=document.createElementNS(SVGNS,'text'); xx.setAttribute('x',cx);xx.setAttribute('y',cy+0.5); xx.setAttribute('fill','#ff8a7a');xx.setAttribute('font-size','11');xx.setAttribute('font-weight','800');xx.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');xx.setAttribute('dominant-baseline','middle'); xx.textContent='×';
          del.appendChild(c); del.appendChild(xx);
          del.addEventListener('click',function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); removeAnn(rec.id); });
          g.appendChild(del);
        }
        return g;
      }
      function offsetFromCursor(a,b,cur){
        var dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,L=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1, nx=-dy/L, ny=dx/L;
        var mx=(a.x+b.x)/2,my=(a.y+b.y)/2;
        return (cur.x-mx)*nx+(cur.y-my)*ny;
      }
      function renderAll(){
        if(!layer) return;
        layer.querySelectorAll('.laibe-dim').forEach(function(n){ n.remove(); });
        anns.forEach(function(rec){ layer.appendChild(buildDim(rec,{})); });
      }
      function removeAnn(id){ anns=anns.filter(function(r){ return r.id!==id; }); renderAll(); }
      function resetDraft(){ stage=0; p1=null; p2=null; clearPreview(); }
      function setMode(on){
        dimMode=!!on; document.body.classList.toggle('laibe-dim-on',dimMode);
        if(!dimMode){ resetDraft(); } else { ensureLayer(); resetDraft(); var sb=document.querySelector('[data-action="set-select-mode"]'); if(sb){ suppressOff=true; sb.click(); suppressOff=false; } toast('標註：點第一點（靠近牆角會自動吸附）'); }
        var btn=document.querySelector('.laibe-dim-btn'); if(btn) btn.classList.toggle('is-mode-active',dimMode);
      }
      // ---- click flow: p1 -> p2 -> offset confirm ----
      function onCanvasSurface(ev){
        if(!ev.target||!ev.target.closest) return false;
        if(!canvas.contains(ev.target)) return false;
        var btn=ev.target.closest('button');
        if(btn && !btn.classList.contains('furniture-item')) return false;
        if(ev.target.closest('#laibeTopTools, a, input, select, textarea, [data-action], .loop70-basket-trigger, .laibe-dim-del, [data-loop70-panel-close]')) return false;
        return true;
      }
      document.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(ev){
        if(!dimMode||ev.button!==0) return;
        if(!onCanvasSurface(ev)) return;
        ev.stopImmediatePropagation(); ev.preventDefault();
        var sc=scale(); if(!sc){ toast('請先用「測量」設定比例，才能標註尺寸'); return; }
        var raw=pt(ev);
        if(stage===0){ var s0=snapPoint(raw,null); p1={x:s0.x,y:s0.y}; stage=1; clearPreview(); toast('點第二點'); return; }
        if(stage===1){ if(!p1){ resetDraft(); return; } var s1=snapPoint(raw,p1); p2={x:s1.x,y:s1.y}; stage=2; clearPreview(); toast('移動滑鼠拉出延伸線，再點一下確定'); return; }
        if(stage===2){ if(!p1||!p2){ resetDraft(); return; } ensureLayer(); var off=offsetFromCursor(p1,p2,raw); anns.push({id:++seq,a:p1,b:p2,offset:off}); resetDraft(); renderAll(); toast('已建立標註'); return; }
      },true);
      document.addEventListener('pointermove',function(ev){
        if(!dimMode) return;
        if(!onCanvasSurface(ev)){ clearPreview(); return; }
        ev.stopImmediatePropagation();
        var raw=pt(ev); ensureLayer(); clearPreview();
        if(stage===0){ var s0=snapPoint(raw,null); var m0=snapMarker(s0); m0.setAttribute('class','laibe-dim-preview'); layer.appendChild(m0); return; }
        if(stage===1){ if(!p1){ resetDraft(); return; } var s1=snapPoint(raw,p1); var pv=buildDim({a:p1,b:{x:s1.x,y:s1.y},offset:0},{preview:true}); pv.appendChild(snapMarker(s1)); layer.appendChild(pv); return; }
        if(stage===2){ if(!p1||!p2){ resetDraft(); return; } var off=offsetFromCursor(p1,p2,raw); layer.appendChild(buildDim({a:p1,b:p2,offset:off},{preview:true})); return; }
      },true);
      document.addEventListener('keydown',function(ev){
        if(ev.key!=='Escape'||!dimMode) return;
        ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation(); if(ev.stopImmediatePropagation) ev.stopImmediatePropagation();
        if(stage>0){ resetDraft(); toast('已取消尺寸標註'); return; }
        setMode(false);
      },true);
      document.addEventListener('pointercancel',function(){ if(dimMode) resetDraft(); },true);
      window.addEventListener('blur',function(){ if(dimMode) resetDraft(); });
      // relabel the basket 尺寸 button → 標註, and intercept its click
      function relabel(){
        var nodes=document.querySelectorAll('#loop70ToolBasketPanel button, .loop70-rail-group button');
        nodes.forEach(function(b){
          var tx=(b.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,'');
          if(tx.indexOf('查看候選尺寸摘要')>-1 && !b.classList.contains('laibe-dim-btn')){
            b.classList.add('laibe-dim-btn');
            b.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(function(el){
              if(el.children.length===0){ var t=(el.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,''); if(t.indexOf('尺寸')>-1&&t.indexOf('顯示')<0&&t.length<6) el.textContent='標註'; if(t.indexOf('查看候選尺寸摘要')>-1) el.textContent='點兩點量測，可吸附牆角'; }
            });
          }
        });
      }
      setInterval(relabel,500); relabel();
      document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){
        var b=ev.target&&ev.target.closest?ev.target.closest('.laibe-dim-btn'):null;
        if(b){
          ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation();
          setMode(true);
          var panel=document.getElementById('loop70ToolBasketPanel')||document.querySelector('.loop70-tool-basket-panel');
          if(panel){ var close=panel.querySelector('[data-loop70-panel-close]'); if(close) close.click(); else panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); document.querySelectorAll('.loop70-rail-group.is-open').forEach(function(g){g.classList.remove('is-open');}); }
          return;
        }
        var other=ev.target&&ev.target.closest?ev.target.closest('[data-action],[data-mode-button],#laibeTopTools button,.loop70-basket-trigger'):null;
        if(other&&dimMode&&!suppressOff) setMode(false);
      },true);
      window.laibeDimSetMode=setMode;
    })();
    var bar=document.createElement("div"); bar.id="laibeTopTools";
    var grpNav=document.createElement("div"); grpNav.className="laibe-tt-group"; grpNav.setAttribute("aria-label","畫布導覽工具");
    var grpEdit=document.createElement("div"); grpEdit.className="laibe-tt-group"; grpEdit.setAttribute("aria-label","編輯工具");
    var defs=[
      {g:"nav",k:"move",ic:SVG.move,t:"移動畫布（平移；圖面物件一起移動）",mode:1,fn:function(){ if(!basketClick(["手掌","拖曳移動","拖曳畫"])) clickAction("pan-canvas"); }},
      {g:"nav",k:"zoom",ic:SVG.zoompm,t:"放大縮小（滑鼠滾輪，或 Ctrl + / Ctrl −）",lbl:"100%",fn:function(){ if(window.laibePlanStepViewZoom) window.laibePlanStepViewZoom(1); updZoom(); },rfn:function(){ if(window.laibePlanStepViewZoom) window.laibePlanStepViewZoom(-1); updZoom(); }},
      {g:"nav",k:"fitfill",ic:SVG.fitwin,t:"充滿視窗（置中並縮放到看得見全圖）",lbl:"充滿視窗",fn:function(){ var done=window.laibePlanFitContent&&window.laibePlanFitContent(); if(!done){ if(window.laibePlanViewZoom) window.laibePlanViewZoom(1); clickAction("fit-underlay-view"); } updZoom(); }},
      {g:"nav",k:"cal",ic:SVG.cal,t:"校正比例（設定底圖真實尺寸）",lbl:"校正比例",fn:function(){ clickAction("start-calibration"); }},
      {g:"nav",k:"gscale",ic:'<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="15 3 21 3 21 9"></polyline><polyline points="9 21 3 21 3 15"></polyline><line x1="21" y1="3" x2="14" y2="10"></line><line x1="3" y1="21" x2="10" y2="14"></line></svg>',t:"比例縮放（點兩點、輸入實際尺寸，把整張匯入圖依比例整體縮放到真實大小）",lbl:"比例縮放",mode:1,fn:function(){ if(window.laibePlanStartPlanScale) window.laibePlanStartPlanScale(); }},
      {g:"nav",k:"snap",ic:SVG.snap,t:"鎖點",toggle:"object-snap",fn:function(){ if(window.laibePlanToggleObjectSnap){ window.laibePlanToggleObjectSnap(); return; } clickAction("toggle-object-snap"); }},
      {g:"nav",k:"ortho",ic:SVG.ortho,t:"正交",toggle:"orthogonal",fn:function(){ if(window.laibePlanToggleOrthogonal){ window.laibePlanToggleOrthogonal(); return; } clickAction("toggle-orthogonal"); }},
      {g:"edit",k:"rotcw",ic:SVG.rotcw,t:"圖面旋轉（每次向右 90°，左下角對齊原點）",fn:function(){ if(window.laibePlanRotateUnderlay) window.laibePlanRotateUnderlay(); updZoom(); }},
      {g:"edit",k:"select",ic:SVG.select,t:"選取",mode:1,fn:function(){ clickAction("set-select-mode"); }},
      {g:"edit",k:"moveObj",ic:SVG.moveObj,t:"移動物件（選取後拖曳）",mode:1,fn:function(){ clickAction("set-select-mode"); }},
      {g:"edit",k:"group",ic:'<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"></rect><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"></rect><rect x="8.5" y="13" width="7" height="7" rx="1"></rect></svg>',t:"群組化（把目前所有物件組成一組，選取模式下可整體拖曳移動）",fn:function(){ if(window.laibePlanGroupAll){ window.laibePlanGroupAll(); } }},
      {g:"edit",k:"ungroup",ic:'<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="4" width="6" height="6" rx="1"></rect><rect x="15" y="14" width="6" height="6" rx="1" stroke-dasharray="2 2"></rect></svg>',t:"取消群組（還原個別編輯）",fn:function(){ if(window.laibePlanUngroupAll) window.laibePlanUngroupAll(); }},
      {g:"edit",k:"copy",ic:SVG.copy,t:"複製（Ctrl+C）",fn:function(){ if(window.laibePlanCopySelection) window.laibePlanCopySelection(); else clickAction("duplicate-current-selection"); }},
      {g:"edit",k:"paste",ic:SVG.copy,t:"貼上（Ctrl+V）",fn:function(){ if(window.laibePlanPasteSelection) window.laibePlanPasteSelection(); }},
      {g:"edit",k:"del",ic:SVG.del,t:"刪除",danger:1,fn:function(){ clickAction("delete-current-selection"); }},
      {g:"edit",sep:1},
      {g:"edit",k:"undo",ic:SVG.undo,t:"復原",fn:function(){ clickAction("undo-action"); }},
      {g:"edit",k:"redo",ic:SVG.redo,t:"重做",fn:function(){ clickAction("redo-action"); }}
    ];
    defs = defs.filter(function(d){ return d.k !== "select"; });
    function updZoom(){ var sp=bar.querySelector('[data-zoomlbl]'); if(sp){ var z=(window.laibePlanGetViewZoom?window.laibePlanGetViewZoom():1); sp.textContent=Math.round(z*100)+'%'; } }
    // 讀取引擎的正交/鎖點狀態；引擎不可用時退回舊的 [data-toggle-button] 查法
    function toggleFlagOn(key, fallback){
      try{
        if(window.laibePlanGetDrawFlags){
          var f=window.laibePlanGetDrawFlags();
          if(key==="orthogonal") return !!f.orthogonal;
          if(key==="object-snap") return !!f.snap;
        }
      }catch(e){}
      var src=document.querySelector('[data-toggle-button="'+key+'"]');
      return src?src.getAttribute("aria-pressed")==="true":!!fallback;
    }
    var modeBtns=[];
    var toggleBtns=[];
    defs.forEach(function(d){
      var parent=d.g==="nav"?grpNav:grpEdit;
      if(d.sep){ var s=document.createElement("span"); s.className="sep"; parent.appendChild(s); return; }
      var b=document.createElement("button"); b.type="button"; b.title=d.t; b.setAttribute("aria-label",d.t);
      b.innerHTML=d.ic+(d.lbl?'<span style="margin-left:5px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800">'+d.lbl+'</span>':''); if(d.lbl) b.classList.add('haslbl'); if(d.danger) b.className="danger";
      if(d.k==="zoom"){ var zl=b.querySelector('span'); if(zl) zl.setAttribute('data-zoomlbl','1'); }
      if(d.rfn){ b.addEventListener("contextmenu",function(e){ e.preventDefault(); d.rfn(); }); }
      b.addEventListener("click",function(){
        d.fn();
        if(d.mode){ modeBtns.forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove("on");}); b.classList.add("on"); }
        if(d.toggle){ setTimeout(function(){ b.classList.toggle("on", toggleFlagOn(d.toggle, !b.classList.contains("on"))); },30); }
      });
      if(d.mode) modeBtns.push(b);
      if(d.toggle){ toggleBtns.push({btn:b,key:d.toggle}); if(toggleFlagOn(d.toggle, false)) b.classList.add("on"); }
      parent.appendChild(b);
    });
    bar.appendChild(grpNav); bar.appendChild(grpEdit);
    canvas.appendChild(bar);
    // 引擎載入完成後補同步一次正交/鎖點的亮燈狀態（plan-puzzle.js 為 defer 載入）
    (function syncToggleStates(n){
      var ready = typeof window.laibePlanGetDrawFlags === "function";
      toggleBtns.forEach(function(x){ x.btn.classList.toggle("on", toggleFlagOn(x.key, x.btn.classList.contains("on"))); });
      if(ready) updZoom();
      if(!ready && n < 40) setTimeout(function(){ syncToggleStates(n+1); }, 250);
    })(0);
    if(!window.__laibeCopyPasteKeys){
      window.__laibeCopyPasteKeys=true;
      document.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){
        var t=e.target, a=document.activeElement;
        function isEdit(el){ return el&&(el.tagName==="INPUT"||el.tagName==="SELECT"||el.tagName==="TEXTAREA"||el.isContentEditable); }
        if(isEdit(t)||isEdit(a)) return;
        if(!(e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)) return;
        var k=(e.key||"").toLowerCase();
        if(k==="c"){ if(window.laibePlanCopySelection&&window.laibePlanCopySelection()) e.preventDefault(); }
        else if(k==="v"){ if(window.laibePlanPasteSelection&&window.laibePlanPasteSelection()) e.preventDefault(); }
      });
    }
    // 地板材質工具改為常駐左側工具欄（不再搬到頂部列）
    return true;
  }
  if(!build()){ var n=0,iv=setInterval(function(){ n++; if(build()||n>50) clearInterval(iv); },200); }
})();
</script>
<script id="laibe-step-tool-link">
(function(){
  var MAP={1:"drawing",2:"drawing",3:"annotation-measure",4:"movable-furniture",5:"floor-material"};
  function injectCSS(){
    if(document.getElementById("laibe-glow-css")) return;
    var st=document.createElement("style"); st.id="laibe-glow-css";
    st.textContent=".laibe-tool-glow{position:relative}"
      +".laibe-tool-glow::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:2px;border-radius:11px;border:2px solid rgba(235,88,30,.85);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(235,88,30,.55),inset 0 0 8px rgba(235,88,30,.35);pointer-events:none;z-index:6;animation:laibeGlow 1.15s ease-in-out infinite}"
      +"@keyframes laibeGlow{0%,100%{opacity:.5}50%{opacity:1}}"
      +"#laibe-stepstrip .lstep{cursor:pointer}"
      +"#laibe-stepstrip .lstep.on{color:#ffd6a8}";
    document.head.appendChild(st);
  }
  function clearGlow(){ document.querySelectorAll(".laibe-tool-glow").forEach(function(e){e.classList.remove("laibe-tool-glow");}); }
  function importBtn(){ return [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".file-area-actions button, .file-area-actions a")).find(function(b){return /匯入底圖/.test(b.textContent||"");}); }
  function planSelect(){
    var lab=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("*")).find(function(e){return e.children.length<3 && /目前圖種/.test((e.textContent||""))&&!/繪製步驟/.test(e.textContent||"");});
    var sel=document.querySelector(".designer-panel select, aside select, .panel-body select");
    return sel|| (lab?lab.parentElement.querySelector("select"):null);
  }
  function glowFor(i){
    clearGlow();
    var grp=MAP[i];
    if(grp){
      var sec=document.querySelector('section[data-loop70-rail-group="'+grp+'"]');
      var t=sec?sec.querySelector(".loop70-basket-trigger"):document.querySelector('[data-loop70-basket-trigger="'+grp+'"]');
      if(grp==="floor-material") t=document.getElementById("laibeMatTool")||t;
      if(t) t.classList.add("laibe-tool-glow");
    } else if(i===0){ var ib=importBtn(); if(ib) ib.classList.add("laibe-tool-glow"); }
    else if(i===6){ var ps=planSelect(); if(ps){ var card=ps.closest(".status-card")||ps; card.classList.add("laibe-tool-glow"); } }
  }
  function wire(){
    var strip=document.getElementById("laibe-stepstrip");
    if(!strip) return false;
    strip.querySelectorAll(".lstep").forEach(function(s){
      if(s.getAttribute("data-glow-bound")) return;
      s.setAttribute("data-glow-bound","1");
      s.addEventListener("click",function(){
        strip.querySelectorAll(".lstep").forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove("on");});
        s.classList.add("on");
        glowFor(parseInt(s.getAttribute("data-i"),10));
      });
    });
    return true;
  }
  injectCSS();
  if(!wire()){ var n=0,iv=setInterval(function(){ n++; if(wire()||n>50) clearInterval(iv); },200); }
})();
</script>

      }catch(error){
        if(r7D3Expired)return;
        r7D3Finish("d3_execution_error","error",{terminalCategory:"d3_execution_error",error:r7D3Error(error)});
      }
    })();
  }
}
</script>
<script id="laibe-pdf-import">
(function(){
  function setWorker(){
    if(window.pdfjsLib){ try{ pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc=new URL("./vendor/pdfjs/pdf.worker.mjs", location.href).href; }catch(e){} return true; }
    return false;
  }
   if(!setWorker()){ var w=0,wv=setInterval(function(){ w++; if(setWorker()||w>60) clearInterval(wv); },150); }
   // The governed Plan Puzzle importer owns PDF selection. The historical Stage 1 bridge remains inert.
   return;

  function toast(msg, ok){
    var t=document.getElementById("laibe-pdf-toast");
    if(!t){ t=document.createElement("div"); t.id="laibe-pdf-toast";
      t.style.cssText="position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:9999;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;font:600 13px/1.4 system-ui,'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif;color:#fff;background:rgba(12,16,20,.92);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.4);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)";
      document.body.appendChild(t); }
    t.style.borderColor=ok?"rgba(98,230,200,.5)":"rgba(235,88,30,.5)";
    t.textContent=msg; t.style.opacity="1";
    clearTimeout(t.__h); t.__h=setTimeout(function(){ t.style.opacity="0"; },2600);
    t.style.transition="opacity .3s ease";
  }

  function findInput(){ return document.getElementById("planImportInput"); }

  var STAGE1_EXPECTED_PACKET_PATH="";
  var STAGE1_BASELINE_HASHES=Object.freeze({});
  var stage1Receipts=[];
  var stage1RunId=window.__laibeStage1RunId || (window.__laibeStage1RunId=makeStage1Id("run"));
  var stage1TabId=getStage1TabId();

  function stage1Now(){ return new Date().toISOString(); }
  function makeStage1Id(prefix){
    var rand="";
    try{
      if(window.crypto && crypto.getRandomValues){
        var bytes=new Uint8Array(8); crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
        rand=Array.prototype.map.call(bytes,function(b){ return b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0"); }).join("");
      }
    }catch(e){}
    return prefix+"-"+Date.now().toString(36)+"-"+(rand || Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10));
  }
  function getStage1TabId(){
    var key="laibeStage1BrowserTabId";
    try{
      var existing=sessionStorage.getItem(key);
      if(existing) return existing;
      var next=makeStage1Id("tab");
      sessionStorage.setItem(key,next);
      return next;
    }catch(e){ return makeStage1Id("tab"); }
  }
  function deepFreezeStage1(value){
    if(!value || typeof value!=="object" || Object.isFrozen(value)) return value;
    Object.keys(value).forEach(function(k){ deepFreezeStage1(value[k]); });
    return Object.freeze(value);
  }
  function cloneStage1(value){
    try{ return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)); }catch(e){ return null; }
  }
  function bytesToHex(buffer){
    return Array.prototype.map.call(new Uint8Array(buffer),function(b){ return b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0"); }).join("").toUpperCase();
  }
  async function sha256Hex(buffer){
    if(!window.crypto || !crypto.subtle || !buffer) return null;
    return bytesToHex(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buffer));
  }
  async function fetchStage1Hash(relativeUrl){
    var absoluteUrl=new URL(relativeUrl, location.href).href;
    var entry={url:absoluteUrl,sha256:null,size:null,ok:false,error:null,capturedAt:stage1Now()};
    try{
      var response=await fetch(absoluteUrl,{cache:"no-store"});
      entry.status=response.status;
      if(!response.ok) throw new Error("fetch status "+response.status);
      var buffer=await response.arrayBuffer();
      entry.size=buffer.byteLength;
      entry.sha256=await sha256Hex(buffer);
      entry.ok=!!entry.sha256;
    }catch(err){ entry.error=err && err.message ? err.message : String(err); }
    return entry;
  }
  async function collectStage1RuntimeHashes(){
    var items=[
      ["codeHtml","code.html"],
      ["planPuzzleJs","plan-puzzle.js"],
      ["svgBlockLibraryJs","svg-block-library.js"],
      ["pdfPlanVectorExtractorJs","pdf-plan-vector-extractor.js"],
      ["sourcePdf","_qa_pdf_reference_3rf.pdf"]
    ];
    var out={capturedAt:stage1Now(),entries:{}};
    for(var i=0;i<items.length;i++){
      out.entries[items[i][0]]=await fetchStage1Hash(items[i][1]);
    }
    return out;
  }
  function exposeStage1ReceiptApi(){
    var api={
      getLatest:function(){ return stage1Receipts.length ? stage1Receipts[stage1Receipts.length-1] : null; },
      list:function(){ return stage1Receipts.slice(); }
    };
    try{ Object.defineProperty(window,"__laibeStage1ImportReceipt",{value:Object.freeze(api),configurable:true}); }
    catch(e){ window.__laibeStage1ImportReceipt=api; }
  }
  exposeStage1ReceiptApi();
  function mirrorStage1ReceiptForQa(receipt){
    if(!receipt) return;
    try{
      var el=document.getElementById("laibe-stage1-import-receipt-json");
      if(!el){
        el=document.createElement("script");
        el.type="application/json";
        el.id="laibe-stage1-import-receipt-json";
        (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(el);
      }
      el.dataset.importSessionId=receipt.importSessionId || "";
      el.dataset.status=receipt.status || "";
      el.textContent=JSON.stringify(receipt);
    }catch(e){}
  }
  async function createStage1PdfReceipt(file, buffer){
    var selectedHash=await sha256Hex(buffer);
    var lastModifiedIso=null;
    try{ lastModifiedIso=file && file.lastModified ? new Date(file.lastModified).toISOString() : null; }catch(e){}
    return {
      schema:"laibe-stage1-pdf-import-receipt-v1",
      stage:"A9_1_IMPORT_SESSION_RECEIPT_AND_MULTI_REGION_PREFLIGHT_20260716",
      noGeometryChangeAssertion:"Stage1 records immutable receipt and diagnostics only; it does not change extraction, classification, geometry, coordinates, transforms, promotion, object counts, UI layout, or product wording.",
      route:{href:location.href,origin:location.origin,pathname:location.pathname,search:location.search,hash:location.hash},
      run:{runId:stage1RunId,browserTabId:stage1TabId,userAgent:navigator.userAgent || null},
      importSessionId:makeStage1Id("import"),
      expectedPacketPath:STAGE1_EXPECTED_PACKET_PATH,
      file:{name:file.name,size:file.size,type:file.type || "",lastModified:file.lastModified || null,lastModifiedIso:lastModifiedIso},
      sourcePdf:{
        expectedPacketPath:STAGE1_EXPECTED_PACKET_PATH,
        expectedPacketSha256:STAGE1_BASELINE_HASHES.sourcePdf,
        selectedFileSha256:selectedHash,
        selectedFileMatchesExpectedPacket:selectedHash===STAGE1_BASELINE_HASHES.sourcePdf,
        browserExposesAbsolutePath:false,
        pageIndex:0,
        pageNumber:1
      },
      pdfjs:{available:!!window.pdfjsLib,loadSuccess:null,pageCount:null,page1LoadSuccess:null,error:null},
      sourcePage:{pageIndex:0,pageNumber:1,boundsPt:null,regions:[],multiRegionStatus:"not-observed"},
      acceptedTransformId:null,
      acceptedTransformStatus:"not-established",
      timestamps:{changeEvent:stage1Now(),fileArrayBufferReadCompleted:stage1Now(),receiptDraftCreated:stage1Now(),importerInvocation:null,transformAccepted:null,receiptFinalizationStarted:null,receiptFinalized:null},
      runtimeHashes:{preWrite:cloneStage1(STAGE1_BASELINE_HASHES),currentAtFinalization:null},
      importer:{invoked:false,method:null,payloadSummary:null,result:null,error:null},
      status:"draft",
      diagnostics:{}
    };
  }
  function textItemBBox(item){
    var tr=item && item.transform || [];
    var x=Number(tr[4]), y=Number(tr[5]);
    var w=Number(item && item.width) || 0;
    var h=Math.abs(Number(tr[3]) || Number(item && item.height) || 0);
    if(!Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(y)) return null;
    return {x:x,y:y,width:Math.max(1,w),height:Math.max(1,h),centerX:x+(Math.max(1,w)/2),centerY:y+(Math.max(1,h)/2)};
  }
  function regionFromHit(id,label,hit,bounds,method){
    return {sourceRegionId:id,label:label,pageIndex:0,pageNumber:1,observed:true,method:method,labelText:hit.text,labelBBoxPt:hit.bbox,boundsPt:bounds,localCoordinateFrame:"page-1-local-pt"};
  }
  async function collectStage1SourceRegions(receipt,page){
    if(!receipt || !page) return;
    var viewport=null;
    try{ viewport=page.getViewport({scale:1}); }catch(e){ viewport=null; }
    var fullBounds=viewport ? {x:0,y:0,width:viewport.width,height:viewport.height} : null;
    receipt.sourcePage.boundsPt=fullBounds;
    var regions=[{sourceRegionId:"page-1-full",label:"page-1-full",pageIndex:0,pageNumber:1,observed:true,method:"pdfjs-page-viewport",boundsPt:fullBounds,localCoordinateFrame:"page-1-local-pt"}];
    var hits={threeF:null,roofF:null};
    try{
      var text=await page.getTextContent();
      (text.items||[]).forEach(function(item){
        var s=String(item.str||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
        if(!s) return;
        var bbox=textItemBBox(item);
        if(!bbox) return;
        if(!hits.threeF && /(^|[^A-Z0-9])3\s*F([^A-Z0-9]|$)|3樓|三樓/i.test(s)) hits.threeF={text:s,bbox:bbox};
        if(!hits.roofF && /(^|[^A-Z0-9])R\s*F([^A-Z0-9]|$)|屋突|屋頂|roof/i.test(s)) hits.roofF={text:s,bbox:bbox};
      });
    }catch(err){ receipt.diagnostics.textRegionError=err && err.message ? err.message : String(err); }
    if(fullBounds && hits.threeF && hits.roofF){
      var splitVertical=Math.abs(hits.threeF.bbox.centerX-hits.roofF.bbox.centerX) >= Math.abs(hits.threeF.bbox.centerY-hits.roofF.bbox.centerY);
      if(splitVertical){
        var midX=(hits.threeF.bbox.centerX+hits.roofF.bbox.centerX)/2;
        var left={x:fullBounds.x,y:fullBounds.y,width:Math.max(1,midX-fullBounds.x),height:fullBounds.height};
        var right={x:midX,y:fullBounds.y,width:Math.max(1,fullBounds.x+fullBounds.width-midX),height:fullBounds.height};
        var threeBounds=hits.threeF.bbox.centerX <= hits.roofF.bbox.centerX ? left : right;
        var roofBounds=hits.threeF.bbox.centerX <= hits.roofF.bbox.centerX ? right : left;
        regions.push(regionFromHit("page-1-region-3f","3F",hits.threeF,threeBounds,"pdfjs-text-label-split-x"));
        regions.push(regionFromHit("page-1-region-rf","RF",hits.roofF,roofBounds,"pdfjs-text-label-split-x"));
      }else{
        var midY=(hits.threeF.bbox.centerY+hits.roofF.bbox.centerY)/2;
        var lower={x:fullBounds.x,y:fullBounds.y,width:fullBounds.width,height:Math.max(1,midY-fullBounds.y)};
        var upper={x:fullBounds.x,y:midY,width:fullBounds.width,height:Math.max(1,fullBounds.y+fullBounds.height-midY)};
        var threeYBounds=hits.threeF.bbox.centerY <= hits.roofF.bbox.centerY ? lower : upper;
        var roofYBounds=hits.threeF.bbox.centerY <= hits.roofF.bbox.centerY ? upper : lower;
        regions.push(regionFromHit("page-1-region-3f","3F",hits.threeF,threeYBounds,"pdfjs-text-label-split-y"));
        regions.push(regionFromHit("page-1-region-rf","RF",hits.roofF,roofYBounds,"pdfjs-text-label-split-y"));
      }
      receipt.sourcePage.multiRegionStatus="observed-3f-rf-text-labels";
    }else if(hits.threeF || hits.roofF){
      receipt.sourcePage.multiRegionStatus="partial-region-label-observed";
      if(hits.threeF) regions.push(regionFromHit("page-1-region-3f","3F",hits.threeF,null,"pdfjs-text-label"));
      if(hits.roofF) regions.push(regionFromHit("page-1-region-rf","RF",hits.roofF,null,"pdfjs-text-label"));
    }
    receipt.sourcePage.regions=regions;
  }
  function noteStage1ImporterInvocation(receipt,method,payload){
    if(!receipt) return;
    receipt.importer.invoked=true;
    receipt.importer.method=method;
    receipt.timestamps.importerInvocation=stage1Now();
    receipt.importer.payloadSummary={
      wallCount:Array.isArray(payload && payload.walls) ? payload.walls.length : null,
      columnCount:Array.isArray(payload && payload.columns) ? payload.columns.length : null,
      hasUnderlay:!!(payload && payload.underlay),
      hasPdfObjectization:!!(payload && payload.pdfObjectization),
      pdfObjectizationSummary:cloneStage1(payload && payload.pdfObjectization && payload.pdfObjectization.summary)
    };
  }
  function noteStage1ImporterResult(receipt,result,error){
    if(!receipt) return;
    receipt.importer.result=result ? cloneStage1(result) : null;
    receipt.importer.error=error ? (error.message || String(error)) : null;
  }
  async function finalizeStage1Receipt(receipt,status,details){
    if(!receipt || receipt.status==="finalized") return receipt;
    receipt.timestamps.receiptFinalizationStarted=stage1Now();
    receipt.status=status || "finalized";
    if(details) receipt.diagnostics.finalDetails=cloneStage1(details);
    receipt.runtimeHashes.currentAtFinalization=await collectStage1RuntimeHashes();
    receipt.timestamps.receiptFinalized=stage1Now();
    var frozen=deepFreezeStage1(receipt);
    stage1Receipts.push(frozen);
    mirrorStage1ReceiptForQa(frozen);
    try{ window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("laibe-stage1-import-receipt-finalized",{detail:{importSessionId:frozen.importSessionId,status:frozen.status}})); }catch(e){}
    return frozen;
  }

  function bind(){
    var input=findInput();
    if(!input || input.__laibePdfBound) return !!input;
    input.__laibePdfBound=true;
    input.addEventListener("change", async function(e){
      var f=input.files && input.files[0];
      if(!f) return;
      // 重入保護：光柵化後會塞回一個 PNG 檔並重派 change，讓原引擎照圖檔流程處理。
      if(input.__laibePdfRasterized){ input.__laibePdfRasterized=false; return; }
      var isPdf=/\.pdf$/i.test(f.name) || f.type==="application/pdf";
      if(!isPdf) return; // 交給原引擎處理 JPG/PNG/SVG/JSON
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      e.preventDefault();
      if(!window.pdfjsLib){ toast("PDF 元件尚未就緒，請稍後再試"); return; }
      var stage1Receipt=null;
      try{
        toast("PDF 解析中…", true);
        var buf=await f.arrayBuffer();
        stage1Receipt=await createStage1PdfReceipt(f, buf);
        stage1Receipt.timestamps.pdfLoadStarted=stage1Now();
        var pdf=await pdfjsLib.getDocument({data:buf}).promise;
        stage1Receipt.timestamps.pdfLoadFinished=stage1Now();
        stage1Receipt.pdfjs.loadSuccess=true;
        stage1Receipt.pdfjs.pageCount=pdf && Number.isFinite(pdf.numPages) ? pdf.numPages : null;
        stage1Receipt.timestamps.page1LoadStarted=stage1Now();
        var page=await pdf.getPage(1);
        stage1Receipt.timestamps.page1LoadFinished=stage1Now();
        stage1Receipt.pdfjs.page1LoadSuccess=!!page;
        await collectStage1SourceRegions(stage1Receipt, page);
        var OPS=pdfjsLib.OPS;
        var legacyProvisionalProjectionMmPerPt=1;
        var lastPageRaster=null;

        // 讀 PDF 圖層（OCG）：若原檔含「牆／柱／結構」等圖層，先讓使用者挑要匯入哪些。
        var ocConfig=null, ocGroups=null;
        try{ ocConfig=await pdf.getOptionalContentConfig(); }catch(e){ ocConfig=null; }
        if(ocConfig){ try{ ocGroups=ocConfig.getGroups(); }catch(e){ ocGroups=null; } }
        function ocName(id){ var g=ocGroups&&ocGroups[id]; return (g&&(g.name||(g.data&&g.data.name)))||("圖層 "+id); }
        var WALLKW=/牆|墙|wall|柱|column|pillar|結構|结构|structur|隔間|隔间|partition/i;
        // PDF 圖層名含「梁／樑／beam」者保留為樑參考線；不進牆或房間閉合。
        var BEAMKW=/梁|樑|beam|girder|大樑|小樑|大梁|小梁/i;
        // 解析 marked-content 的 OC 參數為圖層 id（可能是字串、物件、或陣列 [type,id]）。
        function resolveOcId(oc){
          if(oc==null) return null;
          if(typeof oc==="string"||typeof oc==="number") return oc;
          if(Array.isArray(oc)) return resolveOcId(oc[oc.length-1]);
          if(typeof oc==="object") return oc.id!=null?oc.id:(oc.name!=null?oc.name:(oc.ref!=null?oc.ref:null));
          return null;
        }
        function ocIsBeam(oc){
          var id=resolveOcId(oc); if(id==null) return false;
          try{ return BEAMKW.test(String(ocName(id))); }catch(e){ return false; }
        }
        var beamLayerCount=0;
        if(ocGroups){ Object.keys(ocGroups).forEach(function(k){ if(BEAMKW.test(String(ocName(k)))) beamLayerCount++; }); }

        // 光柵化 fallback：辨識不到牆線時，把第 1 頁轉白底底圖，走原引擎套繪流程。
        async function rasterFallback(note, receipt){
          var b0=page.getViewport({scale:1});
          var longSide=Math.max(b0.width,b0.height)||1000;
          var sc=Math.max(1,Math.min(3,2200/longSide));
          var rvp=page.getViewport({scale:sc});
          var cv=document.createElement("canvas");
          cv.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(rvp.width)); cv.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(rvp.height));
          var cc=cv.getContext("2d"); cc.fillStyle="#ffffff"; cc.fillRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);
          try{ await renderWithTimeout(page.render({canvasContext:cc,viewport:rvp}), 9000); }
          catch(renderErr){ toast("圖面轉檔逾時，請改用 JPG/PNG 圖檔匯入。"); return; }
          var blob=await new Promise(function(res){ cv.toBlob(res,"image/png"); });
          if(!blob){ toast("PDF 轉圖失敗，請改用圖檔套繪。"); return; }
          throw new Error("Raster fallback is disabled for the governed PDF import route.");
          if(receipt){
            noteStage1ImporterInvocation(receipt,"raster_fallback_disabled",{walls:[],columns:[]});
            noteStage1ImporterResult(receipt,{ok:false,method:"raster_fallback_disabled"});
          }
          if(receipt){ await finalizeStage1Receipt(receipt,"raster-fallback-dispatched",{fallbackFileName:pngFile.name}); }
          toast(note||"已把 PDF 第 1 頁轉成底圖。用【校正比例】後描繪。", true);
        }

        function renderWithTimeout(renderTask, ms){
          return Promise.race([
            renderTask.promise,
            new Promise(function(_,rej){ setTimeout(function(){ try{ renderTask.cancel(); }catch(e){} rej(new Error("render timeout")); }, ms||9000); })
          ]);
        }
        async function createPdfPageUnderlayContext(){
          var b0=page.getViewport({scale:1});
          var longSide=Math.max(b0.width,b0.height)||1000;
          var sc=Math.max(1,Math.min(3,2200/longSide));
          var rvp=page.getViewport({scale:sc});
          var cv=document.createElement("canvas");
          cv.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(rvp.width)); cv.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(rvp.height));
          var cc=cv.getContext("2d"); cc.fillStyle="#ffffff"; cc.fillRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);
          try{
            await renderWithTimeout(page.render({canvasContext:cc,viewport:rvp}), 24000);
          }catch(primaryRenderErr){
            sc=Math.max(1,Math.min(2,1500/longSide));
            rvp=page.getViewport({scale:sc});
            cv=document.createElement("canvas");
            cv.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(rvp.width)); cv.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(rvp.height));
            cc=cv.getContext("2d"); cc.fillStyle="#ffffff"; cc.fillRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);
            await renderWithTimeout(page.render({canvasContext:cc,viewport:rvp}), 24000);
          }
          lastPageRaster={cv:cv,sc:sc};
          var dataUrl=cv.toDataURL("image/png");
          if(!/^data:image\/png;base64,/.test(dataUrl)) return null;
          var pageFrameMm={
            xMm:0,
            yMm:0,
            widthMm:Math.round(b0.width*legacyProvisionalProjectionMmPerPt),
            heightMm:Math.round(b0.height*legacyProvisionalProjectionMmPerPt)
          };
          return {
            fileName:f.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i,"")+".png",
            fileType:"png",
            dataUrl:dataUrl,
            naturalWidth:cv.width,
            naturalHeight:cv.height,
            renderMode:"pdf-vector-context",
            mmPerPt:legacyProvisionalProjectionMmPerPt,
            sourcePageWidth:b0.width,
            sourcePageHeight:b0.height,
            pageFrame:{
              xPt:0,
              yPt:0,
              widthPt:b0.width,
              heightPt:b0.height,
              xMm:pageFrameMm.xMm,
              yMm:pageFrameMm.yMm,
              widthMm:pageFrameMm.widthMm,
              heightMm:pageFrameMm.heightMm
            },
            visibleFrame:{
              xMm:pageFrameMm.xMm,
              yMm:pageFrameMm.yMm,
              widthMm:pageFrameMm.widthMm,
              heightMm:pageFrameMm.heightMm
            },
            cropOffset:{xMm:0,yMm:0},
            worldFrame:{
              xMm:pageFrameMm.xMm,
              yMm:pageFrameMm.yMm,
              widthMm:pageFrameMm.widthMm,
              heightMm:pageFrameMm.heightMm
            },
            coordinateWidthMm:pageFrameMm.widthMm,
            coordinateHeightMm:pageFrameMm.heightMm,
            opacity:0.62,
            source:"pdf-vector-success-underlay"
          };
        }

        // 向量解析：抓「軸向雙線」＝牆、「填色方塊」＝標柱；隱藏圖層（OCG）自動跳過。
        async function extract(){
         try{
          var vp=page.getViewport({scale:1}), vt=vp.transform;
          function mul(m1,m2){ return [m1[0]*m2[0]+m1[2]*m2[1],m1[1]*m2[0]+m1[3]*m2[1],m1[0]*m2[2]+m1[2]*m2[3],m1[1]*m2[2]+m1[3]*m2[3],m1[0]*m2[4]+m1[2]*m2[5]+m1[4],m1[1]*m2[4]+m1[3]*m2[5]+m1[5]]; }
          function ap(m,x,y){ return [m[0]*x+m[2]*y+m[4],m[1]*x+m[3]*y+m[5]]; }
          function mscale(m){ var sx=Math.hypot(m[0]||0,m[1]||0), sy=Math.hypot(m[2]||0,m[3]||0); return (sx&&sy)?(sx+sy)/2:(sx||sy||1); }
          function lineWidthPx(v,m){ return Math.abs(Number(v)||0)*mscale(mul(vt,m)); }
          var opl=await page.getOperatorList();
          var textZones=[], pdfTextCandidates=[];
          function classifyPdfReviewText(st){
            var hasDigit=/[0-9]/.test(st||"");
            if(!hasDigit || /[\u4e00-\u9fff\uac00-\ud7a3]/.test(st||"")) return null;
            if(hasDigit){
              return /[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)?\s*(?:mm|cm|m|M)?|[0-9]+\s*[xX*\/-]\s*[0-9]+/.test(st) ? "dimensionText" : "numericLabel";
            }
            return null;
          }
          // 文字區塊：含中文/英文字母的字串當「文字」排除；純數字/尺寸（含 ×、/、-、.）保留。
          var textZones=[];
          try{
            var tc=await page.getTextContent();
            (tc&&tc.items||[]).forEach(function(it,idx){
              var st=(it.str||"").trim(); if(!st) return;
              if(/[0-9A-Za-z\u4e00-\u9fff\uac00-\ud7a3]/.test(st)){
                var txCandidate=mul(vt, it.transform);
                var cx0=txCandidate[4], cy0=txCandidate[5], cfh=Math.hypot(txCandidate[2],txCandidate[3])||Math.abs(it.height)||8, cwd=Math.abs(it.width)||cfh;
                var ccat=classifyPdfReviewText(st);
                if(!ccat) return;
                var cangle=Math.atan2(txCandidate[1]||0,txCandidate[0]||0)*180/Math.PI;
                if(pdfTextCandidates.length<360){
                  pdfTextCandidates.push({id:"pdf-review-text-"+String(idx+1).padStart(4,"0"),text:st.slice(0,90),category:ccat,xMm:Math.round((cx0+cwd/2)*legacyProvisionalProjectionMmPerPt),yMm:Math.round((cy0-cfh/2)*legacyProvisionalProjectionMmPerPt),widthMm:Math.max(40,Math.round(cwd*legacyProvisionalProjectionMmPerPt)),heightMm:Math.max(40,Math.round(cfh*legacyProvisionalProjectionMmPerPt)),fontSizeMm:Math.max(80,Math.round(cfh*legacyProvisionalProjectionMmPerPt)),rotationDeg:Math.round(cangle),numericDimensionEvidence:true,textPolicy:"arabic-dimension-evidence-only"});
                }
              }
              if(!/[\u4e00-\u9fff\uac00-\ud7a3a-zA-Z]/.test(st)) return; // 純數字 → 保留
              var tx=mul(vt, it.transform);
              var x0=tx[4], y0=tx[5], fh=Math.hypot(tx[2],tx[3])||Math.abs(it.height)||8, wd=Math.abs(it.width)||fh;
              textZones.push([x0-3, y0-fh-3, x0+wd+3, y0+3]);
            });
          }catch(e){}
          function inText(px,py){ for(var z=0;z<textZones.length;z++){ var B=textZones[z]; if(px>=B[0]&&px<=B[2]&&py>=B[1]&&py<=B[3]) return true; } return false; }
          var ctm=[1,0,0,1,0,0], lw=1, stk=[];
          var Hs=[], Vs=[], fills=[], pend=null, doorArcs=[];
          var STROKE={}, FILL={};
          [OPS.stroke,OPS.closeStroke,OPS.fillStroke,OPS.eoFillStroke,OPS.closeFillStroke,OPS.closeEOFillStroke].forEach(function(o){ STROKE[o]=1; });
          [OPS.fill,OPS.eoFill,OPS.fillStroke,OPS.eoFillStroke,OPS.closeFillStroke,OPS.closeEOFillStroke].forEach(function(o){ FILL[o]=1; });
          var MINLEN=14, pMinX=Infinity,pMinY=Infinity,pMaxX=-Infinity,pMaxY=-Infinity;
          var stageMetrics={beamLayers:beamLayerCount};
          function decode(pOps,pA,full){
            var subs=[],cur=null,x=0,y=0,j=0,hasCurve=false;
            for(var pi=0;pi<pOps.length;pi++){ var po=pOps[pi];
              if(po===OPS.moveTo){ x=pA[j++];y=pA[j++]; cur=[ap(full,x,y)]; subs.push(cur); }
              else if(po===OPS.lineTo){ x=pA[j++];y=pA[j++]; if(!cur){cur=[];subs.push(cur);} cur.push(ap(full,x,y)); }
              else if(po===OPS.curveTo){ // 貝茲曲線細分成折線，保留弧形（門開弧）
                var x0=x,y0=y, c1x=pA[j++],c1y=pA[j++],c2x=pA[j++],c2y=pA[j++]; x=pA[j++];y=pA[j++];
                if(!cur){cur=[ap(full,x0,y0)];subs.push(cur);}
                hasCurve=true;
                var N=6; for(var t=1;t<=N;t++){ var u=t/N, mu=1-u;
                  var bx=mu*mu*mu*x0+3*mu*mu*u*c1x+3*mu*u*u*c2x+u*u*u*x;
                  var by=mu*mu*mu*y0+3*mu*mu*u*c1y+3*mu*u*u*c2y+u*u*u*y;
                  cur.push(ap(full,bx,by)); }
              }
              else if(po===OPS.rectangle){ var rx=pA[j++],ry=pA[j++],rw=pA[j++],rh=pA[j++]; subs.push([ap(full,rx,ry),ap(full,rx+rw,ry),ap(full,rx+rw,ry+rh),ap(full,rx,ry+rh),ap(full,rx,ry)]); cur=null; }
              else if(po===OPS.closePath){ if(cur&&cur.length){ cur.push(cur[0]); } }
            }
            subs.__hasCurve=hasCurve;
            return subs;
          }
          var microTicks=[]; // 短於 MINLEN 的軸向小刻線（窗梳/百葉符號的訊號）
          function addStroke(subs, strokeWidth, dashed, sourceKind){
            for(var s=0;s<subs.length;s++){ var pts=subs[s];
              for(var i=0;i+1<pts.length;i++){ var a=pts[i],b=pts[i+1];
                var dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1];
                if(a[0]<pMinX)pMinX=a[0]; if(a[0]>pMaxX)pMaxX=a[0]; if(a[1]<pMinY)pMinY=a[1]; if(a[1]>pMaxY)pMaxY=a[1];
                if(textZones.length && inText((a[0]+b[0])/2,(a[1]+b[1])/2)) continue; // 文字筆畫不進牆判讀
                if(Math.abs(dy)<=1.5 && Math.abs(dx)>=MINLEN){ Hs.push({y:(a[1]+b[1])/2, x1:Math.min(a[0],b[0]), x2:Math.max(a[0],b[0]), lw:strokeWidth||0, dash:!!dashed, sourceKind:sourceKind||""}); }
                else if(Math.abs(dx)<=1.5 && Math.abs(dy)>=MINLEN){ Vs.push({x:(a[0]+b[0])/2, y1:Math.min(a[1],b[1]), y2:Math.max(a[1],b[1]), lw:strokeWidth||0, dash:!!dashed, sourceKind:sourceKind||""}); }
                else if(!dashed && !sourceKind && microTicks.length<800){
                  var len=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
                  if(len>=1.5 && len<MINLEN){
                    if(Math.abs(dy)<=1.2){ microTicks.push({o:"h", pos:(a[1]+b[1])/2, mid:(a[0]+b[0])/2, len:len}); }
                    else if(Math.abs(dx)<=1.2){ microTicks.push({o:"v", pos:(a[0]+b[0])/2, mid:(a[1]+b[1])/2, len:len}); }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
          function addFill(subs){
            var mnx=Infinity,mny=Infinity,mxx=-Infinity,mxy=-Infinity,n=0;
            for(var s=0;s<subs.length;s++){ var pts=subs[s]; for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i++){ var p=pts[i]; n++; if(p[0]<mnx)mnx=p[0]; if(p[0]>mxx)mxx=p[0]; if(p[1]<mny)mny=p[1]; if(p[1]>mxy)mxy=p[1]; } }
            if(n<3) return;
            if(textZones.length && inText((mnx+mxx)/2,(mny+mxy)/2)) return; // 實心字不進柱判讀
            fills.push({w:mxx-mnx,h:mxy-mny,cx:(mnx+mxx)/2,cy:(mny+mxy)/2});
          }
          // 門開弧：描邊、含曲線、門尺寸、外框近方形（四分之一圓的外框）＝門的開啟弧線。排除小字形與細長曲線。
          function tryDoorArc(subs){
            var mnx=Infinity,mny=Infinity,mxx=-Infinity,mxy=-Infinity,n=0;
            for(var s=0;s<subs.length;s++){ var pts=subs[s]; for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i++){ var p=pts[i]; n++; if(p[0]<mnx)mnx=p[0]; if(p[0]>mxx)mxx=p[0]; if(p[1]<mny)mny=p[1]; if(p[1]>mxy)mxy=p[1]; } }
            if(n<4) return;
            var w=mxx-mnx,h=mxy-mny,lo=Math.min(w,h),hi=Math.max(w,h);
            if(hi<15||hi>75) return;          // 門寬約 300–1500mm（F=20：15–75pt）
            if(lo<hi*0.45) return;            // 太扁＝非弧（尺寸線/引線）
            if(textZones.length && inText((mnx+mxx)/2,(mny+mxy)/2)) return; // 非字形
            var all=[]; for(var s2=0;s2<subs.length;s2++){ for(var i2=0;i2<subs[s2].length;i2++) all.push(subs[s2][i2]); }
            var step=Math.max(1,Math.floor(all.length/24)), pts=[];
            for(var pi2=0;pi2<all.length;pi2+=step) pts.push(all[pi2]);
            if(pts[pts.length-1]!==all[all.length-1]) pts.push(all[all.length-1]);
            doorArcs.push({cx:(mnx+mxx)/2,cy:(mny+mxy)/2,w:w,h:h,pts:pts});
          }
          var hideDepth=0, beamDepth=0, mcStack=[], dashOn=false;
          for(var oi=0;oi<opl.fnArray.length;oi++){
            var fn=opl.fnArray[oi], arg=opl.argsArray[oi];
            if(fn===OPS.save){ stk.push({ctm:ctm.slice(),lw:lw,dash:dashOn}); }
            else if(fn===OPS.restore){ var rs=stk.pop(); ctm=(rs&&rs.ctm)||[1,0,0,1,0,0]; lw=(rs&&rs.lw)||1; dashOn=!!(rs&&rs.dash); }
            else if(fn===OPS.transform){ ctm=mul(ctm,arg); }
            else if(fn===OPS.setLineWidth){ lw=Number(arg&&arg[0])||0; }
            else if(fn===OPS.setDash){ dashOn=!!(arg&&arg[0]&&arg[0].length); } // 追蹤 PDF 原生線型：實線/虛線
            else if(fn===OPS.beginMarkedContentProps){
              var oc=(arg&&arg[0]==="OC")?arg[1]:null; var vis=true; if(oc&&ocConfig){ try{ vis=ocConfig.isVisible(oc); }catch(e){ vis=true; } }
              var isBeamOc=!!(oc && ocIsBeam(oc));
              if(isBeamOc){ stageMetrics.beamLayerContentPreserved=(stageMetrics.beamLayerContentPreserved||0)+1; }
              var frame={hidden:vis?0:1, beam:isBeamOc?1:0};
              mcStack.push(frame); if(frame.hidden)hideDepth++; if(frame.beam)beamDepth++;
            }
            else if(fn===OPS.beginMarkedContent){ mcStack.push({hidden:0,beam:0}); }
            else if(fn===OPS.endMarkedContent){ var d=mcStack.pop()||0; if(typeof d==="number"){ if(d)hideDepth--; } else { if(d.hidden)hideDepth--; if(d.beam)beamDepth--; } }
            else if(fn===OPS.constructPath){ pend=hideDepth?null:{subs:decode(arg[0],arg[1],mul(vt,ctm)),lw:lineWidthPx(lw,ctm),dash:dashOn,sourceKind:beamDepth?"beam":""}; }
            else if(pend){ if(FILL[fn]) addFill(pend.subs); if(STROKE[fn]){ addStroke(pend.subs,pend.lw,pend.dash,pend.sourceKind); if(!pend.dash && !pend.sourceKind && pend.subs.__hasCurve && doorArcs.length<80) tryDoorArc(pend.subs); } pend=null; }
            if(Hs.length+Vs.length>80000) break;
          }

          // 合併共線線段成「線段跑道」；實線/虛線分流，虛線只作後續保留類別判讀，不直接進牆。
          function mergeRuns(items,posKey,aKey,bKey){
            var map={};
            items.forEach(function(it){ var p=Math.round(it[posKey])+"_"+(it.sourceKind||(it.dash?"dash":"solid")); (map[p]=map[p]||[]).push([it[aKey],it[bKey],it.lw||0,it.dash?1:0,it.sourceKind||""]); });
            var runs=[];
            Object.keys(map).forEach(function(pk){ var arr=map[pk].sort(function(u,v){return u[0]-v[0];}); var cur=null; var basePos=parseInt(pk,10); var isDash=arr.some(function(iv){return !!iv[3];}); var sourceKind=arr.some(function(iv){return iv[4]==="beam";})?"beam":(isDash?"dashed":"");
              arr.forEach(function(iv){ if(!cur){cur=[iv[0],iv[1],iv[2]||0];} else if(iv[0]<=cur[1]+3){ if(iv[1]>cur[1])cur[1]=iv[1]; if((iv[2]||0)>cur[2])cur[2]=iv[2]||0; } else { runs.push({pos:basePos,a:cur[0],b:cur[1],lw:cur[2]||0,dash:isDash,sourceKind:sourceKind}); cur=[iv[0],iv[1],iv[2]||0]; } });
              if(cur) runs.push({pos:basePos,a:cur[0],b:cur[1],lw:cur[2]||0,dash:isDash,sourceKind:sourceKind}); });
            return runs;
          }
          var Hr=mergeRuns(Hs,"y","x1","x2"), Vr=mergeRuns(Vs,"x","y1","y2");
          // 虛線跑道分離：只保留可判定為門窗、樓梯、標註等必要類別的線索；梁與 hatch/noise 不回收。
          var HrDash=Hr.filter(function(r){return r.dash;}), VrDash=Vr.filter(function(r){return r.dash;});
          stageMetrics.dashedH=HrDash.length; stageMetrics.dashedV=VrDash.length;
          stageMetrics.rawH=Hs.length; stageMetrics.rawV=Vs.length;

          function medianNum(a){ if(!a.length)return 0; var s=a.slice().sort(function(x,y){return x-y;}); return s[Math.floor(s.length/2)]; }
          function applyLineWidthFilter(hRuns,vRuns){
            var vals=hRuns.concat(vRuns).map(function(r){return r.lw||0;}).filter(function(v){return v>0;}).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});
            if(vals.length<24) return {h:hRuns,v:vRuns};
            var p10=vals[Math.floor(vals.length*0.10)], p90=vals[Math.min(vals.length-1,Math.ceil(vals.length*0.90))];
            if(!p10||!p90||p90/p10<1.9) return {h:hRuns,v:vRuns};
            var minGroup=Math.max(6,Math.round(vals.length*0.08)), best=-1, bestGap=1;
            for(var n=minGroup;n<=vals.length-minGroup;n++){ var gap=vals[n]/Math.max(0.001,vals[n-1]); if(gap>bestGap){ bestGap=gap; best=n; } }
            if(best<0||bestGap<1.75) return {h:hRuns,v:vRuns};
            var low=medianNum(vals.slice(0,best)), high=medianNum(vals.slice(best));
            if(!low||!high||high/low<1.8) return {h:hRuns,v:vRuns};
            var threshold=Math.sqrt(vals[best-1]*vals[best]);
            function keep(r){ return !(r.lw>0 && r.lw<threshold); }
            return {h:hRuns.filter(keep),v:vRuns.filter(keep),thinH:hRuns.filter(function(r){return !keep(r);}),thinV:vRuns.filter(function(r){return !keep(r);})};
          }
          stageMetrics.mergedH=Hr.length; stageMetrics.mergedV=Vr.length;
          var lwClean=applyLineWidthFilter(Hr,Vr); Hr=lwClean.h; Vr=lwClean.v;
          var thinHr=lwClean.thinH||[], thinVr=lwClean.thinV||[];
          var stairSourceHr=Hr.slice(), stairSourceVr=Vr.slice();
          stageMetrics.thinDroppedH=thinHr.length; stageMetrics.thinDroppedV=thinVr.length;
          stageMetrics.afterLineWidthH=Hr.length; stageMetrics.afterLineWidthV=Vr.length;

          // 樓梯/剖面線抑制：≥5 條等距、互相重疊的平行短線群＝梯級/hatch → 整群排除（保留明顯較長的邊界牆）
          function suppressHatch(runs, dropped){
            runs.sort(function(a,b){return a.pos-b.pos;});
            var keep=runs.map(function(){return true;});
            var spanX=(pMaxX-pMinX)||vp.width||1000, spanY=(pMaxY-pMinY)||vp.height||1000;
            var maxShort=Math.max(48,Math.min(spanX,spanY)*0.18), maxGap=Math.max(18,Math.min(42,Math.min(spanX,spanY)*0.035));
            function overlapRatio(a,b){
              var ov=Math.min(a.b,b.b)-Math.max(a.a,b.a);
              var minLen=Math.max(0.001,Math.min(a.b-a.a,b.b-b.a));
              return ov/minLen;
            }
            var i=0;
            while(i<runs.length){
              if(runs[i].sourceKind==="beam"){ i++; continue; }
              var chain=[i], k=i;
              while(k+1<runs.length){
                var p=runs[k], c=runs[k+1];
                if(p.sourceKind==="beam" || c.sourceKind==="beam") break;
                var gap=c.pos-p.pos;
                var plen=p.b-p.a, clen=c.b-c.a;
                var aligned=Math.abs(((p.a+p.b)/2)-((c.a+c.b)/2))<=Math.max(10,Math.min(plen,clen)*0.45);
                if(gap>0 && gap<=maxGap && (overlapRatio(p,c)>=0.35 || aligned)){ chain.push(k+1); k++; } else break;
              }
              if(chain.length>=4){
                var gaps=[]; for(var q=1;q<chain.length;q++){ gaps.push(runs[chain[q]].pos-runs[chain[q-1]].pos); }
                var mean=gaps.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;},0)/gaps.length;
                var varr=gaps.reduce(function(a,b){return a+(b-mean)*(b-mean);},0)/gaps.length;
                if(mean>0 && Math.sqrt(varr)<=Math.max(2.2, mean*0.55)){
                  var lens=chain.map(function(idx){ return runs[idx].b-runs[idx].a; }).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});
                  var medLen=lens[Math.floor(lens.length/2)];
                  if(medLen<=maxShort){ chain.forEach(function(idx){ if((runs[idx].b-runs[idx].a) <= medLen*2.2) keep[idx]=false; }); }
                }
              }
              i=k+1;
            }
            return runs.filter(function(r,idx){ if(r.sourceKind==="beam") return true; if(!keep[idx] && dropped){ dropped.push(r); } return keep[idx]; });
          }
          var hatchDroppedH=[], hatchDroppedV=[], thinHatchDroppedH=[], thinHatchDroppedV=[];
          Hr=suppressHatch(Hr, hatchDroppedH); Vr=suppressHatch(Vr, hatchDroppedV);
          thinHr=suppressHatch(thinHr, thinHatchDroppedH); thinVr=suppressHatch(thinVr, thinHatchDroppedV);
          stageMetrics.afterHatchH=Hr.length; stageMetrics.afterHatchV=Vr.length;
          stageMetrics.hatchDroppedH=hatchDroppedH.length; stageMetrics.hatchDroppedV=hatchDroppedV.length;
          stageMetrics.thinHatchDroppedH=thinHatchDroppedH.length; stageMetrics.thinHatchDroppedV=thinHatchDroppedV.length;

          function runBox(r,o){
            return o==="h" ? {x0:r.a,y0:r.pos,x1:r.b,y1:r.pos,cx:(r.a+r.b)/2,cy:r.pos,len:r.b-r.a,o:o}
              : {x0:r.pos,y0:r.a,x1:r.pos,y1:r.b,cx:r.pos,cy:(r.a+r.b)/2,len:r.b-r.a,o:o};
          }
          function boxTouch(A,B,pad){ return A.x0-pad<=B.x1 && B.x0-pad<=A.x1 && A.y0-pad<=B.y1 && B.y0-pad<=A.y1; }
          function regularPositions(items,o){
            var vals=items.filter(function(it){return it.o===o;}).map(function(it){return o==="h"?it.cy:it.cx;}).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});
            if(vals.length<4) return false;
            var gaps=[]; for(var i=1;i<vals.length;i++){ var g=vals[i]-vals[i-1]; if(g>0.5) gaps.push(g); }
            if(gaps.length<3) return false;
            var mean=gaps.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;},0)/gaps.length;
            var variance=gaps.reduce(function(a,b){return a+(b-mean)*(b-mean);},0)/gaps.length;
            return mean>0 && mean<=48 && Math.sqrt(variance)<=Math.max(2.5,mean*0.6);
          }
          function buildNoiseZones(hRuns,vRuns){
            var spanX=(pMaxX-pMinX)||vp.width||1000, spanY=(pMaxY-pMinY)||vp.height||1000, pageMin=Math.min(spanX,spanY);
            var shortMax=Math.max(52,pageMin*0.22), joinPad=Math.max(14,pageMin*0.028), zones=[];
            var items=hRuns.map(function(r){return runBox(r,"h");}).concat(vRuns.map(function(r){return runBox(r,"v");}))
              .filter(function(it){ return it.len>=MINLEN && it.len<=shortMax; });
            items.forEach(function(it){
              var target=null;
              for(var i=0;i<zones.length;i++){ if(boxTouch(zones[i],it,joinPad)){ target=zones[i]; break; } }
              if(!target){ target={x0:it.x0,y0:it.y0,x1:it.x1,y1:it.y1,items:[]}; zones.push(target); }
              target.items.push(it);
              target.x0=Math.min(target.x0,it.x0); target.y0=Math.min(target.y0,it.y0); target.x1=Math.max(target.x1,it.x1); target.y1=Math.max(target.y1,it.y1);
            });
            return zones.filter(function(z){
              var h=z.items.filter(function(it){return it.o==="h";}).length, v=z.items.length-h;
              var zw=z.x1-z.x0, zh=z.y1-z.y0, compact=zw<=pageMin*0.34 && zh<=pageMin*0.34;
              var repeated=regularPositions(z.items,"h") || regularPositions(z.items,"v");
              var mixed=z.items.length>=6 && h>=2 && v>=2 && compact;
              return compact && z.items.length>=5 && (repeated || mixed || h>=5 || v>=5);
            }).map(function(z){
              var pad=Math.max(10,joinPad*0.6);
              return {x0:z.x0-pad,y0:z.y0-pad,x1:z.x1+pad,y1:z.y1+pad,maxLen:shortMax*1.35,count:z.items.length};
            });
          }
          function runInNoiseZone(r,o,zones){
            if(r.sourceKind==="beam") return false;
            if(!zones.length) return false;
            var b=runBox(r,o);
            if(b.len>Math.max(70,Math.min((pMaxX-pMinX)||vp.width||1000,(pMaxY-pMinY)||vp.height||1000)*0.24)) return false;
            return zones.some(function(z){
              var cxInside=b.cx>=z.x0 && b.cx<=z.x1 && b.cy>=z.y0 && b.cy<=z.y1;
              return cxInside && b.len<=z.maxLen && boxTouch(z,b,0);
            });
          }
          var noiseZones=buildNoiseZones(Hr,Vr);
          var noiseDroppedH=[], noiseDroppedV=[];
          if(noiseZones.length){
            Hr=Hr.filter(function(r){ var drop=runInNoiseZone(r,"h",noiseZones); if(drop) noiseDroppedH.push(r); return !drop; });
            Vr=Vr.filter(function(r){ var drop=runInNoiseZone(r,"v",noiseZones); if(drop) noiseDroppedV.push(r); return !drop; });
            thinHr=thinHr.filter(function(r){ var drop=runInNoiseZone(r,"h",noiseZones); if(drop) noiseDroppedH.push(r); return !drop; });
            thinVr=thinVr.filter(function(r){ var drop=runInNoiseZone(r,"v",noiseZones); if(drop) noiseDroppedV.push(r); return !drop; });
          }
          stageMetrics.noiseZoneCount=noiseZones.length;
          stageMetrics.afterNoiseZoneH=Hr.length; stageMetrics.afterNoiseZoneV=Vr.length;
          stageMetrics.afterThinNoiseZoneH=thinHr.length; stageMetrics.afterThinNoiseZoneV=thinVr.length;
          stageMetrics.noiseDroppedH=noiseDroppedH.length; stageMetrics.noiseDroppedV=noiseDroppedV.length;
          function detectStairTreadEvidence(droppedH,droppedV,sourceH,sourceV){
            function median(vals){
              vals=vals.filter(function(v){ return Number.isFinite(v); }).sort(function(a,b){ return a-b; });
              var n=vals.length;
              if(!n) return 0;
              return n%2 ? vals[(n-1)/2] : (vals[n/2-1]+vals[n/2])/2;
            }
            function overlap(a1,a2,b1,b2){ return Math.max(0, Math.min(a2,b2)-Math.max(a1,b1)); }
            function lineLen(r){ return Math.abs((r.b||0)-(r.a||0)); }
            function sameSpan(a,b){
              return overlap(a.a,a.b,b.a,b.b) >= Math.min(lineLen(a),lineLen(b))*0.55;
            }
            function chainRuns(runs){
              var sorted=runs.filter(function(r){ return r && Number.isFinite(r.pos) && Number.isFinite(r.a) && Number.isFinite(r.b); })
                .slice().sort(function(a,b){ return (a.pos-b.pos)||((a.a||0)-(b.a||0)); });
              var chains=[];
              sorted.forEach(function(r){
                var attached=false;
                for(var i=chains.length-1;i>=0;i--){
                  var c=chains[i], last=c[c.length-1], medLen=median(c.map(lineLen));
                  var maxGap=Math.max(4, Math.min(18, medLen*0.32));
                  if(Math.abs(r.pos-last.pos)<=maxGap && sameSpan(r,last)){ c.push(r); attached=true; break; }
                  if(last.pos+maxGap<r.pos) break;
                }
                if(!attached) chains.push([r]);
              });
              return chains;
            }
            function getBoundaryEvidence(box,o,crossRuns,sameRuns){
              var major=o==="h"?box.w:box.h, minor=o==="h"?box.h:box.w;
              var edgeTol=Math.max(10, Math.min(32, major*0.32));
              var minorPad=Math.max(6, minor*0.3);
              var firstStringer=false, secondStringer=false;
              crossRuns.forEach(function(r){
                if(o==="h"){
                  var stringerCoverage=overlap(r.a,r.b,box.y0-minorPad,box.y1+minorPad);
                  if(stringerCoverage>=minor*0.62){
                    if(Math.abs(r.pos-box.x0)<=edgeTol) firstStringer=true;
                    if(Math.abs(r.pos-box.x1)<=edgeTol) secondStringer=true;
                  }
                } else {
                  var stringerCoverageV=overlap(r.a,r.b,box.x0-minorPad,box.x1+minorPad);
                  if(stringerCoverageV>=minor*0.62){
                    if(Math.abs(r.pos-box.y0)<=edgeTol) firstStringer=true;
                    if(Math.abs(r.pos-box.y1)<=edgeTol) secondStringer=true;
                  }
                }
              });
              var railOk=false;
              sameRuns.some(function(r){
                if(o==="h"){
                  var nearY=Math.min(Math.abs(r.pos-box.y0), Math.abs(r.pos-box.y1));
                  if(nearY<=Math.max(10, minor*0.85) && lineLen(r)>=major*0.75 && overlap(r.a,r.b,box.x0-edgeTol,box.x1+edgeTol)>=major*0.65){ railOk=true; return true; }
                } else {
                  var nearX=Math.min(Math.abs(r.pos-box.x0), Math.abs(r.pos-box.x1));
                  if(nearX<=Math.max(10, minor*0.85) && lineLen(r)>=major*0.75 && overlap(r.a,r.b,box.y0-edgeTol,box.y1+edgeTol)>=major*0.65){ railOk=true; return true; }
                }
                return false;
              });
              return {
                opposedStringers:firstStringer && secondStringer,
                firstStringer:firstStringer,
                secondStringer:secondStringer,
                outlineRail:railOk,
                edgeTolerancePt:Number(edgeTol.toFixed(3)),
                minimumStringerCoverageRatio:0.62
              };
            }
            function fromChains(runs,o,crossRuns,sameRuns,candidates){
              chainRuns(runs).forEach(function(chain){
                if(chain.length<5 || chain.length>22) return;
                var medLen=median(chain.map(lineLen));
                if(medLen<14 || medLen>140) return;
                var positions=chain.map(function(r){ return r.pos; }).sort(function(a,b){ return a-b; });
                var gaps=[];
                for(var i=1;i<positions.length;i++) gaps.push(positions[i]-positions[i-1]);
                var medGap=median(gaps);
                if(medGap<2 || medGap>24) return;
                var treadGapLengthRatio=medGap/medLen;
                if(treadGapLengthRatio<0.16 || treadGapLengthRatio>0.6) return;
                var maxGap=Math.max.apply(null,gaps), minGap=Math.min.apply(null,gaps);
                if(maxGap>Math.max(8, medGap*2.35) || minGap<Math.max(0.5, medGap*0.25)) return;
                var a0=median(chain.map(function(r){ return r.a; })), b0=median(chain.map(function(r){ return r.b; }));
                var edgeSpread=Math.max.apply(null, chain.map(function(r){ return Math.max(Math.abs(r.a-a0), Math.abs(r.b-b0)); }));
                if(edgeSpread>Math.max(8, medLen*0.24)) return;
                var pos0=positions[0], pos1=positions[positions.length-1];
                var box=o==="h" ? {x0:a0,x1:b0,y0:pos0,y1:pos1,w:b0-a0,h:pos1-pos0} : {x0:pos0,x1:pos1,y0:a0,y1:b0,w:pos1-pos0,h:b0-a0};
                if(box.w<=0 || box.h<=0) return;
                var major=o==="h"?box.w:box.h, minor=o==="h"?box.h:box.w;
                if(minor<8 || minor>Math.max(160, major*1.45)) return;
                var boundary=getBoundaryEvidence(box,o,crossRuns,sameRuns);
                if(!boundary.opposedStringers || !boundary.outlineRail) return;
                candidates.push({
                  o:o,
                  chain:chain,
                  box:box,
                  pos0:pos0,
                  pos1:pos1,
                  span0:a0,
                  span1:b0,
                  medLen:medLen,
                  medGap:medGap,
                  treadGapLengthRatio:treadGapLengthRatio,
                  edgeSpread:edgeSpread,
                  boundary:boundary
                });
              });
            }
            function pairedFlightRelation(a,b){
              if(a===b || a.o!==b.o) return null;
              var progressionOverlap=overlap(a.pos0,a.pos1,b.pos0,b.pos1);
              var progressionMin=Math.max(0.001,Math.min(a.pos1-a.pos0,b.pos1-b.pos0));
              var progressionOverlapRatio=progressionOverlap/progressionMin;
              if(progressionOverlapRatio<0.72) return null;
              var landingGap=Math.max(a.span0,b.span0)-Math.min(a.span1,b.span1);
              var maxLandingGap=Math.max(16,Math.min(40,Math.min(a.medLen,b.medLen)*0.8));
              if(landingGap<2 || landingGap>maxLandingGap) return null;
              var lengthRatio=Math.max(a.medLen,b.medLen)/Math.max(0.001,Math.min(a.medLen,b.medLen));
              if(lengthRatio>1.45 || Math.abs(a.chain.length-b.chain.length)>2) return null;
              return {
                pairedFlight:true,
                sameTreadDirection:true,
                progressionOverlapRatio:Number(progressionOverlapRatio.toFixed(3)),
                minimumProgressionOverlapRatio:0.72,
                landingGapPt:Number(landingGap.toFixed(3)),
                maximumLandingGapPt:Number(maxLandingGap.toFixed(3)),
                flightLengthRatio:Number(lengthRatio.toFixed(3)),
                maximumFlightLengthRatio:1.45
              };
            }
            var candidates=[];
            fromChains(droppedH||[],"h",sourceV||[],sourceH||[],candidates);
            fromChains(droppedV||[],"v",sourceH||[],sourceV||[],candidates);
            var out=[];
            candidates.forEach(function(candidate,index){
              var relation=null;
              for(var i=0;i<candidates.length;i++){
                relation=pairedFlightRelation(candidate,candidates[i]);
                if(relation) break;
              }
              if(!relation) return;
              candidate.chain.forEach(function(r){
                var copy=Object.assign({}, r);
                copy.o=candidate.o;
