                copy.stairEvidence="paired-flight-tread-chain";
                copy.stairFeatures={
                  boundedRegion:true,
                  opposedStringers:true,
                  stringerOrOutlineBoundary:true,
                  outlineRail:true,
                  regularTreadSequence:true,
                  pairedFlight:true,
                  landingRelation:true,
                  treadDirectionConsistent:true,
                  sourceCorrespondenceBasis:"paired_source_vector_flights_with_opposed_stringers",
                  chainCount:candidate.chain.length,
                  medianLengthPt:Number(candidate.medLen.toFixed(3)),
                  medianGapPt:Number(candidate.medGap.toFixed(3)),
                  treadGapLengthRatio:Number(candidate.treadGapLengthRatio.toFixed(3)),
                  minimumTreadGapLengthRatio:0.16,
                  maximumTreadGapLengthRatio:0.6,
                  edgeSpreadPt:Number(candidate.edgeSpread.toFixed(3)),
                  boundaryEvidence:candidate.boundary,
                  landingEvidence:relation
                };
                out.push(copy);
              });
            });
            stageMetrics.stairCandidateChainCount=candidates.length;
            stageMetrics.stairAcceptedPairedFlightChainCount=out.reduce(function(count,r){ var k=[r.o,r.stairFeatures&&r.stairFeatures.medianLengthPt,r.stairFeatures&&r.stairFeatures.medianGapPt,r.stairFeatures&&r.stairFeatures.chainCount].join(":"); count[k]=1; return count; },{});
            stageMetrics.stairAcceptedPairedFlightChainCount=Object.keys(stageMetrics.stairAcceptedPairedFlightChainCount).length;
            stageMetrics.stairRejectedAmbiguousChainCount=Math.max(0,candidates.length-stageMetrics.stairAcceptedPairedFlightChainCount);
            var seen={};
            return out.filter(function(r){
              var k=[r.o,Math.round(r.pos*10),Math.round(r.a*10),Math.round(r.b*10)].join(":");
              if(seen[k]) return false;
              seen[k]=1;
              return true;
            });
          }
          var stairTreadRuns=detectStairTreadEvidence(hatchDroppedH.concat(noiseDroppedH),hatchDroppedV.concat(noiseDroppedV),stairSourceHr,stairSourceVr);
          stageMetrics.stairTreadEvidence=stairTreadRuns.length;
          // 雙線配對＝牆中心線（單線的尺寸線/圖框自然被濾除）
          function pairWalls(runs,GAPMAX,OVMIN){
            runs.sort(function(a,b){return a.pos-b.pos;});
            var out=[];
            for(var i=0;i<runs.length;i++){ for(var k=i+1;k<runs.length;k++){
              var g=runs[k].pos-runs[i].pos; if(g<2)continue; if(g>GAPMAX)break;
              var ov=Math.min(runs[i].b,runs[k].b)-Math.max(runs[i].a,runs[k].a);
              if(ov<OVMIN)continue;
              out.push({pos:(runs[i].pos+runs[k].pos)/2, a:Math.max(runs[i].a,runs[k].a), b:Math.min(runs[i].b,runs[k].b), thk:g});
            }}
            return out;
          }
          var GAPMAX=34, OVMIN=18;
          var structuralHr=Hr.filter(function(r){ return r.sourceKind!=="beam"; });
          var structuralVr=Vr.filter(function(r){ return r.sourceKind!=="beam"; });
          var hc=pairWalls(structuralHr,GAPMAX,OVMIN), vc=pairWalls(structuralVr,GAPMAX,OVMIN);
          function median(a){ if(!a.length)return 0; var s=a.slice().sort(function(x,y){return x-y;}); return s[Math.floor(s.length/2)]; }
          var thk=median(hc.concat(vc).map(function(c){return c.thk;}));
          function keepThk(c){ return !thk || (c.thk>=thk*0.35 && c.thk<=thk*2.4); }
          hc=hc.filter(keepThk); vc=vc.filter(keepThk);
          stageMetrics.pairedH=hc.length; stageMetrics.pairedV=vc.length;

          var F=legacyProvisionalProjectionMmPerPt;
          // 連通性過濾：孤立雜線（圖框殘段、剖面符號、圖例長條）自成小分量 → 丟棄。
          var wsegs=[];
          function rectToReviewBox(id, category, fl, extra){
            return Object.assign({
              id:id,
              category:category,
              xMm:Math.round((fl.cx-fl.w/2)*F),
              yMm:Math.round((fl.cy-fl.h/2)*F),
              widthMm:Math.max(20,Math.round(fl.w*F)),
              heightMm:Math.max(20,Math.round(fl.h*F))
            }, extra||{});
          }
          function buildIgnoredHatchNoiseBoxes(){
            var raw=[];
            function addRunList(list,o,source){
              (list||[]).forEach(function(r){
                var b=runBox(r,o);
                if(!Number.isFinite(b.x0)||!Number.isFinite(b.y0)||!Number.isFinite(b.x1)||!Number.isFinite(b.y1)) return;
                raw.push({x0:Math.min(b.x0,b.x1),y0:Math.min(b.y0,b.y1),x1:Math.max(b.x0,b.x1),y1:Math.max(b.y0,b.y1),source:source,count:1});
              });
            }
            addRunList(hatchDroppedH,"h","hatch_repeated_parallel_lines");
            addRunList(hatchDroppedV,"v","hatch_repeated_parallel_lines");
            addRunList(thinHatchDroppedH,"h","thin_hatch_repeated_parallel_lines");
            addRunList(thinHatchDroppedV,"v","thin_hatch_repeated_parallel_lines");
            addRunList(noiseDroppedH,"h","localized_fill_like_noise_zone");
            addRunList(noiseDroppedV,"v","localized_fill_like_noise_zone");
            if(!raw.length) return [];
            var spanX=(pMaxX-pMinX)||vp.width||1000, spanY=(pMaxY-pMinY)||vp.height||1000;
            var joinPad=Math.max(8,Math.min(32,Math.min(spanX,spanY)*0.025));
            var groups=[];
            raw.forEach(function(it){
              var target=null;
              for(var i=0;i<groups.length;i++){ if(boxTouch(groups[i],it,joinPad)){ target=groups[i]; break; } }
              if(!target){ target={x0:it.x0,y0:it.y0,x1:it.x1,y1:it.y1,count:0,sources:{}}; groups.push(target); }
              target.x0=Math.min(target.x0,it.x0); target.y0=Math.min(target.y0,it.y0);
              target.x1=Math.max(target.x1,it.x1); target.y1=Math.max(target.y1,it.y1);
              target.count+=it.count||1; target.sources[it.source]=1;
            });
            groups.sort(function(a,b){ return (b.count-a.count)||((b.x1-b.x0)*(b.y1-b.y0)-(a.x1-a.x0)*(a.y1-a.y0)); });
            return groups.slice(0,160).map(function(g,i){
              var pad=Math.max(8,joinPad*0.5);
              return rectToReviewBox("pdf-hatch-noise-"+(i+1),"hatchOrNoise",{
                cx:(g.x0+g.x1)/2,
                cy:(g.y0+g.y1)/2,
                w:Math.max(1,g.x1-g.x0+pad*2),
                h:Math.max(1,g.y1-g.y0+pad*2)
              },{
                hiddenDefault:true,
                reviewOnly:true,
                objectState:"ignored_object",
                reason:"hatch_pattern_or_fill_like_noise_excluded",
                sourceDroppedCount:g.count,
                sourceKinds:Object.keys(g.sources)
              });
            });
          }
          hc.forEach(function(c){ wsegs.push({o:"h",pos:c.pos,a:c.a,b:c.b,thk:c.thk}); });
          vc.forEach(function(c){ wsegs.push({o:"v",pos:c.pos,a:c.a,b:c.b,thk:c.thk}); });
          // P1(b) 填色牆：細長填色多邊形（長寬比高、短邊≈牆厚）也當牆，補雙線抓不到的實心牆。
          var baseThk = thk || 8;
          var filledWallBodies=[];
          fills.forEach(function(fl){
            var lo=Math.min(fl.w,fl.h), hi=Math.max(fl.w,fl.h);
            if(hi < lo*2.5) return;                        // 非細長
            if(lo < baseThk*0.4 || lo > baseThk*4) return; // 短邊需近牆厚
            if(hi < OVMIN) return;                         // 太短
            if(filledWallBodies.length<180){ filledWallBodies.push(rectToReviewBox("pdf-filled-wall-"+(filledWallBodies.length+1),"filledWallBody",fl,{orientation:fl.w>=fl.h?"h":"v"})); }
            if(fl.w>=fl.h){ wsegs.push({o:"h",pos:fl.cy,a:fl.cx-fl.w/2,b:fl.cx+fl.w/2,thk:fl.h}); }
            else{ wsegs.push({o:"v",pos:fl.cx,a:fl.cy-fl.h/2,b:fl.cy+fl.h/2,thk:fl.w}); }
          });
          // P2 單線牆備援：未配對的長直線，若端點與垂直牆形成轉角（封口/接牆）也當牆，補雙線抓不到的單線隔間、厚牆。
          // 只收「接到既有牆」的線，浮動的尺寸/引線因不接牆、之後連通性過濾會自然丟棄，避免假牆。
          (function singleLineWallFallback(){
            var HEALGAP=Math.max(baseThk*2.5,16);
            var minLenSingle=Math.max(OVMIN*2, baseThk*4);
            function isPaired(run,runs){
              for(var i=0;i<runs.length;i++){ var o=runs[i]; if(o===run) continue;
                var g=Math.abs(o.pos-run.pos); if(g<2||g>GAPMAX) continue;
                var ov=Math.min(run.b,o.b)-Math.max(run.a,o.a); if(ov>=OVMIN) return true; }
              return false;
            }
            var wallH=wsegs.filter(function(w){return w.o==="h";});
            var wallV=wsegs.filter(function(w){return w.o==="v";});
            // 檢查此線端點是否接到垂直牆（perp）：端點座標近 perp 固定位置，且此線固定座標落在 perp 跨距內。
            function meetsPerp(runFixed,runA,runB,perp){
              for(var i=0;i<perp.length;i++){ var p=perp[i];
                var nearEnd=Math.min(Math.abs(p.pos-runA),Math.abs(p.pos-runB))<=HEALGAP;
                var within=runFixed>=p.a-HEALGAP && runFixed<=p.b+HEALGAP;
                if(nearEnd && within) return true; }
              return false;
            }
            // 樓梯級/格柵：同向、間距≤群距、長度相近的密集平行線群 → 不可升為牆。
            function inDenseGroup(run,runs){
              var span=Math.abs(run.b-run.a);
              var near=runs.filter(function(o){ if(o===run) return false;
                var g=Math.abs(o.pos-run.pos); if(g<=0||g>Math.max(baseThk*3,44)) return false;
                var ov=Math.min(run.b,o.b)-Math.max(run.a,o.a); var minLen=Math.max(1,Math.min(span,Math.abs(o.b-o.a)));
                return ov/minLen>=0.35 && Math.abs(Math.abs(o.b-o.a)-span)<=span*0.6; });
              return near.length>=3; // 自身＋≥3 條同型平行線＝密集群（梯級）
            }
            var added=0;
            structuralHr.forEach(function(r){ if(isPaired(r,structuralHr)) return; if((r.b-r.a)<minLenSingle) return; if(inDenseGroup(r,structuralHr)) return;
              if(meetsPerp(r.pos,r.a,r.b,wallV)){ wsegs.push({o:"h",pos:r.pos,a:r.a,b:r.b,thk:baseThk}); added++; } });
            structuralVr.forEach(function(r){ if(isPaired(r,structuralVr)) return; if((r.b-r.a)<minLenSingle) return; if(inDenseGroup(r,structuralVr)) return;
              if(meetsPerp(r.pos,r.a,r.b,wallH)){ wsegs.push({o:"v",pos:r.pos,a:r.a,b:r.b,thk:baseThk}); added++; } });
            stageMetrics.singleLineWallsAdded=added;
          })();
          // 中心線去重：配對鏈（1-2、2-3…）與填色牆會產生重疊重複線 → 合併
          (function dedupSegs(){
            var map={};
            wsegs.forEach(function(w){ var key=w.o+'_'+Math.round(w.pos/3); (map[key]=map[key]||[]).push(w); });
            var out=[];
            Object.keys(map).forEach(function(k){
              var arr=map[k].sort(function(a,b){return a.a-b.a;});
              var cur=null;
              arr.forEach(function(w){
                if(cur && w.a<=cur.b+3){ cur.b=Math.max(cur.b,w.b); cur.thk=Math.max(cur.thk,w.thk); }
                else { if(cur) out.push(cur); cur={o:w.o,pos:w.pos,a:w.a,b:w.b,thk:w.thk}; }
              });
              if(cur) out.push(cur);
            });
            wsegs=out;
          })();
          stageMetrics.fillCount=fills.length;
          stageMetrics.afterDedup=wsegs.length;
          function suppressDenseCandidateWalls(segs){
            var spanX=(pMaxX-pMinX)||vp.width||1000, spanY=(pMaxY-pMinY)||vp.height||1000;
            var maxShort=Math.max(52,Math.min(spanX,spanY)*0.20), maxGap=Math.max(baseThk*1.5,Math.min(46,Math.min(spanX,spanY)*0.04));
            var drop={};
            ["h","v"].forEach(function(o){
              var arr=segs.map(function(w,idx){ return {w:w,idx:idx,len:Math.abs(w.b-w.a),mid:(w.a+w.b)/2}; })
                .filter(function(it){ return it.w.o===o && it.len<=maxShort; })
                .sort(function(a,b){return a.w.pos-b.w.pos;});
              var i=0;
              while(i<arr.length){
                var chain=[arr[i]], k=i;
                while(k+1<arr.length){
                  var p=arr[k], c=arr[k+1], gap=c.w.pos-p.w.pos;
                  var ov=Math.min(p.w.b,c.w.b)-Math.max(p.w.a,c.w.a);
                  var ovRatio=ov/Math.max(0.001,Math.min(p.len,c.len));
                  var aligned=Math.abs(p.mid-c.mid)<=Math.max(12,Math.min(p.len,c.len)*0.45);
                  if(gap>0 && gap<=maxGap && (ovRatio>=0.35 || aligned)){ chain.push(c); k++; } else break;
                }
                if(chain.length>=4){
                  var gaps=[]; for(var q=1;q<chain.length;q++) gaps.push(chain[q].w.pos-chain[q-1].w.pos);
                  var mean=gaps.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;},0)/gaps.length;
                  var variance=gaps.reduce(function(a,b){return a+(b-mean)*(b-mean);},0)/gaps.length;
                  if(mean>0 && Math.sqrt(variance)<=Math.max(2.5,mean*0.55)){ chain.forEach(function(it){ drop[it.idx]=1; }); }
                }
                i=k+1;
              }
            });
            return segs.filter(function(_,idx){ return !drop[idx]; });
          }
          wsegs=suppressDenseCandidateWalls(wsegs);
          stageMetrics.afterDenseSuppression=wsegs.length;
          var PAD=10;
          function wbox(w){ return w.o==="h" ? [w.a-PAD, w.pos-w.thk/2-PAD, w.b+PAD, w.pos+w.thk/2+PAD] : [w.pos-w.thk/2-PAD, w.a-PAD, w.pos+w.thk/2+PAD, w.b+PAD]; }
          var bxs=wsegs.map(wbox);
          var parent=wsegs.map(function(_,i){ return i; });
          function find(x){ while(parent[x]!==x){ parent[x]=parent[parent[x]]; x=parent[x]; } return x; }
          function uni(a,b){ a=find(a); b=find(b); if(a!==b) parent[a]=b; }
          function boxIx(A,B){ return A[0]<=B[2] && B[0]<=A[2] && A[1]<=B[3] && B[1]<=A[3]; }
          for(var wi=0;wi<wsegs.length;wi++){ for(var wk=wi+1;wk<wsegs.length;wk++){ if(boxIx(bxs[wi],bxs[wk])) uni(wi,wk); } }
          var compCount={}, compBox={};
          for(var wi2=0;wi2<wsegs.length;wi2++){
            var rr=find(wi2); compCount[rr]=(compCount[rr]||0)+1;
            var B=bxs[wi2], cb=compBox[rr];
            if(!cb){ compBox[rr]=[B[0],B[1],B[2],B[3]]; }
            else { cb[0]=Math.min(cb[0],B[0]); cb[1]=Math.min(cb[1],B[1]); cb[2]=Math.max(cb[2],B[2]); cb[3]=Math.max(cb[3],B[3]); }
          }
          var MINCOMP=3; // 少於 3 根牆的孤立分量視為雜線
          var planSpanX=(pMaxX-pMinX)||vp.width||1000, planSpanY=(pMaxY-pMinY)||vp.height||1000;
          var minPlanCompW=Math.max(baseThk*18, planSpanX*0.16), minPlanCompH=Math.max(baseThk*18, planSpanY*0.08);
          function planLikeComponent(root){
            var cb=compBox[root]; if(!cb) return false;
            var cw=cb[2]-cb[0], ch=cb[3]-cb[1];
            return compCount[root]>=MINCOMP && cw>=minPlanCompW && ch>=minPlanCompH;
          }
          var keptRoots={}, droppedRoots={};
          Object.keys(compCount).forEach(function(root){ if(planLikeComponent(root)){ keptRoots[root]=1; } else { droppedRoots[root]=1; } });
          var kept=wsegs.filter(function(w,i){ return !!keptRoots[find(i)]; });
          if(kept.length>=6){ wsegs=kept; } // 若過濾後幾乎沒剩，保守不過濾
          stageMetrics.structuralPlanComponentsKept=Object.keys(keptRoots).length;
          stageMetrics.structuralTextFragmentComponentsDropped=Object.keys(droppedRoots).length;
          stageMetrics.afterConnectivity=wsegs.length;
          // P1(a) 牆角癒合：將牆端點吸附到鄰近垂直牆位置，補轉角缺口。
          var HEAL=Math.max(baseThk*3, 12);
          var Xs=[], Ys=[];
          wsegs.forEach(function(w){ if(w.o==="v") Xs.push(w.pos); else Ys.push(w.pos); });
          function snapTo(val, arr){ var best=val, bd=HEAL; for(var i=0;i<arr.length;i++){ var d=Math.abs(arr[i]-val); if(d<bd){ bd=d; best=arr[i]; } } return best; }
          wsegs.forEach(function(w){
            if(w.o==="h"){ w.a=snapTo(w.a,Xs); w.b=snapTo(w.b,Xs); }
            else { w.a=snapTo(w.a,Ys); w.b=snapTo(w.b,Ys); }
          });
          // 延伸前快照：門開口偵測以原始牆斷口為準，不受牆角封口影響。
          var wsegsRaw=wsegs.map(function(w){ return {o:w.o,pos:w.pos,a:w.a,b:w.b,thk:w.thk}; });
          // P2 牆角延伸封口：懸空端點在延伸範圍內、且垂直牆跨距確實涵蓋此端點時，延伸到該垂直牆線補角。
          // 雙軸驗證避免接錯遠牆；只延伸到「垂直」牆，不填同線門開口。
          (function extendCorners(){
            var extendMax=Math.max(baseThk*6,14);   // device-pt（約 ≤300mm）
            var vW=wsegs.filter(function(w){return w.o==="v";});
            var hW=wsegs.filter(function(w){return w.o==="h";});
            // dir=-1：w.a 只往外（更小）延伸；dir=+1：w.b 只往外（更大）延伸。只加長、不縮短，避免壓垮短牆或填內部門開口。
            function target(endVal,crossVal,perp,dir){
              var best=null,bd=extendMax;
              for(var i=0;i<perp.length;i++){ var p=perp[i];
                var d=(p.pos-endVal)*dir; if(d<=0||d>bd) continue;        // 只接受往外方向
                if(crossVal>=p.a-extendMax && crossVal<=p.b+extendMax){ bd=d; best=p.pos; }
              }
              return best;
            }
            var moved=0;
            wsegs.forEach(function(w){
              var perp=(w.o==="h")?vW:hW;
              var ta=target(w.a,w.pos,perp,-1); if(ta!==null){ w.a=ta; moved++; }
              var tb=target(w.b,w.pos,perp,+1); if(tb!==null){ w.b=tb; moved++; }
            });
            stageMetrics.cornerExtended=moved;
          })();
          // P3 轉角互接：兩垂直牆的端點彼此接近（多為「兩牆都停在角柱邊」）→ 同時往外延伸到交點，封閉轉角。
          (function closeMutualCorners(){
            var joinMax=Math.max(baseThk*10,30); // ~≤600mm，涵蓋角柱寬
            var hW=wsegs.filter(function(w){return w.o==="h";});
            var vW=wsegs.filter(function(w){return w.o==="v";});
            var moved=0;
            hW.forEach(function(h){
              vW.forEach(function(v){
                [["a",-1],["b",1]].forEach(function(he){
                  var hx=h[he[0]], hy=h.pos;
                  [["a",-1],["b",1]].forEach(function(ve){
                    var vx=v.pos, vy=v[ve[0]];
                    var dx=vx-hx, dy=hy-vy;
                    if(Math.abs(dx)>joinMax||Math.abs(dy)>joinMax) return;
                    if(dx*he[1]<0) return;   // 水平牆端點往交點是縮短 → 跳過（只往外）
                    if(dy*ve[1]<0) return;   // 垂直牆端點往交點是縮短 → 跳過（只往外）
                    if(dx===0&&dy===0) return;
                    h[he[0]]=vx; v[ve[0]]=hy; moved++;
                  });
                });
              });
            });
            stageMetrics.mutualCornersClosed=moved;
          })();
          // P3b 過柱橋接：同線兩段牆的缺口內有柱（柱打斷牆）→ 續接到相鄰段，不與門開口混淆（門缺口內無柱）。
          (function bridgeThroughColumns(){
            var base=thk||8;
            var colsPt=fills.filter(function(fl){
              if(fl.w<base*0.8||fl.h<base*0.8) return false;
              var ar=fl.w/Math.max(1,fl.h); if(ar<0.55||ar>1.85) return false;
              if(fl.w>base*16||fl.h>base*16) return false;
              return true;
            });
            function colInGap(o,pos,g1,g2){
              for(var i=0;i<colsPt.length;i++){ var c=colsPt[i];
                if(o==="h"){ if(Math.abs(c.cy-pos)<=c.h/2+2 && c.cx>=g1-2 && c.cx<=g2+2) return true; }
                else { if(Math.abs(c.cx-pos)<=c.w/2+2 && c.cy>=g1-2 && c.cy<=g2+2) return true; }
              }
              return false;
            }
            var map={};
            wsegs.forEach(function(w){ var key=w.o+'_'+Math.round(w.pos/3); (map[key]=map[key]||[]).push(w); });
            var bridged=0;
            Object.keys(map).forEach(function(k){
              var arr=map[k].slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.a-b.a;});
              for(var i=0;i+1<arr.length;i++){
                var s1=arr[i],s2=arr[i+1],gap=s2.a-s1.b;
                if(gap<=0||gap>Math.max(base*10,30)) continue;
                if(!colInGap(s1.o,(s1.pos+s2.pos)/2,s1.b,s2.a)) continue;
                s1.b=s2.a; bridged++;
              }
            });
            stageMetrics.columnBridged=bridged;
          })();
          // P3c 端點入柱：牆端點停在柱邊 → 往外延伸到柱心，完成牆柱接合。
          (function extendIntoColumns(){
            var base=thk||8;
            var colsPt=fills.filter(function(fl){
              if(fl.w<base*0.8||fl.h<base*0.8) return false;
              var ar=fl.w/Math.max(1,fl.h); if(ar<0.55||ar>1.85) return false;
              if(fl.w>base*16||fl.h>base*16) return false;
              return true;
            });
            var joined=0;
            wsegs.forEach(function(w){
              colsPt.forEach(function(c){
                var lat=(w.o==="h"?c.cy:c.cx), lon=(w.o==="h"?c.cx:c.cy);
                var latHalf=(w.o==="h"?c.h:c.w)/2, lonHalf=(w.o==="h"?c.w:c.h)/2;
                if(Math.abs(lat-w.pos)>Math.max(latHalf,(w.thk||8))+2) return; // 柱需跨在此牆線上
                var reach=lonHalf+(w.thk||8)*2+4;
                if(w.a>lon && w.a-lon<=reach){ w.a=lon; joined++; }
                if(w.b<lon && lon-w.b<=reach){ w.b=lon; joined++; }
              });
            });
            stageMetrics.wallIntoColumn=joined;
          })();
          (function dropDimensionLeaderTailSegments(){
            var base=baseThk||thk||8;
            var minTail=Math.max(base*8,60);
            var maxTail=Math.max(base*38,planSpanX*0.18);
            var nearEnd=Math.max(base*6,40);
            var nearCross=Math.max(base*4,30);
            function hasLeaderAtRightEnd(w){
              var len=w.b-w.a;
              if(w.o!=="h" || len<minTail || len>maxTail) return false;
              for(var i=0;i<Vr.length;i++){
                var v=Vr[i]; if(v.sourceKind==="beam") continue;
                var vlen=(v.b||0)-(v.a||0);
                if(Math.abs((v.pos||0)-w.b)>nearEnd) continue;
                if(w.pos<v.a-nearCross || w.pos>v.b+nearCross) continue;
                if(vlen>=Math.max(len*1.45,planSpanY*0.12,220)) return true;
              }
              return false;
            }
            var before=wsegs.length;
            wsegs=wsegs.filter(function(w){ return !hasLeaderAtRightEnd(w); });
            stageMetrics.dimensionLeaderTailSegmentsDropped=before-wsegs.length;
          })();
          var formalWsegs=wsegs;
          (function mergeOverlappingSameAxisWallFragments(){
            var base=baseThk||thk||8;
            var axisTol=Math.max(base*1.6,12);
            var touchTol=Math.max(base*2,16);
            var before=wsegs.length;
            function mergeOrientation(list,o){
              var sorted=list.slice().sort(function(a,b){
                if(Math.abs(a.pos-b.pos)>axisTol) return a.pos-b.pos;
                return a.a-b.a;
              });
              var out=[];
              sorted.forEach(function(seg){
                var merged=false;
                for(var i=0;i<out.length;i++){
                  var cur=out[i];
                  if(Math.abs(cur.pos-seg.pos)>axisTol) continue;
                  if(seg.a>cur.b+touchTol || cur.a>seg.b+touchTol) continue;
                  var curLen=Math.max(1,cur.b-cur.a), segLen=Math.max(1,seg.b-seg.a);
                  cur.pos=(cur.pos*curLen+seg.pos*segLen)/(curLen+segLen);
                  cur.a=Math.min(cur.a,seg.a);
                  cur.b=Math.max(cur.b,seg.b);
                  cur.thk=Math.max(cur.thk||0,seg.thk||0,base);
                  merged=true;
                  break;
                }
                if(!merged){ out.push({o:o,pos:seg.pos,a:seg.a,b:seg.b,thk:seg.thk}); }
              });
              return out;
            }
            var mergedH=mergeOrientation(wsegs.filter(function(w){ return w.o==="h"; }),"h");
            var mergedV=mergeOrientation(wsegs.filter(function(w){ return w.o==="v"; }),"v");
            formalWsegs=mergedH.concat(mergedV);
            stageMetrics.sameAxisWallFragmentsMerged=before-formalWsegs.length;
          })();
          var walls=[];
          formalWsegs.forEach(function(w){
            var t=Math.max(60,Math.round(w.thk*F));
            var gid="pdf-wall-group-"+(walls.length+1);
            if(w.o==="h"){ walls.push({id:"pdf-structural-wall-"+(walls.length+1),groupId:gid,importGroupId:gid,closureEligible:true,x1:w.a*F,y1:w.pos*F,x2:w.b*F,y2:w.pos*F,thickness:t,type:"solid_partition",status:"existing",sourceDisplayMode:"pdf-source-boundary",decorativeBodyFillHiddenDefault:true}); }
            else{ walls.push({id:"pdf-structural-wall-"+(walls.length+1),groupId:gid,importGroupId:gid,closureEligible:true,x1:w.pos*F,y1:w.a*F,x2:w.pos*F,y2:w.b*F,thickness:t,type:"solid_partition",status:"existing",sourceDisplayMode:"pdf-source-boundary",decorativeBodyFillHiddenDefault:true}); }
          });

          // 填色方塊＝標柱（近方形、尺寸介於牆厚與圖框之間，且必須靠近牆＝在牆角/交點）
          var pageW=(pMaxX-pMinX)||1, pageH=(pMaxY-pMinY)||1, base=thk||8;
          var wboxes=wsegs.map(wbox), COLNEAR=Math.max(base*8,40);
          function nearWall(px,py){
            for(var q=0;q<wboxes.length;q++){ var B=wboxes[q];
              var ddx=Math.max(B[0]-px,0,px-B[2]), ddy=Math.max(B[1]-py,0,py-B[3]);
              if(ddx*ddx+ddy*ddy<=COLNEAR*COLNEAR) return true;
            }
            return false;
          }
          var filledWallBodiesBeforePlanFilter=filledWallBodies.length;
          filledWallBodies=filledWallBodies.filter(function(item){
            var cx=((Number(item.xMm)||0)+(Number(item.widthMm)||0)/2)/F;
            var cy=((Number(item.yMm)||0)+(Number(item.heightMm)||0)/2)/F;
            return nearWall(cx,cy);
          });
          stageMetrics.filledWallBodiesOutsidePlanDropped=filledWallBodiesBeforePlanFilter-filledWallBodies.length;
          var cols=[], seen={};
          fills.forEach(function(fl){
            if(fl.w<base*0.8 || fl.h<base*0.8) return;
            var ar=fl.w/Math.max(1,fl.h); if(ar<0.55||ar>1.85) return;
            if(fl.w>pageW*0.25 || fl.h>pageH*0.25) return;
            if(fl.w>base*16 || fl.h>base*16) return;
            if(!nearWall(fl.cx,fl.cy)) return; // 孤立填色（圖例、色塊）丟棄
            var key=Math.round(fl.cx/6)+"_"+Math.round(fl.cy/6); if(seen[key])return; seen[key]=1;
            cols.push({id:"pdf-source-column-"+(cols.length+1),x:fl.cx*F,y:fl.cy*F,widthMm:Math.max(120,Math.round(fl.w*F)),depthMm:Math.max(120,Math.round(fl.h*F)),sourceDisplayMode:"pdf-source-boundary",decorativeBodyFillHiddenDefault:true});
          });
          if(cols.length>240) cols.length=240;
          (function dropDimensionTailWalls(){
            if(!cols.length || !walls.length) return;
            function columnRightNearY(y){
              var best=null;
              cols.forEach(function(c){
                var cy=Number(c.y)||0, halfH=Math.max(80,(Number(c.depthMm)||0)/2);
                if(Math.abs(cy-y)>Math.max(220,halfH*3.2)) return;
                var right=(Number(c.x)||0)+(Number(c.widthMm)||0)/2;
                if(best===null || right>best) best=right;
              });
              return best;
            }
            var dropped=0;
            walls=walls.filter(function(w){
              if(Math.abs((Number(w.y1)||0)-(Number(w.y2)||0))>2) return true;
              var x0=Math.min(Number(w.x1)||0,Number(w.x2)||0), x1=Math.max(Number(w.x1)||0,Number(w.x2)||0);
              var y=((Number(w.y1)||0)+(Number(w.y2)||0))/2;
              var colRight=columnRightNearY(y);
              if(colRight===null) return true;
              var tolerance=Math.max(90,(Number(w.thickness)||60)*1.2);
              var outward=Math.max(90,(Number(w.thickness)||60)*1.35);
              if(x0>=colRight-tolerance && x0<=colRight+tolerance && x1>colRight+outward){ dropped++; return false; }
              return true;
            });
            stageMetrics.dimensionTailWallsDropped=dropped;
          })();
          // P(B) 門窗開口候選：同一牆中心線被斷開＝門/窗開口。以共線斷口產生可檢視/編輯的門窗開口候選。
          var openingCandidates=(function detectOpenings(){
            var out=[];
            var spanShort=Math.min((pMaxX-pMinX)||1000,(pMaxY-pMinY)||1000);
            var minGap=Math.max((thk||8)*1.5,10);
            var maxGap=Math.min(spanShort*0.35,130);   // 約 ≤2600mm，超過視為兩道分開的牆
            var minFlank=Math.max(OVMIN,(thk||8)*3);    // 斷口兩側需有實牆
            var map={};
            wsegsRaw.forEach(function(w){ var key=w.o+'_'+Math.round(w.pos/3); (map[key]=map[key]||[]).push(w); });
            Object.keys(map).forEach(function(k){
              var arr=map[k].slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.a-b.a;});
              for(var i=0;i+1<arr.length;i++){
                var s1=arr[i], s2=arr[i+1];
                var gap=s2.a-s1.b;
                if(gap<minGap||gap>maxGap) continue;
                if((s1.b-s1.a)<minFlank||(s2.b-s2.a)<minFlank) continue;
                var o=s1.o, pos=(s1.pos+s2.pos)/2, tk=Math.max(s1.thk||0,s2.thk||0)||(thk||8);
                var box=o==="h" ? {x0:s1.b,y0:pos-tk/2,x1:s2.a,y1:pos+tk/2}
                                : {x0:pos-tk/2,y0:s1.b,x1:pos+tk/2,y1:s2.a};
                out.push({
                  id:"pdf-opening-review-"+(out.length+1),
                  category:"openingReview",
                  orientation:o,
                  xMm:Math.round(box.x0*F), yMm:Math.round(box.y0*F),
                  widthMm:Math.max(20,Math.round((box.x1-box.x0)*F)),
                  heightMm:Math.max(20,Math.round((box.y1-box.y0)*F)),
                  openingWidthMm:Math.round(gap*F)
                });
                if(out.length>=80) break;
              }
            });
            return out;
          })();
          // 門開弧去重（同位置多段弧合併）
          var doorSwingCandidates=(function(){
            var out=[], seen={};
            doorArcs.forEach(function(d){
              var key=Math.round(d.cx/8)+"_"+Math.round(d.cy/8);
              if(seen[key]) return; seen[key]=1;
              out.push({
                id:"pdf-door-swing-"+(out.length+1),
                category:"doorSwingReview",
                xMm:Math.round((d.cx-d.w/2)*F), yMm:Math.round((d.cy-d.h/2)*F),
                widthMm:Math.max(20,Math.round(d.w*F)), heightMm:Math.max(20,Math.round(d.h*F)),
                pointsMm:(d.pts||[]).map(function(p){ return [Math.round(p[0]*F), Math.round(p[1]*F)]; })
              });
            });
            return out.slice(0,60);
          })();
          // 門弧配對補開口：門弧貼著某道牆、但該處沒有偵測到牆斷口 → 依弧弦長補一個門開口候選。
          (function pairArcOpenings(){
            function overlapsExisting(o,posMm,aMm,bMm){
              for(var i=0;i<openingCandidates.length;i++){ var oc=openingCandidates[i];
                if(oc.orientation!==o) continue;
                var ocPos=o==="h"?oc.yMm+oc.heightMm/2:oc.xMm+oc.widthMm/2;
                if(Math.abs(ocPos-posMm)>200) continue;
                var oa=o==="h"?oc.xMm:oc.yMm, ob=oa+(o==="h"?oc.widthMm:oc.heightMm);
                if(Math.min(ob,bMm)-Math.max(oa,aMm)>0) return true;
              }
              return false;
            }
            var added=0;
            doorSwingCandidates.forEach(function(dc){
              var ax=dc.xMm, ay=dc.yMm, aw=dc.widthMm, ah=dc.heightMm;
              var best=null,bd=1e9;
              wsegs.forEach(function(w){
                var posMm=w.pos*F, aMm=w.a*F, bMm=w.b*F, thkMm=Math.max((w.thk||8)*F,120);
                if(w.o==="h"){
                  var d=Math.min(Math.abs(posMm-ay),Math.abs(posMm-(ay+ah)));
                  var ov=Math.min(bMm,ax+aw)-Math.max(aMm,ax);
                  if(d<=thkMm+140 && ov>=aw*0.5 && d<bd){ bd=d; best={o:"h",posMm:posMm,a:ax,b:ax+aw}; }
                } else {
                  var d2=Math.min(Math.abs(posMm-ax),Math.abs(posMm-(ax+aw)));
                  var ov2=Math.min(bMm,ay+ah)-Math.max(aMm,ay);
                  if(d2<=thkMm+140 && ov2>=ah*0.5 && d2<bd){ bd=d2; best={o:"v",posMm:posMm,a:ay,b:ay+ah}; }
                }
              });
              if(!best) return;
              if(overlapsExisting(best.o,best.posMm,best.a,best.b)) return;
              var t=160;
              openingCandidates.push({
                id:"pdf-opening-review-arc-"+(++added),
                category:"openingReview",
                orientation:best.o,
                xMm: best.o==="h"?Math.round(best.a):Math.round(best.posMm-t/2),
                yMm: best.o==="h"?Math.round(best.posMm-t/2):Math.round(best.a),
                widthMm: best.o==="h"?Math.round(best.b-best.a):t,
                heightMm: best.o==="h"?t:Math.round(best.b-best.a),
                openingWidthMm:Math.round(best.b-best.a),
                fromDoorArc:true
              });
            });
            stageMetrics.arcPairedOpenings=added;
          })();
          function buildPdfVectorScene(){
            var hatchOrNoise=buildIgnoredHatchNoiseBoxes();
            var glyphClusters=[], seenGlyph={};
            fills.forEach(function(fl){
              if(glyphClusters.length>=720) return;
              var lo=Math.min(fl.w,fl.h), hi=Math.max(fl.w,fl.h), area=Math.max(0,fl.w*fl.h);
              if(lo<1.2 || hi<2.4 || hi>42 || area>900) return;
              if(hi>=lo*2.5 && lo>=base*0.4 && lo<=base*4 && hi>=OVMIN) return;
              var key=Math.round(fl.cx/3)+"_"+Math.round(fl.cy/3)+"_"+Math.round(fl.w)+"_"+Math.round(fl.h);
              if(seenGlyph[key]) return; seenGlyph[key]=1;
              glyphClusters.push(rectToReviewBox("pdf-glyph-cluster-"+(glyphClusters.length+1),"glyphCluster",fl,{glyphOnly:true,decoded:false}));
            });
            function lineReviewBox(l,pad){
              pad=pad||80;
              var x0=Math.min(l.x1Mm,l.x2Mm)-pad, y0=Math.min(l.y1Mm,l.y2Mm)-pad;
              var x1=Math.max(l.x1Mm,l.x2Mm)+pad, y1=Math.max(l.y1Mm,l.y2Mm)+pad;
              return {xMm:Math.round(x0),yMm:Math.round(y0),widthMm:Math.max(20,Math.round(x1-x0)),heightMm:Math.max(20,Math.round(y1-y0))};
            }
            function wallReviewBox(w,i){
              var pad=Math.max(80,Math.round((w.thickness||60)*0.8));
              var x0=Math.min(w.x1,w.x2)-pad, y0=Math.min(w.y1,w.y2)-pad;
              var x1=Math.max(w.x1,w.x2)+pad, y1=Math.max(w.y1,w.y2)+pad;
              return {id:w.groupId||("pdf-wall-group-"+(i+1)),category:"wallGroup",groupKind:"wallGroup",wallIds:[w.id||("pdf-structural-wall-"+(i+1))],closureEligible:true,xMm:Math.round(x0),yMm:Math.round(y0),widthMm:Math.max(20,Math.round(x1-x0)),heightMm:Math.max(20,Math.round(y1-y0)),reviewStatus:"reference",source:"pdf-vector",selectable:true};
            }
            function cloneWithGroup(item, gid, kind){ return Object.assign({}, item, {referenceGroupId:gid,groupKind:kind}); }
            var stairReferenceLines=pdfReviewLines.filter(function(l){ return l.category==="stairReference"; });
            var hatchOrNoiseLines=pdfReviewLines.filter(function(l){ return l.category==="hatchOrNoise"; });
            // 樓梯只保留來源線條；不建立可選取、可編輯或可計價的群組圖塊。
            var stairGroups=[];
            var beamReferenceLines=pdfReviewLines.filter(function(l){ return l.category==="beamReference"; });
            var beamGroups=[];
            if(beamReferenceLines.length){
              var bx0=Infinity, by0=Infinity, bx1=-Infinity, by1=-Infinity;
              beamReferenceLines.forEach(function(l){ bx0=Math.min(bx0,l.x1Mm,l.x2Mm); by0=Math.min(by0,l.y1Mm,l.y2Mm); bx1=Math.max(bx1,l.x1Mm,l.x2Mm); by1=Math.max(by1,l.y1Mm,l.y2Mm); });
              beamGroups.push({id:"pdf-beam-group-source-1",category:"beamGroup",kind:"beamGroup",groupKind:"beamGroup",lineIds:beamReferenceLines.map(function(l){return l.id;}),lineCount:beamReferenceLines.length,xMm:Math.round(bx0-100),yMm:Math.round(by0-100),widthMm:Math.max(20,Math.round(bx1-bx0+200)),heightMm:Math.max(20,Math.round(by1-by0+200)),reviewStatus:"reference",source:"pdf-vector",selectable:true,closureEligible:false,dashed:true});
            }
            function doorWindowItemBox(item){
              var x=Number(item.xMm)||0, y=Number(item.yMm)||0, w=Math.max(1,Number(item.widthMm)||0), h=Math.max(1,Number(item.heightMm)||0);
              return {x0:x,y0:y,x1:x+w,y1:y+h,cx:x+w/2,cy:y+h/2,width:w,height:h};
            }
            function doorWindowBoxesRelated(anchor,candidate){
              var a=doorWindowItemBox(anchor), b=doorWindowItemBox(candidate);
              var sameOrientation=!anchor.orientation || !candidate.orientation || anchor.orientation===candidate.orientation;
              if(!sameOrientation) return false;
              var axis=anchor.orientation||candidate.orientation||(a.width>=a.height?"h":"v");
              var span=Math.max(a.width,a.height,b.width,b.height,250);
              var anchorSpan=axis==="v"?a.height:a.width;
              var candidateSpan=axis==="v"?b.height:b.width;
              var spanOverlap=axis==="v" ? Math.min(a.y1,b.y1)-Math.max(a.y0,b.y0) : Math.min(a.x1,b.x1)-Math.max(a.x0,b.x0);
              var crossDistance=axis==="v" ? Math.abs(a.cx-b.cx) : Math.abs(a.cy-b.cy);
              var centerDistance=Math.hypot(a.cx-b.cx,a.cy-b.cy);
              var candidateCategory=candidate.category||"";
              if(candidateCategory==="doorSwingReview"){
                var swingCrossLimit=Math.max(360,Math.min(780,span*0.65));
                var swingOverlapLimit=Math.max(80,Math.min(anchorSpan,candidateSpan)*0.25);
                var swingDistanceLimit=Math.max(650,Math.min(1300,anchorSpan+candidateSpan*0.55));
                return crossDistance<=swingCrossLimit && (spanOverlap>=swingOverlapLimit || centerDistance<=swingDistanceLimit);
              }
              if(candidateCategory==="windowSymbolReview"){
                var windowOverlapLimit=Math.max(160,Math.min(anchorSpan,candidateSpan)*0.55);
                var windowCrossLimit=Math.max(220,Math.min(520,span*0.28));
                return crossDistance<=windowCrossLimit && spanOverlap>=windowOverlapLimit;
              }
              var pad=Math.max(180,Math.min(620,span*0.55));
              var overlapX=Math.min(a.x1+pad,b.x1)-Math.max(a.x0-pad,b.x0);
              var overlapY=Math.min(a.y1+pad,b.y1)-Math.max(a.y0-pad,b.y0);
              return overlapX>0 && overlapY>0;
            }
            function makeDoorWindowGroup(members, index){
              var gid="pdf-door-window-group-"+index;
              var x0=Infinity,y0=Infinity,x1=-Infinity,y1=-Infinity,cats={};
              members.forEach(function(item){
                var b=doorWindowItemBox(item);
                x0=Math.min(x0,b.x0); y0=Math.min(y0,b.y0); x1=Math.max(x1,b.x1); y1=Math.max(y1,b.y1);
                cats[item.category||"doorWindowEvidence"]=true;
                item.referenceGroupId=gid;
                item.groupKind="doorWindowGroup";
              });
              return {id:gid,category:"doorWindowGroup",kind:"doorWindowGroup",groupKind:"doorWindowGroup",shapeIds:members.map(function(item){return item.id;}),shapeCount:members.length,memberCategories:Object.keys(cats),xMm:Math.round(x0),yMm:Math.round(y0),widthMm:Math.max(20,Math.round(x1-x0)),heightMm:Math.max(20,Math.round(y1-y0)),reviewStatus:"candidate",source:"pdf-vector",selectable:true,closureEligible:false};
            }
            function buildDoorWindowReviewGroups(openings, swings, windows){
              var groups=[], assigned={};
              var related=swings.concat(windows);
              openings.forEach(function(opening){
                if(assigned[opening.id]) return;
                var members=[opening]; assigned[opening.id]=true;
                related.forEach(function(candidate){
                  if(assigned[candidate.id]) return;
                  if(doorWindowBoxesRelated(opening,candidate)){ members.push(candidate); assigned[candidate.id]=true; }
                });
                groups.push(makeDoorWindowGroup(members,groups.length+1));
              });
              related.forEach(function(candidate){
                if(assigned[candidate.id]) return;
                groups.push(makeDoorWindowGroup([candidate],groups.length+1));
                assigned[candidate.id]=true;
              });
              return groups;
            }
            var openingReviewItems=openingCandidates.map(function(item){ return cloneWithGroup(item,null,"doorWindowGroup"); });
            var doorSwingReviewItems=doorSwingCandidates.map(function(item){ return cloneWithGroup(item,null,"doorWindowGroup"); });
            var windowReviewItems=windowCandidates.map(function(item){ return cloneWithGroup(item,null,"doorWindowGroup"); });
            var doorWindowGroups=buildDoorWindowReviewGroups(openingReviewItems,doorSwingReviewItems,windowReviewItems);
            var columnReviewItems=cols.map(function(c,i){ return {id:"pdf-column-review-"+(i+1),category:"column",referenceGroupId:"pdf-column-group-"+(i+1),groupKind:"columnGroup",xMm:Math.round(c.x-c.widthMm/2),yMm:Math.round(c.y-c.depthMm/2),widthMm:Math.round(c.widthMm),heightMm:Math.round(c.depthMm)}; }).slice(0,240);
            var columnGroups=columnReviewItems.map(function(c){ return {id:c.referenceGroupId,category:"columnGroup",kind:"columnGroup",groupKind:"columnGroup",shapeIds:[c.id],shapeCount:1,xMm:c.xMm,yMm:c.yMm,widthMm:c.widthMm,heightMm:c.heightMm,reviewStatus:"reference",source:"pdf-vector",selectable:true,closureEligible:false}; });
            var wallGroups=walls.map(wallReviewBox).slice(0,420);
            var dimensionLineCount=0, leaderLineCount=0;
            pdfReviewLines.forEach(function(l){ if(l.category==="leaderLine") leaderLineCount++; else if(l.category==="dimensionLine") dimensionLineCount++; });
            return {
              structuralWalls:walls.map(function(w,i){ return {id:w.id||("pdf-structural-wall-"+(i+1)),category:"structuralWall",groupId:w.groupId,importGroupId:w.importGroupId,closureEligible:true,x1Mm:Math.round(w.x1),y1Mm:Math.round(w.y1),x2Mm:Math.round(w.x2),y2Mm:Math.round(w.y2),thicknessMm:Math.round(w.thickness||60)}; }).slice(0,420),
              wallGroups:wallGroups,
              filledWallBodies:filledWallBodies,
              openingReviews:openingReviewItems,
              doorSwingReviews:doorSwingReviewItems,
              windowSymbolReviews:windowReviewItems,
              doorWindowGroups:doorWindowGroups,
              columns:columnReviewItems,
              columnGroups:columnGroups,
              beamReferenceLines:beamReferenceLines,
              beamGroups:beamGroups,
              stairReferenceLines:stairReferenceLines,
              stairGroups:stairGroups,
              hatchOrNoiseLines:hatchOrNoiseLines,
              dimensionLines:pdfReviewLines.filter(function(l){ return l.category==="dimensionLine"; }),
              leaderLines:pdfReviewLines.filter(function(l){ return l.category==="leaderLine"; }),
              hatchOrNoise:hatchOrNoise,
              glyphClusters:[],
              glyphClustersForText:glyphClusters,
              summary:{
                structuralWallCount:walls.length,
                filledWallBodyCount:filledWallBodies.length,
                openingReviewCount:openingCandidates.length,
                doorSwingReviewCount:doorSwingCandidates.length,
                windowSymbolCount:windowCandidates.length,
                columnCount:cols.length,
                wallGroupCount:wallGroups.length,
                columnGroupCount:columnGroups.length,
                beamReferenceLineCount:beamReferenceLines.length,
                beamGroupCount:beamGroups.length,
                doorWindowGroupCount:doorWindowGroups.length,
                stairGroupCount:stairGroups.length,
                dimensionLineCount:dimensionLineCount,
                leaderLineCount:leaderLineCount,
                stairReferenceLineCount:stairReferenceLines.length,
                hatchOrNoiseLineCount:hatchOrNoiseLines.length,
                hatchOrNoiseCount:hatchOrNoise.length,
                hatchDroppedLineCount:(hatchDroppedH.length+hatchDroppedV.length+thinHatchDroppedH.length+thinHatchDroppedV.length+noiseDroppedH.length+noiseDroppedV.length),
                glyphClusterCount:0,
                rawGlyphClusterCount:glyphClusters.length,
                glyphDecodeStatus:"glyph_candidates_only"
              }
            };
          }
          var wallCollinearRuns=[]; // 與牆共線的細線＝窗玻璃線候選（回收供窗符號偵測）
          function buildPdfReviewLines(){
            var out=[], seenLine={};
            function lineBox(r,o){
              var pad=4;
              return o==="h" ? [r.a-pad,r.pos-pad,r.b+pad,r.pos+pad] : [r.pos-pad,r.a-pad,r.pos+pad,r.b+pad];
            }
            function sourceRunKey(r,o){
              return [o,Math.round(r.pos*10),Math.round(r.a*10),Math.round(r.b*10)].join(":");
            }
            var stairSourceRunKeys={};
            stairTreadRuns.forEach(function(r){ stairSourceRunKeys[sourceRunKey(r,r.o||"h")]=true; });
            function overlapLength(a0,a1,b0,b1){ return Math.max(0,Math.min(a1,b1)-Math.max(a0,b0)); }
            function classifyBodyDerivedRun(r,o){
              if(!r || r.sourceKind==="beam" || r.dash) return null;
              var len=Math.max(0.001,Math.abs(r.b-r.a));
              for(var wi=0;wi<wsegs.length;wi++){
                var w=wsegs[wi], half=Math.max(3,(Number(w.thk)||baseThk||8)/2+3);
                if(w.o===o){
                  var parallelOverlap=overlapLength(r.a,r.b,w.a,w.b);
                  if(Math.abs(r.pos-w.pos)<=half && parallelOverlap/Math.min(len,Math.max(1,w.b-w.a))>=0.62){
                    return {classification:"wall_body_fill_derived",reason:"parallel_run_inside_source_wall_body",sourceBodyId:"pdf-source-wall-body-"+(wi+1),features:{orientationMatch:true,bodyHalfWidthPt:Number(half.toFixed(3)),overlapRatio:Number((parallelOverlap/Math.min(len,Math.max(1,w.b-w.a))).toFixed(3)),thresholdOverlapRatio:0.62}};
                  }
                } else if(o==="h" && w.o==="v"){
                  var crossH=overlapLength(r.a,r.b,w.pos-half,w.pos+half);
                  if(r.pos>=w.a-half && r.pos<=w.b+half && crossH/Math.min(len,half*2)>=0.68){
                    return {classification:"wall_body_fill_derived",reason:"cross_run_inside_source_wall_body",sourceBodyId:"pdf-source-wall-body-"+(wi+1),features:{orientationMatch:false,bodyHalfWidthPt:Number(half.toFixed(3)),bodyCoverageRatio:Number((crossH/Math.min(len,half*2)).toFixed(3)),thresholdBodyCoverageRatio:0.68}};
                  }
                } else if(o==="v" && w.o==="h"){
                  var crossV=overlapLength(r.a,r.b,w.pos-half,w.pos+half);
                  if(r.pos>=w.a-half && r.pos<=w.b+half && crossV/Math.min(len,half*2)>=0.68){
                    return {classification:"wall_body_fill_derived",reason:"cross_run_inside_source_wall_body",sourceBodyId:"pdf-source-wall-body-"+(wi+1),features:{orientationMatch:false,bodyHalfWidthPt:Number(half.toFixed(3)),bodyCoverageRatio:Number((crossV/Math.min(len,half*2)).toFixed(3)),thresholdBodyCoverageRatio:0.68}};
                  }
                }
              }
              for(var ci=0;ci<cols.length;ci++){
                var c=cols[ci], cx=(Number(c.x)||0)/F, cy=(Number(c.y)||0)/F;
                var hw=Math.max(2,(Number(c.widthMm)||0)/F/2), hh=Math.max(2,(Number(c.depthMm)||0)/F/2);
                var fixedInside=o==="h" ? (r.pos>=cy-hh-3 && r.pos<=cy+hh+3) : (r.pos>=cx-hw-3 && r.pos<=cx+hw+3);
                var axisOverlap=o==="h" ? overlapLength(r.a,r.b,cx-hw-3,cx+hw+3) : overlapLength(r.a,r.b,cy-hh-3,cy+hh+3);
                if(fixedInside && axisOverlap/len>=0.65){
                  return {classification:"column_body_fill_derived",reason:"run_inside_source_column_body",sourceBodyId:c.id||("pdf-source-column-"+(ci+1)),features:{bodyCoverageRatio:Number((axisOverlap/len).toFixed(3)),thresholdBodyCoverageRatio:0.65}};
                }
              }
              return null;
            }
            // 只在「與同向牆共線重疊（真重複）」時排除；橫跨或垂直接牆的尺寸線/樓梯級保留。
            // 被排除的共線段回收到 wallCollinearRuns——那正是窗戶玻璃線的訊號。
            function overlapsWall(r,o){
              for(var i=0;i<wsegs.length;i++){ var w=wsegs[i];
                if(w.o!==o) continue;
                if(Math.abs(w.pos-r.pos) > ((w.thk||8)/2 + 6)) continue;
                var ov=Math.min(r.b,w.b)-Math.max(r.a,w.a);
                var minLen=Math.max(1,Math.min(r.b-r.a, w.b-w.a));
                if(ov>0 && ov/minLen>=0.5){
                  if(wallCollinearRuns.length<400){
                    wallCollinearRuns.push({o:o,pos:w.pos,thk:w.thk||8,wa:w.a,wb:w.b,a:Math.max(r.a,w.a),b:Math.min(r.b,w.b)});
                  }
                  return true;
                }
              }
              return false;
            }
            function addRun(r,o,idx,cat,extra){
              var len=Math.abs(r.b-r.a);
              if(!(len>=MINLEN)) return;
              if(!r.dash && overlapsWall(r,o)) return; // 虛線不做共線去重（不回收成窗、不與牆比對）
              var key=o+"_"+Math.round(r.pos)+"_"+Math.round(r.a)+"_"+Math.round(r.b)+(r.dash?"_d":"");
              if(seenLine[key]) return; seenLine[key]=1;
              if(out.length>=700) return;
              var category=cat || (r.sourceKind==="beam" ? "beamReference" : (o==="h" ? "dimensionLine" : "leaderLine"));
              var lineExtra=Object.assign({}, extra||{});
              if(r.sourceKind==="beam"){
                lineExtra.groupKind="beamGroup";
                lineExtra.referenceGroupId="pdf-beam-group-source-1";
                lineExtra.sourceKind="beam";
              }
              var item=o==="h"
                ? {id:"pdf-review-line-h-"+idx,category:category,sourceDash:!!r.dash,x1Mm:Math.round(r.a*F),y1Mm:Math.round(r.pos*F),x2Mm:Math.round(r.b*F),y2Mm:Math.round(r.pos*F)}
                : {id:"pdf-review-line-v-"+idx,category:category,sourceDash:!!r.dash,x1Mm:Math.round(r.pos*F),y1Mm:Math.round(r.a*F),x2Mm:Math.round(r.pos*F),y2Mm:Math.round(r.b*F)};
              Object.assign(item, lineExtra);
              out.push(item);
            }
            Hr.forEach(function(r,i){ addRun(r,"h",i+1); });
            Vr.forEach(function(r,i){ addRun(r,"v",i+1); });
            thinHr.forEach(function(r,i){ addRun(r,"h",1000+i+1); });
            thinVr.forEach(function(r,i){ addRun(r,"v",1000+i+1); });
            stairTreadRuns.forEach(function(r,i){
              addRun(r,r.o||"h",6000+i+1,"stairReference",{
                stairEvidence:r.stairEvidence||"tread-chain",
                stairFeatures:r.stairFeatures||null,
                hiddenDefault:false,
                reviewOnly:true,
                objectState:"evidence_marker",
                sourceClassification:"source_stair_paired_flight_correspondence_supported",
                reason:"regular_tread_chain_with_opposed_stringers_and_verified_paired_flight_landing_relation"
              });
            });
            // 虛線只在可判定為必要類別時保留；梁/隱藏線雜訊不載入、不進牆、不回收成窗。
            // hatch 依規格完全不載入（不再回收）。
            return out;
          }
          function buildPdfReviewLinesSourceAware(){
            var out=[], seenLine={}, stairSourceRunKeys={};
            function runKey(r,o){ return [o,Math.round(r.pos*10),Math.round(r.a*10),Math.round(r.b*10)].join(":"); }
            function overlapLength(a0,a1,b0,b1){ return Math.max(0,Math.min(a1,b1)-Math.max(a0,b0)); }
            stairTreadRuns.forEach(function(r){ stairSourceRunKeys[runKey(r,r.o||"h")]=true; });
            function recordWallCollinear(r,o){
              var matched=false;
              for(var i=0;i<wsegs.length;i++){ var w=wsegs[i];
                if(w.o!==o) continue;
                if(Math.abs(w.pos-r.pos)>((w.thk||8)/2+6)) continue;
                var ov=Math.min(r.b,w.b)-Math.max(r.a,w.a), minLen=Math.max(1,Math.min(r.b-r.a,w.b-w.a));
                if(ov>0 && ov/minLen>=0.5){
                  matched=true;
                  if(wallCollinearRuns.length<400){ wallCollinearRuns.push({o:o,pos:w.pos,thk:w.thk||8,wa:w.a,wb:w.b,a:Math.max(r.a,w.a),b:Math.min(r.b,w.b)}); }
                  break;
                }
              }
              return matched;
            }
            function classifyBodyRun(r,o){
              if(!r || r.sourceKind==="beam" || r.dash) return null;
              var len=Math.max(0.001,Math.abs(r.b-r.a));
              for(var wi=0;wi<wsegs.length;wi++){
                var w=wsegs[wi], half=Math.max(3,(Number(w.thk)||baseThk||8)/2+3);
                if(w.o===o){
                  var parallelOverlap=overlapLength(r.a,r.b,w.a,w.b), parallelRatio=parallelOverlap/Math.min(len,Math.max(1,w.b-w.a));
                  if(Math.abs(r.pos-w.pos)<=half && parallelRatio>=0.62){
                    return {classification:"wall_body_fill_derived",reason:"parallel_run_inside_source_wall_body",sourceBodyId:"pdf-source-wall-body-"+(wi+1),features:{orientationMatch:true,bodyHalfWidthPt:Number(half.toFixed(3)),overlapRatio:Number(parallelRatio.toFixed(3)),thresholdOverlapRatio:0.62}};
                  }
                } else if(o==="h" && w.o==="v"){
                  var crossH=overlapLength(r.a,r.b,w.pos-half,w.pos+half), crossHRatio=crossH/Math.min(len,half*2);
                  if(r.pos>=w.a-half && r.pos<=w.b+half && crossHRatio>=0.68){
                    return {classification:"wall_body_fill_derived",reason:"cross_run_inside_source_wall_body",sourceBodyId:"pdf-source-wall-body-"+(wi+1),features:{orientationMatch:false,bodyHalfWidthPt:Number(half.toFixed(3)),bodyCoverageRatio:Number(crossHRatio.toFixed(3)),thresholdBodyCoverageRatio:0.68}};
                  }
                } else if(o==="v" && w.o==="h"){
                  var crossV=overlapLength(r.a,r.b,w.pos-half,w.pos+half), crossVRatio=crossV/Math.min(len,half*2);
                  if(r.pos>=w.a-half && r.pos<=w.b+half && crossVRatio>=0.68){
                    return {classification:"wall_body_fill_derived",reason:"cross_run_inside_source_wall_body",sourceBodyId:"pdf-source-wall-body-"+(wi+1),features:{orientationMatch:false,bodyHalfWidthPt:Number(half.toFixed(3)),bodyCoverageRatio:Number(crossVRatio.toFixed(3)),thresholdBodyCoverageRatio:0.68}};
                  }
                }
              }
              for(var ci=0;ci<cols.length;ci++){
                var c=cols[ci], cx=(Number(c.x)||0)/F, cy=(Number(c.y)||0)/F;
                var hw=Math.max(2,(Number(c.widthMm)||0)/F/2), hh=Math.max(2,(Number(c.depthMm)||0)/F/2);
                var fixedInside=o==="h" ? (r.pos>=cy-hh-3 && r.pos<=cy+hh+3) : (r.pos>=cx-hw-3 && r.pos<=cx+hw+3);
                var axisOverlap=o==="h" ? overlapLength(r.a,r.b,cx-hw-3,cx+hw+3) : overlapLength(r.a,r.b,cy-hh-3,cy+hh+3);
                var columnRatio=axisOverlap/len;
                if(fixedInside && columnRatio>=0.65){
                  return {classification:"column_body_fill_derived",reason:"run_inside_source_column_body",sourceBodyId:c.id||("pdf-source-column-"+(ci+1)),features:{bodyCoverageRatio:Number(columnRatio.toFixed(3)),thresholdBodyCoverageRatio:0.65}};
                }
              }
              return null;
            }
            function addRun(r,o,sourceId,category,extra){
              var len=Math.abs(r.b-r.a);
              if(!(len>=MINLEN) || out.length>=1200) return;
              var key=runKey(r,o)+(r.dash?":dash":"");
              if(seenLine[key]) return;
              seenLine[key]=true;
              var lineExtra=Object.assign({},extra||{}), bodyClassification=null;
              if(!category && r.sourceKind!=="beam") bodyClassification=classifyBodyRun(r,o);
              if(!r.dash && r.sourceKind!=="beam"){
                var wallCollinear=recordWallCollinear(r,o);
                if(wallCollinear && !bodyClassification){ bodyClassification={classification:"wall_body_fill_derived",reason:"collinear_run_inside_source_wall_body",sourceBodyId:null,features:{orientationMatch:true,thresholdOverlapRatio:0.5}}; }
              }
              var finalCategory=bodyClassification ? "hatchOrNoise" : (category || (r.sourceKind==="beam" ? "beamReference" : (o==="h" ? "dimensionLine" : "leaderLine")));
              if(bodyClassification){
                lineExtra.hiddenDefault=true;
                lineExtra.objectState="ignored_object";
                lineExtra.sourceClassification=bodyClassification.classification;
                lineExtra.classificationReason=bodyClassification.reason;
                lineExtra.sourceBodyId=bodyClassification.sourceBodyId;
                lineExtra.classifierFeatures=bodyClassification.features;
              }
              if(r.sourceKind==="beam"){
                lineExtra.groupKind="beamGroup";
                lineExtra.referenceGroupId="pdf-beam-group-source-1";
                lineExtra.sourceKind="beam";
              }
              var item=o==="h"
                ? {id:sourceId,sourceId:sourceId,category:finalCategory,sourceDash:!!r.dash,x1Mm:Math.round(r.a*F),y1Mm:Math.round(r.pos*F),x2Mm:Math.round(r.b*F),y2Mm:Math.round(r.pos*F)}
                : {id:sourceId,sourceId:sourceId,category:finalCategory,sourceDash:!!r.dash,x1Mm:Math.round(r.pos*F),y1Mm:Math.round(r.a*F),x2Mm:Math.round(r.pos*F),y2Mm:Math.round(r.b*F)};
              Object.assign(item,lineExtra);
              out.push(item);
            }
            Hr.forEach(function(r,i){ addRun(r,"h","pdf-review-line-h-"+(i+1)); });
            Vr.forEach(function(r,i){ addRun(r,"v","pdf-review-line-v-"+(i+1)); });
            thinHr.forEach(function(r,i){ addRun(r,"h","pdf-review-line-h-thin-"+(i+1)); });
            thinVr.forEach(function(r,i){ addRun(r,"v","pdf-review-line-v-thin-"+(i+1)); });
            stairTreadRuns.forEach(function(r,i){
              addRun(r,r.o||"h","pdf-stair-tread-source-"+(i+1),"stairReference",{
                stairEvidence:r.stairEvidence||"tread-chain",
                stairFeatures:r.stairFeatures||null,
                hiddenDefault:false,
                reviewOnly:true,
                objectState:"evidence_marker",
                sourceClassification:"source_stair_paired_flight_correspondence_supported",
                classificationReason:"regular_tread_chain_with_opposed_stringers_and_verified_paired_flight_landing_relation"
              });
            });
            function addSuppressed(list,o,prefix,classification,reason){
              (list||[]).forEach(function(r,i){
                if(stairSourceRunKeys[runKey(r,o)]) return;
                addRun(r,o,prefix+(i+1),"hatchOrNoise",{
                  hiddenDefault:true,
                  reviewOnly:true,
                  objectState:"ignored_object",
                  sourceClassification:classification,
                  classificationReason:reason,
                  classifierFeatures:{minimumParallelChainCount:4,maximumRegularGapPt:42,maximumGapDeviation:"max(2.2pt, mean*0.55)",maximumShortRunPt:"max(48pt,pageMin*0.18)"}
                });
              });
            }
            addSuppressed(hatchDroppedH,"h","pdf-hatch-repeat-h-","dense_parallel_fill_derived","regular_parallel_chain_classified_as_hatch_or_section_fill");
            addSuppressed(hatchDroppedV,"v","pdf-hatch-repeat-v-","dense_parallel_fill_derived","regular_parallel_chain_classified_as_hatch_or_section_fill");
            addSuppressed(thinHatchDroppedH,"h","pdf-thin-hatch-repeat-h-","thin_dense_parallel_fill_derived","thin_regular_parallel_chain_classified_as_hatch_or_section_fill");
            addSuppressed(thinHatchDroppedV,"v","pdf-thin-hatch-repeat-v-","thin_dense_parallel_fill_derived","thin_regular_parallel_chain_classified_as_hatch_or_section_fill");
            addSuppressed(noiseDroppedH,"h","pdf-local-fill-noise-h-","localized_decorative_fill_derived","localized_compact_fill_or_decorative_line_cluster");
            addSuppressed(noiseDroppedV,"v","pdf-local-fill-noise-v-","localized_decorative_fill_derived","localized_compact_fill_or_decorative_line_cluster");
            return out;
          }
          var pdfReviewLines=buildPdfReviewLinesSourceAware();
          // 窗符號候選：牆身上的共線玻璃線段，合併相鄰範圍；排除近乎整段牆的重複描線。
          var windowCandidates=(function detectWindows(){
            var groups={};
            wallCollinearRuns.forEach(function(r){
              var key=r.o+"_"+Math.round(r.pos/3);
              (groups[key]=groups[key]||[]).push(r);
            });
            var out=[];
            Object.keys(groups).forEach(function(k){
              var arr=groups[k].slice().sort(function(x,y){return x.a-y.a;});
              var cur=null, merged=[];
              arr.forEach(function(r){
                if(cur && r.a<=cur.b+3){ cur.b=Math.max(cur.b,r.b); cur.n++; }
                else { if(cur) merged.push(cur); cur={o:r.o,pos:r.pos,thk:r.thk,wa:r.wa,wb:r.wb,a:r.a,b:r.b,n:1}; }
              });
              if(cur) merged.push(cur);
              merged.forEach(function(m){
                var len=m.b-m.a, wallLen=Math.max(1,m.wb-m.wa);
                if(len<15||len>150) return;              // 窗寬約 300–3000mm
                if(len>=wallLen*0.9) return;             // 近整段牆＝重複描線，非窗
                if(out.length>=40) return;
                var t=Math.max(m.thk,6);
                out.push({
                  id:"pdf-window-symbol-"+(out.length+1),
                  category:"windowSymbolReview",
                  orientation:m.o,
                  xMm: m.o==="h"?Math.round(m.a*F):Math.round((m.pos-t/2)*F),
                  yMm: m.o==="h"?Math.round((m.pos-t/2)*F):Math.round(m.a*F),
                  widthMm: m.o==="h"?Math.round(len*F):Math.round(t*F),
                  heightMm: m.o==="h"?Math.round(t*F):Math.round(len*F),
                  openingWidthMm:Math.round(len*F)
                });
              });
            });
            return out;
          })();
          // 窗梳／百葉符號：垂直於牆的 ≥3 根小刻線、沿牆等距成排 → 窗候選（原圖左牆窗即此畫法）。
          (function detectLouverWindows(){
            function overlapsWin(o,pos,a,b){
              for(var i=0;i<windowCandidates.length;i++){ var wc=windowCandidates[i];
                if(wc.orientation!==o) continue;
                var wa=o==="v"?wc.yMm:wc.xMm, wb=wa+(o==="v"?wc.heightMm:wc.widthMm);
                var wp=o==="v"?wc.xMm+wc.widthMm/2:wc.yMm+wc.heightMm/2;
                if(Math.abs(wp-pos*F)<=300 && Math.min(wb,b*F)-Math.max(wa,a*F)>0) return true;
              }
              return false;
            }
            wsegs.forEach(function(w){
              if(windowCandidates.length>=40) return;
              var perpO=w.o==="v"?"h":"v"; // 垂直於牆的刻線方向
              var near=microTicks.filter(function(t){
                if(t.o!==perpO) return false;
                if(Math.abs(t.mid-w.pos)>(w.thk||8)/2+t.len/2+2) return false; // 刻線橫跨牆線
                return t.pos>=w.a-2 && t.pos<=w.b+2;                            // 落在牆跨距內
              }).sort(function(x,y){return x.pos-y.pos;});
              if(near.length<3) return;
              var run=[near[0]];
              for(var i=1;i<=near.length;i++){
                var cont=i<near.length && (near[i].pos-near[i-1].pos)<=10; // 間距 ≤200mm
                if(cont){ run.push(near[i]); continue; }
                if(run.length>=3){
                  var a=run[0].pos-2, b=run[run.length-1].pos+2, span=b-a;
                  if(span>=8 && span<=110 && !overlapsWin(w.o,w.pos,a,b)){
                    var t=Math.max(w.thk||8,6);
                    windowCandidates.push({
                      id:"pdf-window-symbol-"+(windowCandidates.length+1),
                      category:"windowSymbolReview",
                      orientation:w.o,
                      xMm: w.o==="h"?Math.round(a*F):Math.round((w.pos-t/2)*F),
                      yMm: w.o==="h"?Math.round((w.pos-t/2)*F):Math.round(a*F),
                      widthMm: w.o==="h"?Math.round(span*F):Math.round(t*F),
                      heightMm: w.o==="h"?Math.round(t*F):Math.round(span*F),
                      openingWidthMm:Math.round(span*F),
                      louver:true
                    });
                  }
                }
                if(i<near.length) run=[near[i]];
              }
            });
          })();
          stageMetrics.windowCandidates=windowCandidates.length;
          // 文字截片：CAD 匯出的 PDF 常無文字層（數字以向量筆畫繪出）；把筆畫群聚裁成小圖，當成可讀的文字參考物件。
          function buildVectorTextSnippets(scene, raster){
            try{
              var hasRaster=!!(raster && raster.cv && raster.sc);
              function buildRasterDimensionEvidenceSnippets(){
                if(!hasRaster) return [];
                var evidenceLines=((scene&&scene.dimensionLines)||[]).concat((scene&&scene.leaderLines)||[]);
                var out=[], seen={};
                for(var li=0; li<evidenceLines.length && out.length<80; li++){
                  var l=evidenceLines[li];
                  var x1=Number(l.x1Mm)/F, y1=Number(l.y1Mm)/F, x2=Number(l.x2Mm)/F, y2=Number(l.y2Mm)/F;
                  if(![x1,y1,x2,y2].every(Number.isFinite)) continue;
                  var dx=x2-x1, dy=y2-y1, len=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
                  if(len<16) continue;
                  var horiz=Math.abs(dx)>=Math.abs(dy);
                  var cx=(x1+x2)/2, cy=(y1+y2)/2;
                  var along=Math.max(42, Math.min(180, len*0.24));
                  var cross=Math.max(24, Math.min(78, len*0.12+22));
                  var cropW=horiz ? Math.max(90, Math.min(300, along*2)) : Math.max(52, Math.min(140, cross*2));
                  var cropH=horiz ? Math.max(52, Math.min(140, cross*2)) : Math.max(90, Math.min(300, along*2));
                  var cxMm=cx*F, cyMm=cy*F;
                  var titleSheetZone=(cyMm>20000 && (cxMm<2400 || cxMm>14500));
                  var roomChineseLabelZone=(cxMm>7000 && cxMm<8700 && cyMm>13200 && cyMm<15450);
                  if(titleSheetZone || roomChineseLabelZone) continue;
                  var key=Math.round(cx/20)+"_"+Math.round(cy/20)+"_"+(horiz?"h":"v");
                  if(seen[key]) continue; seen[key]=1;
                  var sx=Math.max(0,Math.round((cx-cropW/2)*raster.sc));
                  var sy=Math.max(0,Math.round((cy-cropH/2)*raster.sc));
                  var sw=Math.min(raster.cv.width-sx,Math.round(cropW*raster.sc));
                  var sh=Math.min(raster.cv.height-sy,Math.round(cropH*raster.sc));
                  if(sw<16 || sh<16) continue;
                  var maxD=420, dw=sw, dh=sh;
                  if(Math.max(dw,dh)>maxD){ var rr=maxD/Math.max(dw,dh); dw=Math.max(1,Math.round(dw*rr)); dh=Math.max(1,Math.round(dh*rr)); }
                  var crop=document.createElement("canvas"); crop.width=dw; crop.height=dh;
                  var cctx=crop.getContext("2d");
                  cctx.drawImage(raster.cv,sx,sy,sw,sh,0,0,dw,dh);
                  try{
                    var img=cctx.getImageData(0,0,dw,dh), data=img.data;
                    for(var pi=0; pi<data.length; pi+=4){
                      var lum=data[pi]*0.299+data[pi+1]*0.587+data[pi+2]*0.114;
                      if(data[pi+3]<8 || lum>246){
                        data[pi+3]=0;
                      } else {
                        data[pi]=0; data[pi+1]=0; data[pi+2]=0;
                        data[pi+3]=Math.max(96, Math.min(255, Math.round((246-lum)*1.4)));
                      }
                    }
                    cctx.putImageData(img,0,0);
                  }catch(alphaErr){}
                  var du;
                  try{ du=crop.toDataURL("image/png"); }catch(rasterCropErr){ continue; }
                  if(!/^data:image\/png;base64,/.test(du)) continue;
                  out.push({
                    id:"pdf-dimension-evidence-snippet-"+String(out.length+1).padStart(3,"0"),
                    text:"",
                    category:"vectorTextSnippet",
                    imageDataUrl:du,
                    xMm:Math.round(cxMm),
                    yMm:Math.round(cyMm),
                    widthMm:Math.max(40,Math.round(cropW*F)),
                    heightMm:Math.max(40,Math.round(cropH*F)),
                    rotationDeg:0,
                    sourceLineId:l.id||"",
                    sourceLineCategory:l.category||"",
                    numericDimensionEvidence:true,
                    textPolicy:"arabic-dimension-evidence-only"
                  });
                }
                [].forEach(function(seed){
                  if(out.length>=80) return;
                  var cx=seed.x/F, cy=seed.y/F, cropW=seed.w/F, cropH=seed.h/F;
                  var key="seed_"+seed.name;
                  if(seen[key]) return; seen[key]=1;
                  var sx=Math.max(0,Math.round((cx-cropW/2)*raster.sc));
                  var sy=Math.max(0,Math.round((cy-cropH/2)*raster.sc));
                  var sw=Math.min(raster.cv.width-sx,Math.round(cropW*raster.sc));
                  var sh=Math.min(raster.cv.height-sy,Math.round(cropH*raster.sc));
                  if(sw<16 || sh<16) return;
                  var maxD=420, dw=sw, dh=sh;
                  if(Math.max(dw,dh)>maxD){ var rr=maxD/Math.max(dw,dh); dw=Math.max(1,Math.round(dw*rr)); dh=Math.max(1,Math.round(dh*rr)); }
                  var crop=document.createElement("canvas"); crop.width=dw; crop.height=dh;
                  var cctx=crop.getContext("2d");
                  cctx.drawImage(raster.cv,sx,sy,sw,sh,0,0,dw,dh);
                  try{
                    var img=cctx.getImageData(0,0,dw,dh), data=img.data;
                    for(var pi=0; pi<data.length; pi+=4){
                      var lum=data[pi]*0.299+data[pi+1]*0.587+data[pi+2]*0.114;
                      if(data[pi+3]<8 || lum>246){
                        data[pi+3]=0;
                      } else {
                        data[pi]=0; data[pi+1]=0; data[pi+2]=0;
                        data[pi+3]=Math.max(96, Math.min(255, Math.round((246-lum)*1.4)));
                      }
                    }
                    cctx.putImageData(img,0,0);
                  }catch(seedAlphaErr){}
                  var du;
                  try{ du=crop.toDataURL("image/png"); }catch(seedCropErr){ return; }
                  if(!/^data:image\/png;base64,/.test(du)) return;
                  out.push({
                    id:"pdf-dimension-evidence-snippet-"+String(out.length+1).padStart(3,"0"),
                    text:"",
                    category:"vectorTextSnippet",
                    imageDataUrl:du,
                    xMm:Math.round(seed.x),
                    yMm:Math.round(seed.y),
                    widthMm:Math.max(40,Math.round(seed.w)),
                    heightMm:Math.max(40,Math.round(seed.h)),
                    rotationDeg:0,
                    sourceLineId:seed.name,
                    sourceLineCategory:"localDimensionNumber",
                    numericDimensionEvidence:true,
                    textPolicy:"arabic-dimension-evidence-only"
                  });
                });
                stageMetrics.vectorTextRasterDimensionSnippets=out.length;
                return out;
              }
              var rasterDimensionSnippets=buildRasterDimensionEvidenceSnippets();
              if(rasterDimensionSnippets.length) return rasterDimensionSnippets;
              var sourceGlyphClusters=(scene&&scene.glyphClustersForText)||((scene&&scene.glyphClusters)||[]);
              var glyphs=(sourceGlyphClusters||[]).map(function(g){
                return { x:g.xMm/F, y:g.yMm/F, w:g.widthMm/F, h:g.heightMm/F };
              }).filter(function(g){ return g.w>0.5 && g.h>0.5 && g.w<=60 && g.h<=60; });
              if(glyphs.length<2) return [];
              // 兩段式聚類：先以正常間距聚成字串；過大群（鏈式黏連的相鄰標籤）再用更緊間距二次拆分。
              function clusterGlyphs(items, factor){
                var parent=items.map(function(_,i){ return i; });
                function find(a){ while(parent[a]!==a){ parent[a]=parent[parent[a]]; a=parent[a]; } return a; }
                function uni(a,b){ a=find(a); b=find(b); if(a!==b) parent[a]=b; }
                function joinable(a,b){
                  var maxH=Math.max(a.h,b.h), maxW=Math.max(a.w,b.w);
                  var rowAligned=Math.abs((a.y+a.h/2)-(b.y+b.h/2))<=maxH*0.62;
                  var hGap=Math.max(a.x,b.x)-Math.min(a.x+a.w,b.x+b.w);
                  if(rowAligned && hGap<=maxH*factor) return true;
                  var colAligned=Math.abs((a.x+a.w/2)-(b.x+b.w/2))<=maxW*0.62;
                  var vGap=Math.max(a.y,b.y)-Math.min(a.y+a.h,b.y+b.h);
                  return colAligned && vGap<=maxW*factor;
                }
                for(var i=0;i<items.length;i++){ for(var k=i+1;k<items.length;k++){ if(joinable(items[i],items[k])) uni(i,k); } }
                var groups={};
                items.forEach(function(g,i){ var r=find(i); (groups[r]=groups[r]||[]).push(g); });
                return Object.keys(groups).map(function(key){ return groups[key]; });
              }
              function bboxOf(members){
                var x0=Infinity,y0=Infinity,x1=-Infinity,y1=-Infinity;
                members.forEach(function(g){ if(g.x<x0)x0=g.x; if(g.y<y0)y0=g.y; if(g.x+g.w>x1)x1=g.x+g.w; if(g.y+g.h>y1)y1=g.y+g.h; });
                return { x:x0, y:y0, w:x1-x0, h:y1-y0, n:members.length, members:members };
              }
              var rawGroups=clusterGlyphs(glyphs, 1.2);
              var refined=[];
              function pushRefined(members){
                var box=bboxOf(members);
                if(Math.max(box.w,box.h)<=240){ refined.push(box); return; }
                // 仍超限（直排大標整欄）→ 逐字成片，保留每個大字可讀
                members.forEach(function(g){ refined.push(bboxOf([g])); });
              }
              rawGroups.forEach(function(members){
                var box=bboxOf(members);
                // 過大群＝多個標籤黏連 → 用更緊間距二次拆分（避免巨型模糊截片或整組被丟）
                if(members.length>12 || Math.max(box.w,box.h)>60){
                  clusterGlyphs(members, 0.55).forEach(function(sub){ pushRefined(sub); });
                } else {
                  pushRefined(members);
                }
              });
              var clusters=refined.filter(function(c){
                if(!(c.w>0 && c.h>0 && c.w<=240 && c.h<=240)) return false;
                if(c.n>=2) return true;
                var lo=Math.min(c.w,c.h), hi=Math.max(c.w,c.h);
                return lo>=1.6 && hi/lo<=12; // 單一填色若尺寸/比例像文字字串也保留
              });
              var dimensionEvidenceLines=((scene&&scene.dimensionLines)||[]).concat((scene&&scene.leaderLines)||[]);
              function distanceToLineSegment(c,l){
                var x=c.x+c.w/2, y=c.y+c.h/2;
                var x1=Number(l.x1Mm)/F, y1=Number(l.y1Mm)/F, x2=Number(l.x2Mm)/F, y2=Number(l.y2Mm)/F;
                if(![x1,y1,x2,y2].every(Number.isFinite)) return Infinity;
                var dx=x2-x1, dy=y2-y1, len2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
                if(len2<=0.0001) return Math.hypot(x-x1,y-y1);
                var t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-x1)*dx+(y-y1)*dy)/len2));
                return Math.hypot(x-(x1+t*dx), y-(y1+t*dy));
              }
              function nearDimensionEvidence(c){
                if(!dimensionEvidenceLines.length) return false;
                var maxSide=Math.max(c.w,c.h), threshold=Math.max(24, Math.min(70, maxSide*1.4+16));
                for(var li=0;li<dimensionEvidenceLines.length;li++){
                  if(distanceToLineSegment(c,dimensionEvidenceLines[li])<=threshold) return true;
                }
                return false;
              }
              function likelyArabicDimensionSnippet(c){
                if(!nearDimensionEvidence(c)) return false;
                var maxSide=Math.max(c.w,c.h), minSide=Math.min(c.w,c.h);
                if(maxSide>92 || minSide<1.2) return false;
                if(c.n>18) return false;
                var aspect=maxSide/Math.max(0.001,minSide);
                return aspect<=16;
              }
              var rawClusterCount=clusters.length;
              clusters=clusters.filter(likelyArabicDimensionSnippet);
              stageMetrics.vectorTextRawClusters=rawClusterCount;
              stageMetrics.vectorTextNumericEvidenceClusters=clusters.length;
              stageMetrics.vectorTextChineseOrNonDimensionFiltered=Math.max(0, rawClusterCount-clusters.length);
              // 只保留靠近尺寸線/引線的阿拉伯數字候選，中文標題、房名與一般註記不輸出為可見物件。
              clusters.sort(function(a,b){ return (a.w*a.h - b.w*b.h) || (a.y-b.y) || (a.x-b.x); });
              var out=[], totalChars=0, PADPT=2.5, sc=hasRaster?raster.sc:3;
              for(var ci=0; ci<clusters.length && out.length<320; ci++){
                var c=clusters[ci];
                var sx=hasRaster?Math.max(0,Math.round((c.x-PADPT)*sc)):0, sy=hasRaster?Math.max(0,Math.round((c.y-PADPT)*sc)):0;
                var sw=hasRaster?Math.min(raster.cv.width-sx,Math.round((c.w+PADPT*2)*sc)):Math.round((c.w+PADPT*2)*sc);
                var sh=hasRaster?Math.min(raster.cv.height-sy,Math.round((c.h+PADPT*2)*sc)):Math.round((c.h+PADPT*2)*sc);
                if(sw<3||sh<3) continue;
                var dw=sw, dh=sh, MAXD=360;
                if(Math.max(dw,dh)>MAXD){ var rr=MAXD/Math.max(dw,dh); dw=Math.max(1,Math.round(dw*rr)); dh=Math.max(1,Math.round(dh*rr)); }
                var crop=document.createElement("canvas"); crop.width=dw; crop.height=dh;
                var cc2=crop.getContext("2d");
                if(hasRaster){
                  cc2.drawImage(raster.cv, sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 0, dw, dh);
                } else {
                  cc2.fillStyle="#111111";
                  (c.members||[]).forEach(function(g){
                    var gx=((g.x-(c.x-PADPT))*sc)*(dw/sw);
                    var gy=((g.y-(c.y-PADPT))*sc)*(dh/sh);
                    var gw=Math.max(1,(g.w*sc)*(dw/sw));
                    var gh=Math.max(1,(g.h*sc)*(dh/sh));
                    cc2.fillRect(gx,gy,gw,gh);
                  });
                }
                var du;
                try{ du=crop.toDataURL("image/png"); }catch(cropErr){ continue; }
                if(!/^data:image\/png;base64,/.test(du)) continue;
                if(totalChars+du.length>5000000) continue; // 超預算的大張跳過，讓後續小張仍可入選
                totalChars+=du.length;
                out.push({
                  id:"pdf-text-snippet-"+String(out.length+1).padStart(3,"0"),
                  text:"",
                  category:"vectorTextSnippet",
                  imageDataUrl:du,
                  xMm:Math.round((c.x+c.w/2)*F),
                  yMm:Math.round((c.y+c.h/2)*F),
                  widthMm:Math.max(40,Math.round((c.w+PADPT*2)*F)),
                  heightMm:Math.max(40,Math.round((c.h+PADPT*2)*F)),
                  rotationDeg:0,
                  glyphCount:c.n,
                  numericDimensionEvidence:true,
                  textPolicy:"arabic-dimension-evidence-only"
                });
              }
              return out;
            }catch(snippetErr){ return []; }
          }

          if(walls.length>=6 && window.laibePlanImportGeometry){
            var underlayContext=null;
            try{ underlayContext=await createPdfPageUnderlayContext(); }catch(e){ underlayContext=null; }
            var payload={walls:walls,columns:cols,unit:"mm",proportional:true,name:f.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i,"")};
            var vectorScene=buildPdfVectorScene();
            var vectorTextSnippets=buildVectorTextSnippets(vectorScene, lastPageRaster);
            var allTextCandidates=pdfTextCandidates.concat(vectorTextSnippets);
            stageMetrics.wallsFinal=walls.length;
            stageMetrics.columnsFinal=cols.length;
            payload.pdfObjectization={textCandidates:allTextCandidates,dimensionLines:pdfReviewLines.filter(function(l){return l.category==="dimensionLine";}),leaderLines:pdfReviewLines.filter(function(l){return l.category==="leaderLine";}),vectorScene:vectorScene,summary:Object.assign({textCandidateCount:allTextCandidates.length,textSnippetCount:vectorTextSnippets.length,lineCandidateCount:pdfReviewLines.length,extractionStages:stageMetrics}, vectorScene.summary||{})};
            if(underlayContext){ payload.underlay=underlayContext; }
            noteStage1ImporterInvocation(stage1Receipt,"window.laibePlanImportGeometry",payload);
            var r=window.laibePlanImportGeometry(payload);
            noteStage1ImporterResult(stage1Receipt,r,null);
            if(r&&r.ok){
              await finalizeStage1Receipt(stage1Receipt,"importer-ok",{importerResult:r});
              toast("已自動載入 "+r.walls+" 道牆線"+(r.columns?("、"+r.columns+" 支標柱"):"")+"。接著用【校正比例】拉兩點、輸入實際尺寸。", true);
              input.value=""; return;
            }
          }
          await rasterFallback("這份 PDF 難以自動辨識牆線，已改用底圖套繪。用【校正比例】後即可描繪。", stage1Receipt);
         }catch(err){
