          if(stage1Receipt){
            stage1Receipt.pdfjs.error=err && err.message ? err.message : String(err);
            noteStage1ImporterResult(stage1Receipt,null,err);
            try{ await finalizeStage1Receipt(stage1Receipt,"import-error",{error:stage1Receipt.pdfjs.error}); }catch(finalizeErr){}
          }
          toast("PDF 解析失敗："+(err && err.message ? err.message : "請改用圖檔套繪"));
         }
        }

        // 圖層選取面板：多圖層時先讓使用者挑「牆／柱」相關圖層，減少雜訊。
        function showLayerPicker(ids){
          var old=document.getElementById("laibeOcgPicker"); if(old) old.remove();
          var anyMatch=ids.some(function(id){ return WALLKW.test(ocName(id)); });
          var ov=document.createElement("div"); ov.id="laibeOcgPicker";
          ov.style.cssText="position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(6,10,14,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);font-family:system-ui,'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif";
          var rows=ids.map(function(id){
            var nm=ocName(id), on=anyMatch?WALLKW.test(nm):true;
            return '<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;color:#e6edf2">'
              +'<input type="checkbox" data-ocg="'+id+'" '+(on?"checked":"")+' style="width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:#EB581E">'
              +'<span style="flex:1">'+nm.replace(/[<>&]/g,"")+'</span></label>';
          }).join("");
          ov.innerHTML='<div style="width:min(420px,92vw);max-height:82vh;overflow:auto;padding:18px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(16,22,28,.96);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.55)">'
            +'<div style="font:800 15px/1.3 system-ui;color:#fff;margin-bottom:4px">選擇要匯入的圖層</div>'
            +'<div style="font-size:12px;color:#9fb0bd;margin-bottom:12px">這份 PDF 有圖層。'+(anyMatch?'已先勾選「牆／柱／結構」相關圖層，':'')+'只匯入勾選圖層可大幅減少尺寸線、家具與文字的雜訊。</div>'
            +'<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-bottom:16px">'+rows+'</div>'
            +'<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end">'
              +'<button data-ocg-cancel style="padding:9px 14px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);background:transparent;color:#cdd8df;font:700 13px system-ui;cursor:pointer">取消</button>'
              +'<button data-ocg-all style="padding:9px 14px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#e6edf2;font:700 13px system-ui;cursor:pointer">全部匯入</button>'
              +'<button data-ocg-ok style="padding:9px 16px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid rgba(235,88,30,.6);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff7a3c,#EB581E);color:#fff;font:800 13px system-ui;cursor:pointer">匯入勾選圖層</button>'
            +'</div></div>';
          document.body.appendChild(ov);
          function applyVis(selectedOnly){
            ids.forEach(function(id){
              var vis=true;
              if(selectedOnly){ var cb=ov.querySelector('input[data-ocg="'+id+'"]'); vis=!!(cb&&cb.checked); }
              try{ ocConfig.setVisibility(id, vis); }catch(e){}
            });
          }
          ov.querySelector("[data-ocg-ok]").addEventListener("click", function(){ applyVis(true); ov.remove(); extract(); });
          ov.querySelector("[data-ocg-all]").addEventListener("click", function(){ applyVis(false); ov.remove(); extract(); });
          ov.querySelector("[data-ocg-cancel]").addEventListener("click", function(){ ov.remove(); input.value=""; toast("已取消匯入。"); });
        }

        var ocgIds = ocGroups ? Object.keys(ocGroups) : [];
        if(ocgIds.length>=1){ showLayerPicker(ocgIds); }
        else { await extract(); }
      }catch(err){
        toast("PDF 解析失敗："+(err && err.message ? err.message : "請改用圖檔套繪"));
      }
    }, true); // capture：早於引擎的拒絕邏輯
    return true;
  }
  if(!bind()){ var n=0,iv=setInterval(function(){ n++; if(bind()||n>60) clearInterval(iv); },150); }
})();
</script>
  <script src="../shared/laibe-owner-progress.js"></script>

    /* 已用全站玻璃 header；隱藏 flowbar 內重複 logo，避免三層標頭跑位 */

<script id="laibe-geometry-import">
(function(){
  function isGeom(f){ return /\.(json|laibeplan)$/i.test(f.name) || f.type==='application/json'; }
  function toast(msg, ok){
    var t=document.getElementById('laibe-pdf-toast');
    if(!t){ t=document.createElement('div'); t.id='laibe-pdf-toast';
      t.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:9999;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;font:600 13px/1.4 system-ui,\'Noto Sans TC\',sans-serif;color:#fff;background:rgba(12,16,20,.92);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.4)';
      document.body.appendChild(t); }
    t.style.borderColor=ok?'rgba(98,230,200,.5)':'rgba(235,88,30,.5)';
    t.textContent=msg; t.style.opacity='1'; t.style.transition='opacity .3s ease';
    clearTimeout(t.__h); t.__h=setTimeout(function(){ t.style.opacity='0'; },3200);
  }
  function bind(){
    var input=document.getElementById('planImportInput');
    if(!input || input.__laibeGeomBound) return !!input;
    input.__laibeGeomBound=true;
    input.addEventListener('change', function(e){
      var f=input.files && input.files[0];
      if(!f || !isGeom(f)) return; // 交給既有引擎處理 圖片/PDF
      e.stopImmediatePropagation(); e.preventDefault();
      var reader=new FileReader();
      reader.onload=function(){
        var data;
        try{ data=JSON.parse(reader.result); }
        catch(err){ toast('掃描檔解析失敗：不是有效的 JSON。'); return; }
        if(!window.laibePlanImportGeometry){ toast('匯入元件尚未就緒，請稍候再試。'); return; }
        var r=window.laibePlanImportGeometry(data);
        if(r && r.ok){ toast('已直接匯入掃描平面：'+r.walls+' 道牆（含真實尺寸，免校正、免套繪）。', true); }
        else { toast('掃描檔沒有可用的牆體資料（walls）。'); }
        input.value='';
      };
      reader.onerror=function(){ toast('讀取掃描檔失敗。'); };
      reader.readAsText(f);
    }, true); // capture：早於引擎的 change 處理
    return true;
  }
  if(!bind()){ var n=0,iv=setInterval(function(){ n++; if(bind()||n>60) clearInterval(iv); },150); }
})();
</script>
<script id="laibe-calibration-prompt">
(function(){
  function ui(){ return window.laibePlancraftPlusUiState || null; }
  var box=null;
  function ensureBox(){
    if(box) return box;
    box=document.createElement('div'); box.id='laibeCalPrompt';
    box.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:50%;top:92px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:10000;display:none;min-width:300px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(14,19,24,.96);border:1px solid rgba(235,88,30,.55);box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5);color:#fff;font:600 13px/1.5 system-ui,\'Noto Sans TC\',sans-serif;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)';
    box.innerHTML='<div id="laibeCalTitle" style="font-weight:800;margin-bottom:8px;color:#ffd27a">設定實際距離（校正比例）</div>'
      +'<div id="laibeCalHint" style="font-size:12px;color:#aeb8bf;margin-bottom:10px">請在底圖點兩個已知距離的端點。</div>'
      +'<div id="laibeCalInputRow" style="display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px">'
      +'<span style="font-size:12px;color:#cdd6dc">兩點實際距離</span>'
      +'<input id="laibeCalCm" type="number" min="1" step="0.1" placeholder="例如 350" style="width:120px;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#fff;font-size:13px">'
      +'<span style="font-size:12px;color:#cdd6dc">cm</span></div>'
      +'<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end">'
      +'<button id="laibeCalCancel" type="button" style="padding:7px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:transparent;color:#cdd6dc;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer">取消</button>'
      +'<button id="laibeCalApply" type="button" style="padding:7px 14px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:#EB581E;color:#fff;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer">套用比例</button></div>';
    document.body.appendChild(box);
    box.querySelector('#laibeCalCancel').addEventListener('click',function(){
      var s=ui(); if(s){ s.calibrationPoints=[]; s.mode='select'; }
      hide();
    });
    box.querySelector('#laibeCalApply').addEventListener('click',applyNow);
    box.querySelector('#laibeCalCm').addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Enter'){ e.preventDefault(); applyNow(); } });
    return box;
  }
  function applyNow(){
    var s=ui(); if(!s) return;
    var inp=box.querySelector('#laibeCalCm');
    var cm=parseFloat(inp.value);
    if(!(cm>0)){ inp.focus(); return; }
    if(s.mode==='scale-plan'){
      if(window.laibePlanApplyGroupScaleCm){ window.laibePlanApplyGroupScaleCm(cm); }
      hide(); return;
    }
    s.knownLengthInput=String(Math.round(cm*10));
    if(window.laibePlanApplyCalibrationCm){ window.laibePlanApplyCalibrationCm(cm); }
    else { var btn=document.querySelector('[data-action="apply-calibration"]'); if(btn){ btn.click(); } }
    hide();
  }
  function hide(){ if(box) box.style.display='none'; }
  function tick(){
    var s=ui();
    if(s && (s.mode==='calibrate' || s.mode==='scale-plan')){
      var isScale = s.mode==='scale-plan';
      var b=ensureBox(); b.style.display='block';
      var title=b.querySelector('#laibeCalTitle'), applyBtn=b.querySelector('#laibeCalApply');
      if(title) title.textContent = isScale ? '整體縮放到真實尺寸' : '設定實際距離（校正比例）';
      if(applyBtn) applyBtn.textContent = isScale ? '整體縮放' : '套用比例';
      var n=(s.calibrationPoints||[]).length;
      var hint=b.querySelector('#laibeCalHint'), row=b.querySelector('#laibeCalInputRow'), inp=b.querySelector('#laibeCalCm');
      var askText = isScale ? '請在圖上點兩個已知實際距離的端點（會自動吸附牆角）。' : '請在底圖點兩個已知距離的端點。';
      if(n>=2){ hint.textContent=(isScale?'已標出兩點，輸入這兩點的實際距離後整體縮放。':'已標出兩點，輸入實際距離後套用。'); if(row.style.display!=='flex'){ row.style.display='flex'; if(!isScale && s.knownLengthInput && !inp.value){ var mm=parseFloat(s.knownLengthInput); if(mm>0) inp.value=(mm/10); } setTimeout(function(){inp.focus();},0); } }
      else if(n===1){ hint.textContent='已放第 1 點，請再點第 2 點。'; row.style.display='none'; }
      else { hint.textContent=askText; row.style.display='none'; }
    } else { hide(); }
    setTimeout(tick, 250);
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',tick); else tick();
})();
</script>
<script id="laibe-group-drag">
(function(){
  function canvas(){ return document.querySelector('.canvas-shell') || document.getElementById('planCanvas'); }
  var dragging=false, last=null, moved=false;
  function grouped(){ return window.laibePlanIsGrouped && window.laibePlanIsGrouped(); }
  function ppm(){ var s=window.laibePlanScale||{}; return s.pxPerMm||0.1; }
  function zoom(){ return window.laibePlanGetViewZoom?window.laibePlanGetViewZoom():1; }
  function selectMode(){ var s=window.laibePlancraftPlusUiState; return s && s.mode==='select'; }
  function isActiveGroupTarget(ev){
    var t=ev.target&&ev.target.closest?ev.target.closest('[data-wall-id],[data-structure-id],[data-zone-id],[data-furniture-id],.furniture-item'):null;
    if(!t) return false;
    var p=window.laibePlanPuzzleProject||{}, gid=p.activeGroupId;
    if(!gid) return false;
    var wall=t.getAttribute('data-wall-id'), structure=t.getAttribute('data-structure-id'), zone=t.getAttribute('data-zone-id'), furniture=t.getAttribute('data-furniture-id');
    if(wall) return (p.walls||[]).some(function(x){ return x.id===wall && x.groupId===gid; });
    if(structure) return (p.structures||[]).some(function(x){ return x.id===structure && x.groupId===gid; });
    if(furniture) return (p.furniture||[]).some(function(x){ return x.id===furniture && x.groupId===gid; });
    if(zone) return (p.zones||[]).some(function(x){ return x.id===zone && x.groupId===gid; });
    return false;
  }
  function onSurface(ev){
    var c=canvas(); if(!c||!ev.target||!c.contains(ev.target)) return false;
    if(isActiveGroupTarget(ev)) return true;
    if(ev.target.closest('#laibeTopTools, button, a, [data-action], .loop70-basket-trigger, [data-loop70-panel-close], input, textarea')) return false;
    return false;
  }
  window.laibePlanCancelGroupDrag=function(){ dragging=false; moved=false; last=null; };
  window.laibePlanClearActiveGroup=function(){
    try{
      var p=window.laibePlanPuzzleProject;
      if(p) p.activeGroupId=null;
    }catch(e){}
    dragging=false; moved=false; last=null;
  };
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(ev){
    if(ev.button!==0 || !grouped() || !selectMode() || !onSurface(ev)) return;
    dragging=true; moved=false; last={x:ev.clientX,y:ev.clientY};
    if(window.laibePlanBeginGroupDrag) window.laibePlanBeginGroupDrag();
    ev.stopImmediatePropagation(); ev.preventDefault();
  },true);
  document.addEventListener('pointermove',function(ev){
    if(!dragging) return;
    var dxpx=(ev.clientX-last.x)/zoom(), dypx=(ev.clientY-last.y)/zoom();
    if(dxpx===0 && dypx===0) return;
    last={x:ev.clientX,y:ev.clientY}; moved=true;
    var pm=ppm(); if(window.laibePlanTranslateGroup) window.laibePlanTranslateGroup(dxpx/pm, dypx/pm);
    ev.stopImmediatePropagation(); ev.preventDefault();
  },true);
  function end(ev){ if(dragging){ dragging=false; if(moved){ ev.stopImmediatePropagation(); } } }
  document.addEventListener('pointerup',end,true);
  document.addEventListener('pointercancel',end,true);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
